title: Project Engineer - MSP
description:
Position: Project Engineer

Location: Newbury & Surrounding areas ( Hybrid )

Salary: £50k

Primary Purpose

You will play a key role in the planning, delivery and ongoing support of client technology solutions. The role combines project implementation with hands-on field engineering, working both on-site and remotely to ensure client systems are deployed, maintained and supported to a high standard. You will work closely with the Project Management Office, clients and the Service Desk to understand requirements, deliver projects in line with agreed scope, resolve complex technical issues and ensure a smooth transition into ongoing support.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the PMO to ensure successful delivery of projects, meeting client requirements, agreed scope, timelines and quality standards, with consistent communication and alignment between stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Review and quality check Statements of Work (SOWs) from a technical delivery perspective before project commencement, validating that the proposed solution, scope, assumptions, dependencies, technical requirements, resource requirements and estimated effort are clear, accurate and deliverable. Identify and escalate gaps, risks or ambiguities before work is scheduled or commenced.
  • Complete Statements of Work (SOWs) for project delivery where required, providing additional support and resilience within the Professional Services function when there is a need to cover periods of holiday, workload pressure or other operational demands.
  • Track all project activities in Autotask, following established procedures for project tracking, updates and reporting. Ensure milestones, tasks, risks, issues and actions are documented promptly to maintain clear visibility for the wider team.
  • Plan and deliver technical implementations on client sites and remotely, including installation, configuration, migration, upgrade and remediation activity across supported technologies.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues and provide technical assistance on client sites, acting as an escalation point and providing technical advice to Service Desk engineers where required.
  • Complete proactive maintenance on client sites and identify opportunities to improve the resilience, security, performance and efficiency of client systems and services.
  • Prepare, maintain and deliver comprehensive client documentation, ensuring technical details, configurations and system information are accurate and updated in IT Glue and shared with the Service Desk to support a smooth handover into ongoing support.
  • Uphold the highest standards of information security by following company policies and procedures and supporting compliance with relevant industry regulation, data protection requirements and the company's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Take ownership of technical activities within client onboarding and offboarding, ensuring systems, access, documentation and data are handled appropriately and transitions are completed efficiently and securely.
  • Provide timely and professional updates to clients and internal stakeholders, setting clear expectations and communicating technical information in an accessible way.
  • Provide out-of-hours or standby support to clients on a rota basis where required.

Experience:

  • Previous experience within a similar field-based, project engineering or Professional Services role, ideally within an MSP environment.
  • Ability to work unsupervised, independently and as part of a wider technical and project team.
  • Strong all-round knowledge of IT principles with a versatile approach to new technologies and demonstrable learning capability.
  • Experience with PSA/RMM and documentation tools such as Autotask, AEM and IT Glue would be advantageous.
  • Experience administering and supporting Microsoft Windows Server and Desktop environments.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, including email migrations, Intune deployment, Azure Information Protection, Azure AD Join, AD Connect, SharePoint Online, DLP and MDM.
  • Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Windows Server and related server roles (IIS/RDS/DFS/NPS).
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure Active Directory, Azure IaaS and Azure Virtual Desktop.
  • Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V and/or VMware vSphere and vCentre.
  • Experience configuring Multi-Factor Authentication and Conditional Access for Microsoft 365 and related technologies.
  • Experience with backup and DR technologies, including Datto.
  • Experience with firewall technologies, including WatchGuard.
  • Detailed knowledge of switching and routing, including VLANs and networking technologies such as TCP/IP, VPN, DHCP, DNS and SSL; experience with Aruba, Cisco and UniFi is advantageous.
  • Experience building and supporting wireless networks.
  • Ability to run, patch and terminate cabling to support installation of new hardware.
  • IT-related degree or relevant technical qualifications are desirable, including MD-102, CompTIA Network+ or equivalent certifications.

title: Executive Director - National Head of Account Management
description:
Your mission

The National Head of Account Management offers a meaningful leadership opportunity to deliver the field strategy and execution for commercial launch of an allogeneic cell therapy, Tabelecleucel (tab-cel). The incumbent is responsible for the achievement of national sales targets and the performance of the account team. This role will shape critical components of the commercial strategy such as the development of the treatment site activation strategy, customer engagement model, leadership and development out of the cell therapy account team and the team’s execution to ensure appropriate patients can benefit from this innovative product post approval. This role will be part of the Commercial leadership team and work closely with the CCO, Head of Value an Access and other cross functional leaders to ensure efficient operational execution supporting appropriate patient treatment.

The ideal candidate is a Purpose-driven, agile leader, with a strong entrepreneurial spirit, collaborative mindset, high self awareness and emotional intelligence with a demonstrated ability to inspire high-performing teams in a scaling organization. This role will report to the Senior Vice President, head of commercial and be a core member of the US Commercial Leadership Team.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Sales Leadership and Drive for Performance:

  • Motivate, engage, develop and positively lead a National team of Cell Therapy Account Directors responsible for appropriately promoting Tab-cel to Cell Therapy Sites of Care and consistently achieving sales targets
  • Set a consistently high standard for development and execution of key account plans across the US, effectively collaborating with key internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate patients receive Tab-cel in expedited manner
  • Ensure that Account team behaviors and performance consistently meet or exceed expectations while following all required compliance requirements
  • Develop and implement national account strategies to consistently meet company objectives
  • Develop and implement comprehensive, rigorous account planning processes and collaborate across all customer-facing functions, as appropriate
  • Assess the commercial landscape by gathering insights on barriers and opportunities, develop and execute differentiated commercial strategies
  • Partner closely with the Head of US Value and Access to support patient access and positive external stakeholder experience ensuring the team work collaboratively together
  • Identify and establish regular tracking for all relevant leading indicators for performance at the national, regional and account level, adapting plans as needed to consistently achieve sales targets
  • Inform sales targets and forecast sales performance.
  • Establish strong partnership across all PFP Commercialization functions being seen as a trusted and valued internal thought partner

Team Leadership:

  • Lead, coach, develop, and motivate the national account team to achieve individual and team goals.
  • Regularly monitor individual and team performance, both remotely and in the field, developing plans of action accordingly to improve effectiveness.
  • Establish a positive, high integrity, high-performance culture with consistently high levels of team and individual accountability.
  • Establish and consistently execute individual team development plans
  • Develop a motivational incentive compensation program

Stakeholder Engagement and Customer Centricity

  • Identify, develop and engage external experts influential across the patient journey in the fields of hematology, transplantation therapeutic guideline committees, hospital/transplant administrators, and medical societies.
  • Work with key site stakeholders to identify and efficiently implement processes for speedy, new cellular therapy adoption at sites (P&T, SOPs, contracting, cell therapy lab requirements) for appropriate HCT and solid tumor transplant patients. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by addressing customer and patient needs, resolving issues promptly.
  • Be seen as a valued partner and representative of Pierre Fabre Pharma by all key industry stakeholders

Compliance and Reporting:

  • Ensure all account activities comply with industry regulations and company policies.
  • Prepare and present regular reports on account performance, market trends, key customer insights, and strategic initiatives to senior management.

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as required based on evolving business needs.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or related discipline
  • Experience in cell or gene therapies
  • Experience working within solid organ or stem cell transplantation a plus
  • Minimum of 10 years of leadership within related Pharmaceutical, Biotech organizations required
  • Experience launching high priced products treating patients with rare or ultra rare diseases.
  • Experience in building, and successfully leading high performing Commercial teams as well as establishing foundational operational structures
  • Demonstrated experience of consistently leading teams to ethically and compliantly meet or exceed their sales targets
  • Demonstrated ability to establish a high engagement/ high agility team culture
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to drive innovation, creativity, and performance, demonstrating appropriate executive presence to positively represent the US Account Team both internally and externally
  • Strong collaboration skills and an ability to work effectively with a variety of cross-functional colleagues across all professional levels
  • Command of government and industry guidelines, regulations, laws, etc., for appropriate scientific/medical exchange and communication with customers.
  • A high level of emotional intelligence, self awareness and humility to partner effectively with all stakeholders, internally and externally.
  • Self-starter and comfortable operating in a “start-up" environment with diverse responsibilities.
  • Relevant pharmaceutical industry regulatory and compliance guidelines and company policies.

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Advanced degree in healthcare related field preferred
  • Deep proficiency in a broad number of commercial topics such as marketing, marketing operations/, sales analytics, sales leadership, sales strategy, account management, value/cost of care discussions, hospitalizations, drug pricing pressures, and reimbursement education.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Field-based position
  • Ability to travel up to 50% or as dictated by business needs with occasional global travel

LOCATION: US - National, remote.

Compensation and Benefits:

Anticipated Salary Range: $250,000 - $340,000

This range represents the base annual full-time salary for all positions within the applicable job grade. The actual salary offer will depend on a range of factors including experience, education, location, and other relevant qualifications. This position is also eligible for a Pierre Fabre bonus, commission, or incentive program in addition to the base pay.

Employees will be eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan, a generous PTO policy, paid company holidays, and paid parental leave. Additional offerings include employee discounts on our products, professional development opportunities, and access to mental health and wellness programs

Who you are ?

title: Value Partner
description:
About Totango

At Totango, we’re on a mission to help businesses grow by investing in their customers. Totango’s Customer Growth Platform is centered around the entire customer journey by providing a single source of truth for insights, health monitoring, cross-functional collaboration, and workflow automations. Join us on our mission to help businesses thrive!

Who we are:

  • Bias for action.
    We don’t wait. We use good judgment, make decisions quickly, and keep things moving — even if that means learning by doing
  • Constructive dissent.
    We speak up and debate ideas with respect. Once a decision is made, we align and move forward as a team.
  • Assume Positive intent.
    We assume the best in each other. No politics, no blame — we are one team working toward a shared goal.
  • Clear communication.
    We don’t rely on guesswork. We’re specific with our words and always make sure decisions are clearly understood.
  • Work > meetings.
    Meetings help us get aligned, but the real work happens during focused time and with customers. We protect that time fiercely.
  • Nothing is sacred.
    We’re not tied to how things were done before. We adapt fast, iterate often, and build what’s right for what’s next.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Value Partner who wants to help redefine what Customer Success looks like in an AI-first world.

This is not a traditional CSM role. You won’t spend your time preparing standard business reviews, reporting surface-level adoption metrics, or sitting around waiting to be told how to solve problems.

Instead, you’ll own the customer journey from value definition through transformation, activation, and renewal. You’ll help customers connect their business priorities to measurable outcomes, guide them toward new AI-powered capabilities, work alongside technical teams to bring those capabilities to life, and own the commercial renewal of your book of business.

You’ll own a portfolio of approximately 20–30 customers, ranging from large, strategic organizations to mid-market customers. That range requires you to flex your approach — knowing where to go deep, where to create scale, and how to give each customer the level of partnership they need to achieve meaningful outcomes.

We’re building while we operate. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, energized by change, and excited to get your hands dirty when there isn’t yet a perfect process.

What You’ll Own

1. Turn Customer Goals Into Measurable Value

Value is the foundation of how we work with customers. Your job is to understand what customers are actually trying to accomplish — and ensure the work we do together moves the needle.

  • Establish clear business objectives and success measures, connecting customer goals directly to workflows and capabilities within our platform.
  • Build and maintain Value Level Agreements that define what success looks like and how we’ll measure progress together.
  • Quantify and communicate ROI and business impact throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Push beyond surface-level measures like consolidated data or a “customer 360” to answer the harder question: What changed for the business because of this?

2. Lead Customers Through Technology Transformation

Our technology is evolving quickly, with AI, automation, prescriptive guidance, intelligent workflows, and new ways of turning customer data into action at the center of that evolution.

You’ll help existing customers understand what’s possible, why it matters, and why evolving their technology can fundamentally change how they operate.

  • Build and communicate a compelling value story connecting new technology to the customer’s business priorities and outcomes.
  • Lead customer conversations around AI-powered, intelligent, automated, and prescriptive capabilities — translating innovation into practical use cases.
  • Navigate amendments and renewal conversations that move customers onto new technology.
  • Create urgency around transformation while maintaining customer trust and a relentless focus on long-term value.

3. Own Activation for Your Customers

Signing an amendment or renewal is only the beginning. You’ll remain accountable for ensuring customers successfully activate what they’ve purchased and begin realizing value quickly.

  • Anchor activation in the customer’s business objectives and Value Level Agreement, ensuring the work stays connected to the why behind the technology.
  • Coordinate across Customer Success Engineering, Front-End Deployment Engineering, Product, Engineering, and the customer to keep decisions and workstreams moving.
  • Identify risks and blockers early, bring the right people together, and actively drive them toward resolution.
  • Drive urgency and momentum throughout activation, with a relentless focus on speed to meaningful value.

You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious enough to understand what’s happening technically and confident enough to bring together the people who can solve it.

4. Own Renewals and Commercial Outcomes

You’ll own the renewal of your book of business, with commercial conversations becoming a natural extension of the value delivered throughout the year.

  • Own renewal strategy, forecasting, risk management, and commercial conversations for your portfolio.
  • Use renewal moments to connect demonstrated value with what comes next — including opportunities to move customers onto technology better suited to their future goals.

What We’re Looking For

You likely have 3–5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Customer Management, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role, but your mindset matters just as much as your title.

  • Documented success helping customers transition to a new platform, product, or technology.
  • A strong understanding of outcome-based Customer Success and the ability to connect technology to measurable business impact.
  • The curiosity and business acumen to uncover the real problem underneath the initial customer request.
  • Confidence communicating with executives, practitioners, and technical stakeholders — including the ability to walk into a customer conversation on day one, build credibility, and move it forward.
  • Strong project leadership skills and the ability to keep multiple teams and workstreams moving simultaneously.
  • Strong time and priority management. You’ll regularly have multiple customers, projects, renewals, and internal priorities competing for your attention, and you’ll need the judgment to determine what matters most right now and act accordingly.
  • The ability to operate with significant autonomy, make decisions without perfect information, and take action without waiting to be told what comes next. You’re comfortable when multiple priorities are shouting for your attention and can quickly determine which one actually needs you first.

You’ll Thrive Here If...

You’re a builder. You see an imperfect process and your instinct is to improve it, not wait for someone else to hand you the finished version.

You’re comfortable learning while operating. Things move quickly, priorities evolve, and sometimes the answer is something we’re figuring out together.

You’re deeply curious. You probably geek out on AI in your spare time, experiment with new tools, or regularly find yourself wondering, “Couldn’t we automate this?”

You’re willing to challenge what Customer Success has traditionally looked like. You believe customer value is about business outcomes — not another meeting, dashboard, or activity metric.

And you take ownership. When something is stuck, you find the person who can unblock it. When a customer needs direction, you provide it. When a process doesn’t exist yet, you help build it.

What’s In It for You

This is an opportunity to be part of a company actively redefining post-sales and what Customer Success can become in an AI-first world.

You’ll be surrounded by people building and experimenting with new technology almost daily. You’ll have the opportunity to influence how we work, challenge conventional CS thinking, and help shape practices that are still being invented.

You’ll also join a culture where we expect a lot from one another — and believe the best work happens when people can challenge each other constructively. Dissent is welcome, positive intent is assumed, and good ideas matter more than where they come from.

And because doing ambitious work shouldn’t mean sacrificing everything outside of it, we invest in creating space to recharge and think:

  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Health and dental benefits
  • 401(k) program for U.S. employees
  • Half-day Fridays
  • Focus Fridays designed to reduce future work — no customer or internal meetings, giving you dedicated space to build, improve, automate, and think ahead
  • Mental Health Fridays throughout the year
  • MacBook provided
  • The opportunity to work at the forefront of AI and Customer Success — and directly influence what comes next

If you’re looking for a highly prescribed environment where every process is already documented and every answer is known, this probably isn’t the role for you.

If you want to help build what comes next, we’d love to meet you.

Your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. The base salary for this role is from $95,000-$105,000 USD per year.

We take into account numerous factors in deciding on compensation, such as experience, job-related skills, relevant education or training, and other business and organizational requirements. The salary range provided corresponds to the level at which this position has been defined.

Totango is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that we do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected class. Diversity is more than just good intentions; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
At Summit, we build and operate the infrastructure behind some of the most critical applications in regulated industries. The work is complex, expectations are high, and the environments we support require precision and thoughtful execution.

We specialize in enterprise-class Application Hosting, Managed Services, and Cloud Solutions, with deep expertise in compliance, security, and performance. Our focus is simple: make the complex manageable and deliver technology that works - reliably, securely, and at scale.

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer who can bridge the gap between customer needs and technical execution. This role sits at the intersection of sales, engineering, and delivery, helping translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

You’ll partner closely with Sales and customers to understand challenges, design tailored solutions across infrastructure and platform services, and guide those solutions through the early stages of implementation. This is a role for someone who can think technically, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in outcomes.

It’s equal parts discovery, design, and alignment - with a strong focus on making complex things understandable and actionable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Gather customer requirements, respectfully challenge customer assumptions, and translate into best-practice Summit solution
  • Primary technical contact on assigned opportunities
  • Identify, qualify, design, develop, and present solutions based on business requirements and restrictions
  • Craft strategic and technical responses for presentations, proposals, SOWs, and other complex engagements
  • Develop and leverage key client relationships, including at the executive level, to earn trust and win business through a consultative selling approach
  • Alongside finance, build cost-engineering and profitability models for large customer opportunities
  • Remain current on industry standards and best practices related to our products and services
  • Consult with other Solution Engineers and internal resources on complex technical issues, or advanced designs
  • Identifies and handles common technical customer objections.
  • Working with Sales, proactively manage the opportunity pipeline to ensure each opportunity receives the required technical pre-sales support in a timely manner
  • Create supporting documentation and / or tools to facilitate and improve the sales process

What You’ll Deliver:

  • Listen to client problems / issues and work with Sales team to develop viable solutions to meet current and potential future needs
  • Ensure solutions are accurately and completely scoped for our implementation team to deliver services.
  • Demonstrate technical leadership and subject matter expertise on solutions and services
  • Engage and represent the company through public speaking opportunities to customers, prospects, conferences, and industry forums
  • Participate with other Solution Engineers in regular technical training along with the Sales team

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:

  • Requires 4+ years working experience, minimum 2+ years in technical role, ideally supporting B2B IT or IT consulting sales
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills; ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Customer-facing sales experience
  • Professional qualification or a degree in a technical discipline
  • Ability to create and run customer-facing presentations
  • Experience with common tools (Salesforce, Showpad, ERP, Office, etc)
  • 2+ years in ISP / Data Center / Managed Services or related industries providing technical sales support OR at an AWS or Azure Cloud Service Provider or related practice providing technical sales support
  • An excellent candidate will be able to demonstrate mastery of the following subjects: System administration on both Linux and Windows AND Familiarity with Backup and Disaster Recovery solutions provided by using hyperscale cloud services
  • Working knowledge with virtualization technologies: VMware, Hyper-V, Xen, or KVM
  • Industry certifications desirable: Linux+, RHCSA, RHCE, MCSE, MCSA, MCITP, CCNA, OpenStack, Cloud Savvy

How We Work at Summit:

How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit, our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers.

We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously - and have fun doing it.

Our core values:

  • Empower our people
  • Constant elevation
  • Customer first
  • Focus on outcomes
  • Embrace curiosity

Benefits: Summit offers a total rewards package designed to support you at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Here’s a look at what’s included:

  • Flexible Time Off (yes, really) – take what you need, we trust you to manage it
  • Medical, Dental & Vision – comprehensive coverage with HSA/HRA options
  • 401(k) with 4% match – we invest alongside you
  • Parental Leave – paid time for the moments that matter most
  • Life & Disability Insurance – built-in peace of mind
  • Wellness Support – resources for your mental and physical health
  • Free Colocation & Cloud Access – build and experiment in real environments
  • Work From Anywhere – remote-friendly by design
  • A low-ego, get-it-done culture – come as you are, do great work

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is 125 - 145K annually. Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location. We aim to make offers that are fair, forward-looking, and aligned to both what you bring and where you’re growing.

Internal candidates may see variations based on current role, compensation, and progression at Summit. Same thoughtful approach, just with additional context.

Summit is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Summit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Arena:

Arena is a startup created in Silicon Valley with a mission to build communities for creators, publishers and brands with the power of AI. Companies using Arena include Disney, Reuters, Fox, Red Bull and NFL. We have +2,000 customers in 150 countries and with +50M users having conversations on Arena per month and engaging with our AI tools.

We are a Series A company backed by top-tier investors such as CRV, Redpoint and Craft Ventures. Arena offers a unique work environment and the chance to collaborate with diverse teammates across multiple countries, with a culture of ownership (autonomy, growth, and specially high performance).

Sometimes you're stuck in a job that doesn't make sense. Managing tasks and infinite backlogs, not talking to customers and miles away from making product decisions. If you love a good challenge, you're a curious product guy who experiments with AI and AI agents every day, and you want to be a part of one of the fastest-growing AI startups in Silicon Valley — then Arena is the company you're looking for.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a QA Engineer who’s passionate about technology, curious about how things work, and eager to ensure quality across our products. You’ll join a supportive, fast-paced environment and collaborate with experienced engineers to test web applications, APIs, and new features as they’re developed.

This is a great opportunity to grow in a company that values mentorship, ownership, and continuous learning.


What you will be doing:

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to understand requirements and define test strategies.
  • Write and maintain **manual and automated test cases** for web applications and APIs.
  • Run exploratory and regression tests for new features and releases.
  • Help monitor issues in production and identify patterns for improvement.
  • Contribute to maintaining and expanding our automated test suite using Cypress and Jest.

The challenges:

  • Real-time messaging to support 100,000 concurrent users per customer application;
  • High performance: our API responses are in the 10ms range;
  • High scalability: we use sharding, master-master, and master-slave to ensure scalability;
  • High availability: our code is running on homepages of the most visited websites and apps in the internet;
  • Distributed databases for our Data Platform storing every user engagement.

You Might Be a Fit If You Have:

  • Some experience (6–18 months) in QA or testing software
  • Familiarity with tools like Cypress, Jest, or Selenium.
  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Understanding of REST APIs and how to test them.
  • Enthusiasm to learn, ask questions, and work in a collaborative environment.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).

Nice-to-Have Experience:

  • Experience with HTML/CSS and browser dev tools.
  • Exposure to mobile testing (iOS or Android).
  • Understanding of how CI/CD and deployment pipelines work.
  • Curiosity about how distributed systems scale.

Example Projects You’ll Be Working on:

  • Build automated test suites and test cases for web apps, mobile apps, and APIs;
  • Build early warning systems that detect production environment errors;
  • Certify production releases;
  • Manual testing, where necessary – we prefer automated tests!
  • Continuously improve and maintain quality standards;
  • Analyze error patterns to identify repeating types of issues;
  • Monitor error and debug sources for production issues.

We also have some sweet perks like:

🔥 Be a part of the team in Silicon Valley and join a global team

💪 A team of exceptional engineers leading the cutting-edge AI Agents.

💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

⛱️ 4 weeks of paid time-off

📖 Learning and Development budget

🚀 Key moment to join Arena in terms of growth and opportunities

💻 Ability to put your stamp on real-world AI applications that serve millions of users.

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 Multiple nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Arena

title: TPM: Operational Targeting Products
description:
About Reveal Technology
Founded in 2019, Reveal is a dynamic startup revolutionizing field operations by delivering software tools and intelligence to operators in remote, disconnected, and extreme environments. Reveal is the Digital Arms Room for the Modern Warrior — providing the tactical intelligence and automation platform for physical, human, and digital terrain at the edge.
Our flagship products include Farsight, a 3D processing and mission planning platform that transforms complex terrain into operational advantage, and Identifi, a secure identity verification solution designed for rapid, trusted identification in dynamic environments. In 2026, Reveal expanded its software portfolio to include Chronos and Anomaly 6, further strengthening its capabilities across the modern battlefield.
Reveal exists to serve defense, security, and public safety missions where time is compressed, information is contested, and precision matters. We are scaling our team and technology to meet the accelerating demands of modern warfare and national security.

About the Role

As Technical Program Manager for Agile Targeting, you will own execution of this campaign end to end — translating Geospatial BU strategy and customer commitments into a sequenced delivery plan for a dedicated engineering pod, and keeping that plan on track day to day. You'll run point on schedule, scope, and risk, partnering closely with the engine, client, cloud, and QA teams that support your campaign alongside their platform-wide commitments. This is a delivery-ownership role: you are accountable for whether Agile Targeting ships on time and at quality, not for setting the campaign's strategic direction.

Responsibilities

Campaign & Delivery Execution
  • Own the Agile Targeting delivery plan, aligning work with customer commitments and BU priorities.
  • Lead sprint and release planning and manage tradeoffs across scope, schedule, and quality.
  • Own backlog prioritization and grooming, translating operator and field feedback into clearly scoped engineering work.
  • Track cross-team dependencies across engine, client, cloud, and QA teams and escalate risks early.
  • Maintain campaign risk, readiness, and delivery status and communicate changes to BU leadership.
  • Establish clear definitions of done and drive release quality, regression discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Track campaign KPIs and post-release outcomes to inform future planning and prioritization.
Customer & Mission Engagement
  • Support discovery with public safety, DoW, SOCOM, and coalition targeting operators and translate needs into actionable product requirements.
  • Support customer demos, proposals, capture efforts, and executive briefings related to targeting-cycle capabilities.
  • Ensure customer and field feedback is quickly incorporated into product and delivery planning.
Engineering & Technical Partnership
  • Partner with engineering leads on architecture, sensor and data integrations, and technical debt tradeoffs for targeting workflows.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and make informed product and delivery tradeoffs with engineering.
  • Identify opportunities to reuse capabilities across Agile Targeting and other Geospatial campaigns.
Business & BU Support
  • Keep BU leadership informed on execution readiness, delivery risk, dependencies, and roadmap tradeoffs.
  • Partner across Product, Engineering, BD, and Program teams to align campaign execution with business priorities.
  • Ensure targeting-cycle capabilities meet applicable security, regulatory, and government contracting requirements.

Requirements

  • Travel ~30%
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of technical program management, product management, or similar experience.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Athos Commerce enables ecommerce and digital marketing teams greater control over how their products are found, merchandised, and sold—on-site and across all digital marketing channels.

Our tools span AI-powered search, personalized recommendations, smart merchandising, optimized product data syndication, A/B Testing and marketplace/social commerce performance.

We help brands grow with sharper visibility, higher conversion, and less friction. Backed by PSG Equity and supported by a global team across North America, Europe, and APAC, we are building practical, powerful tools for the next era of commerce. Athos Commerce unites shopper intent and product visibility across every touchpoint.

Who You Are

  • You are a senior QA professional who takes ownership of quality and is comfortable working independently.
  • You are analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to break complex requirements into clear and effective test scenarios.
  • You are technically curious and enjoy investigating issues across applications, APIs, databases, logs, and cloud environments.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with Development, Product, and QA teams.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and sharing knowledge to improve team capability.
  • You are pragmatic, adaptable, and focused on delivering high-quality outcomes in an Agile environment.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior QA Engineer, you will take ownership of Quality Assurance within one of our dedicated implementation teams. You will work closely with Development, Product, and QA teams to ensure comprehensive quality coverage throughout the software delivery lifecycle. This is a hands-on role combining manual testing, automation, API testing, technical investigation, and release support. You will also provide technical guidance and mentorship to other QA Engineers while helping continuously improve our testing practices and product quality.

How You Will Succeed

  • Own QA execution for your implementation team, ensuring comprehensive testing and high-quality product releases.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and improve UI automation using C#, Selenium, and xUnit.
  • Perform API testing using Postman and Newman, ensuring reliable integration and service-level coverage.
  • Conduct manual, functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing across web applications, microservices, databases, and Azure/Microsoft Function Apps.
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and other Agile ceremonies to identify risks and improve testability early in the development lifecycle.
  • Investigate complex defects and production issues using SQL, application logs, browser developer tools, and other diagnostic techniques.
  • Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, regression suites, and QA documentation in Azure DevOps.
  • Support deployment and release activities, including pre-release regression and post-release validation.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to QA Engineers within the team.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve QA processes, automation coverage, testing efficiency, and overall product quality.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in software testing/QA, with strong experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience in test automation, including designing and maintaining automation frameworks.
  • Advanced or strong working knowledge of C#, with experience writing automated tests.
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium and xUnit or similar automation/testing frameworks.
  • Experience with API testing, preferably using Postman and Newman.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL/MSSQL for data validation and defect investigation.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, including Boards, test management, defect tracking, and QA documentation.
  • Good understanding of Git and version-control practices.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure or other cloud technologies.
  • Understanding of DOM structure, browser developer tools, and web application testing.
  • Experience with scripting, preferably PowerShell.
  • Ability to read and debug application logs and investigate complex technical issues.
  • Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.
  • Understanding of black-box and white-box testing techniques, web testing heuristics, and test case design.
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies and exposure to TDD/shift-left testing practices.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to work UK business hours.
  • Experience in e-commerce, SaaS, marketing technology, or high-volume data platforms is highly desirable.
  • Degree, diploma, apprenticeship, or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with Visio, Lucidchart, or similar workflow/diagramming tools is an advantage.

Benefits and Company Perks

  • 24 PTOs in a calendar year
  • Company-paid Health Insurance
  • Company-paid Short Term and Long Term Disability coverage
  • Company-paid Accidental Insurance
  • Company-paid Learning & Development (L&D) programmes
  • Flexible work environment – work from home, office, or hybrid
  • Collaborative and innovation-driven work culture
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI-powered ecommerce technology

- survey

title: Senior Advisor, Clinical AI & Technology Program Execution - Cigna Healthcare -
description:
Job Summary

As a part of the enterprise clinical organization and the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, the Sr. Advisor, Clinical AI and Technology Program Execution will manage the portfolio and program management processes that move clinical AI and technology opportunities from intake through prioritization, decision-making, execution oversight, measurement, and learning. This role is responsible for ensuring visibility across the clinical AI and technology portfolio, tracking progress against cross-enterprise goals, monitoring dependencies and risks, and ensuring owners are aligned on tasks, timelines, and risk management while stakeholders are engaged in required toll gates and approvals.

The ideal candidate will bring strong portfolio discipline, enterprise program management experience, executive communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed healthcare environment. This position partners closely with clinical AI and technology leaders and works across business and clinical stakeholders, along with enterprise functions, including technology, data and analytics, and finance teams to connect parallel planning and execution efforts into one integrated view of progress, dependencies, risks, decisions, and actions aligned to enterprise goals. This role reports to the Principal, Enterprise Clinical Programs – Technology + AI Strategic Initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Execute the clinical AI and technology portfolio management process across intake, prioritization, decision readiness, execution oversight, value measurement, and ongoing portfolio learning.
  • Create and maintain a transparent enterprise view of clinical AI and technology opportunities, including business-generated and clinical AI-generated ideas, portfolio stage, sponsors, owners, clinical problem statements, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and next actions.
  • Ensure leaders have clear visibility to portfolio and program progress, cross-enterprise goals, key milestones, critical dependencies, risks, issues, decisions needed, and actions required to keep work moving forward.
  • Partner with clinical AI strategy, clinical design and delivery, business stakeholders, product, technology, data and analytics, finance, and vendor partners to align initiatives to enterprise priorities and clinical value opportunities.
  • Coordinate the translation of approved clinical AI and technology strategies and leadership decisions into actionable plans, integrated timelines, ownership models, readiness checkpoints, and execution tracking.
  • Support problem-first opportunity development by organizing inputs related to clinical need, member and provider experience, data availability, workflow impact, technology fit, operational feasibility, value hypothesis, and measurement approach.
  • Prepare governance and leadership materials that enable clear decisions, including portfolio updates, prioritization summaries, decision briefs, risk and dependency views, value measurement summaries, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Document and track leadership decisions, open issues, assumptions, accountable owners, due dates, and follow-up actions to support disciplined execution, timely follow-through, and alignment on tasks, timelines, and risk mitigation.
  • Coordinate stakeholder participation in required toll gates, approvals, readiness reviews, and decision forums to ensure the right contributors are engaged at the right time.
  • Monitor cross-functional dependencies across business, clinical, product, technology, analytics, compliance, finance, implementation, and vendor workstreams; escalate material risks, timing concerns, or sequencing conflicts as appropriate.
  • Coordinate with clinical design and delivery partners to ensure clinical workflow, clinical excellence, safety, adoption, implementation readiness, and measurement considerations are visible within the broader execution plan.
  • Apply approved portfolio criteria, investment logic, governance requirements, and value-realization practices to support consistent decision-making and portfolio discipline.
  • Improve templates, processes, artifacts, forums, reporting routines, and systems of record that increase clarity, repeatability, speed, and accountability across the clinical AI and technology portfolio.
  • Develop concise executive communications that synthesize complex, cross-functional work into clear progress updates, risks, tradeoffs, decisions needed, and value-oriented recommendations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certification preferred.
  • Significant experience 5+ years in portfolio management, program management, PMO leadership, strategy execution, transformation, or complex enterprise initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple interdependent workstreams in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Experience with portfolio governance, integrated planning, executive reporting, dependency management, risk escalation, and decision tracking.
  • Strong facilitation, synthesis, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to translate established strategy and leadership decisions into coordinated plans, milestones, ownership, and execution visibility.
  • Comfort operating through ambiguity while maintaining disciplined processes and transparent follow-through.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, actionable insights for executive and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare, payer, clinical, digital health, data, analytics, or artificial intelligence experience.
  • Experience in regulated or clinically sensitive environments.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, clinical governance, value realization, or measurement planning.
  • Portfolio, program, project, agile, change-management, or process-improvement credentials.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

title: Creative Production Specialist (Part-time)
description:
Location: Remote (AU or NZ time zones)

Type: Part-time (8 hours per week - either 1x full day or 2x half days per week)

Salary: USD $3,000 per month which is approximately AUD $50,000 per annum at current exchange rates. (Compensation is paid in USD, the AUD equivalent is provided here for reference only and may fluctuate based on exchange rates).

Start: September 2026

Want to raise the bar on performance creative?

At Right Hook, we make ads that stop the scroll, earn the click, and make our clients money.

Right Hook Digital is a performance growth team helping eCommerce founders and DTC brands scale. Our creative machine is built around one thing: producing high-performing ads at volume without letting quality fall through the floor.

We’re a performance growth team helping eCommerce founders and DTC brands scale. Our creative function is grounded one thing: produce high-performing ad creative at volume to scale our clients. And we’re looking for a Creative Production Specialist to help us do exactly that.

About the Role

The Creative Production Specialist will help us raise and embed the creative execution standard across our entire creative function.

This is a role for someone who can look at an ad and immediately see: Why does this work? Why doesn’t this work? And how do I teach someone else to see the difference?

You’ll work directly with our Head of Creative Strategy to raise the creative execution standard across our team, through training, creative audits, playbooks, frameworks and AI-enabled production workflows.

You won’t be managing a team or sitting in operational meetings, your job is to make the team better at producing great work without needing you in the room. In other words, building the capability and systems that make high-performing creative repeatable.

What you’ll do

You’ll work across our team of creatives (visual creators and creative strategists), helping each drive quality of creative craft.

1. Raise the creative execution standard:

We already have a documented benchmark for what high-converting creative looks like, you’ll help make it sharper.

You’ll identify where our current work falls short, understand why, and turn those insights into clearer standards, examples, frameworks and training that the team can actually use.

2. Build creative capability:

You know what separates average creative from high-performing creative, more importantly, you know how to teach it.

You’ll identify recurring skill and quality gaps across graphic design, video, creative execution and performance thinking, then build training programmes that actually change how people work.

That includes but is not limited to:

  • Live training sessions
  • Creative workshops
  • Creative audits and reviews
  • Playbooks and frameworks
  • Example libraries and benchmarks
  • Feedback systems
  • Ongoing capability programmes

We’re not looking for one-off training that everyone forgets two weeks later, we want to build capability that sticks.

3. Develop creative judgement:

A big part of this role is helping our Creative Strategists develop stronger creative judgement.

You’ll help the team learn to:

  • Recognise what is and isn’t working
  • Give specific, useful creative feedback
  • Diagnose problems rather than simply point them out
  • Improve the next piece of creative, not just fix the current one
  • Understand when an execution problem is actually a briefing or strategy problem
  • Make better creative decisions independently

The end goal is for the team to develop the judgement to make better calls themselves.

4. Push AI-enabled production forward:

AI is becoming a bigger part of how performance creative gets made, and we want to use it properly because it can help us move faster, produce more, and expand what’s possible.

You’ll help us in two ways:

  • Accelerate what already works: Use AI to take existing, proven creative and make production faster and more scalable without lowering the bar.
  • Build what’s possible next: Help the team build end-to-end AI production workflows using things like: AI-generated video, images, voiceovers and UGC, automated production workflows, and connected tools that turn an idea into a finished ad

*You don’t need to be an expert in every AI tool, we care much more about whether you can think in workflows, understand how tools fit together, and teach other people how to use them effectively.

What this role is not

This is not a management role, you will not be required to:

  • Manage the designers, editors or creative strategists
  • Run performance or operational meetings
  • Own team capacity
  • Handle team complaints or people issues
  • Become the escalation point for day-to-day team problems

What your 8 hours per week will look like

Your time will be spread across the week and typically include:

  • Live training with Visual Creators and/or Creative Strategists
  • Creative audits for quality reviews and training implementation
  • Training preparation
  • Building on and evolving playbooks
  • AI workflow development and training
  • Regular working sessions with the Head of Creative Strategy

The mix of focus will change depending on what the team needs. Some weeks will be heavier on live training, other weeks will focus on audits, building training programmes, developing AI workflows, and working with the Head of Creative Strategy to evolve the creative machine.

The first 30 days will naturally be more hands-on as we establish the execution standard and get the first training programmes moving.

We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. If the standard is rising, the team is getting better, and the output is getting stronger then you’re succeeding.

What you need to bring to this role

1. 3+ years of performance creative experience: Specifically direct-response advertising for paid social platforms such as Meta and TikTok. You’ve produced performance creative at scale and understand the realities of working across volume, testing, and performance. You understand what makes an ad convert, not just what makes an ad look good.

2. You know how to make other people better - critical to this role:

  • You have demonstrated experience training, mentoring or upskilling creative teams. You understand the difference between telling someone what to do and actually changing how they work.
  • You know how to turn expertise into training, playbooks, frameworks, systems, and documentation that the team can apply independently.

3. Comfortable with AI: You have experience with AI image generation, video generation and voiceover tools. We’re less interested in your list of tools than your ability to think in workflows.

4. Can work across AU + US time zones: Occasional overlap will be required for live training sessions approximately 4-5pm AEST.

5. You have the basics: Reliable high-speed WiFi, your own laptop and a functional workspace setup.

Why Right Hook?

You’ll be joining a team that takes performance creative seriously.

We’re actively building how creative strategy, production, training and AI work together inside a performance agency.

You’ll work directly with our Head of Creative Strategy and have genuine influence over how our creative function develops.

If you’re the kind of person who gets frustrated watching good creative teams produce mediocre work because they lack the right systems, standards or training, you’ll probably enjoy this role. And if you’re excited about where performance creative and AI-enabled production are heading, there’s plenty here to build.

Keen to apply?

1. Upload your resume (no cover letter)

2. Answer these questions:

  • Are you currently based in the Australia or New Zealand?
  • How many years of direct response/performance creative experience do you have, and which paid social platforms have you worked across?
  • Tell us briefly about the performance creative work you’ve done. What types of brands, creative formats and production volumes have you worked with?
  • What AI tools have you personally used in creative production, and what have you actually produced using these tools?

Strong analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem-solving, presentation, budgeting, project management (from conception to completion), & planning skills.

Strong interpersonal skills including strengths in working in a team environment with a client/user orientation.

Ability to work effectively with multi-disciplinary teams with different lines of reporting.

Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas and processes in simple terminology to internal and external stakeholders, including all levels of management.

Demonstrated attention to detail and maintenance of high quality standards.

Demonstrated ability to work independently, meeting deadlines under pressure, with minimal supervision and frequent interruptions.

Works effectively under time pressure to meet deadlines, balance work priorities and resolve problems in a timely manner.

Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

Hvem er du?

I vores Plan and Order Point i Kolding, sælger vi et bredt udvalg af IKEAs sortiment, med fokus på køkkener, garderobe og bad. Vi leder efter en energisk kollega med passion for kundeservice og boligindretning, der kan supplere vores Køkkenkonsulenter, som tegner køkkener, garderobe og bad for vores kunder.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver er at:

  • Hjælpe til med vareudlevering
  • Håndtere almindelig butiksdrift og forefaldende opgaver såsom rengøring
  • Sørge for at butikken altid er præsentabel og inspirerende.

Hvad du skal lave – dag for dag

Ligesom os, brænder du for at skabe fantastiske kundeoplevelser. Du er god til at se muligheder, tilbyde inspiration, og du giver dine kunder en grundig vejledning, der tilsikrer at alle deres behov bliver mødt.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på at du:

  • Taler dansk og gerne også engelsk og/eller tysk
  • Er serviceorienteret og får energi at af tale med mange mennesker hver dag
  • Trives med et job, hvor man primært er på fødderne og bruger kroppen
  • Er ansvarsbevidst og selvstændigt kan prioritere opgaver.

Sammen som et team

We are the ones meeting our customers – in our stores, online, in our catalogue and beyond. We have knowledge of the IKEA product range, local markets and customer needs and we constantly find new ways of making real connections with our customers to maximize sales and profitability. Together with thousands of colleagues around the world we’re a diverse team working for the continued global success of the IKEA Concept – a concept that helps millions of customers create a better everyday life!

Har du spørgsmål eller brug for hjælp? Lad os tale med hinanden!

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder Andreas Møller på andreas.moller@ingka.ikea.com ved spørgsmål.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi udelukkende modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem og ikke via e-mail.

Øvrig informationer

  • Stillingen er på 8-15 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit efter reglerne for fleksibel deltid, beskrevet i HK Handels overenskomst. Dette betyder, at man er garanteret 8 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit og at arbejdstiden ikke kan overstige 15 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit. Vær opmærksom på om du opfylder betingelserne for at blive ansat på fleksibel deltid (som udgangspunkt skal man være studerende, pensionist eller have et job med væsentligt flere timer ved siden af)
  • Din arbejdstid placeres primært indenfor åbningstiden, og du skal forvente at have 1-2 lukkevagter pr. uge samt arbejde hver 2. weekend, både lørdag og søndag. Det er muligt for dig at komme med input til arbejdsplanen
  • Løn efter HK’s butiksoverenskomst, herunder pension- og fritvalgsordning samt forskudttidstillæg
  • Vi har diverse personalegoder som helbredsforsikring, personalerabat, rabatordninger med samarbejdspartnere, årsgave osv.
  • Der kan i ansættelsesprocessen blive stillet krav om fremvisning af straffeattest
  • Ønsket opstart efter aftale
  • OBS: Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og forbeholder os retten til at lukke jobopslaget, når vi har modtaget tilstrækkeligt med relevante kandidater.

Ligesom vores hjem er vores talenter også mangfoldige, og i IKEA har vi en passion for rigtige mennesker. Ved jobsøgning er der nogle der kan miste modet, hvis de ikke opfylder alle kompetencer, men du er meget velkommen til stadig at ansøge. Vi vil gerne lære dig at kende og mulighederne er mange i IKEA, baseret på interesse, evner og erfaring - uanset om du er ung, senior eller derimellem. Vi håber, at du vil være med på rejsen og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, quality assurance, and operations to deliver innovative features and enhancements.   • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working in a distributed team environment.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong personal portfolio of software projects.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software applications and services.
  • Lead technical design discussions and code reviews to ensure best practices and high code quality.
  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, providing technical leadership and support.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing software to improve performance and reliability.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to recommend improvements and innovations.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and tools.

Skills

The required skills enable the Senior Software Developer to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code that meets business requirements and technical standards. Proficiency in multiple programming languages allows the developer to select the best tools for each project and adapt to evolving technology stacks. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills are essential for identifying issues and implementing effective solutions quickly. Familiarity with agile methodologies and version control supports seamless collaboration and iterative development within cross-functional teams. Preferred skills such as cloud platform experience and DevOps knowledge enhance the developer’s ability to deploy and manage applications in modern, scalable environments, ensuring reliability and performance.

Det er din fornemmeste opgave at rådgive vores kunder hele vejen gennem deres køb og sikre, at de kommer hjem med den helt rette løsning til deres behov. Vores hovedfokus er at opfylde kundernes boligdrømme. Jobbet som Køkkenkonsulent er en alsidig stilling - du vil både arbejde med salg og rådgivning, besvare kundespørgsmål, deltage i planlægningsmøder samt håndtere udlevering af varer og reklamationer. Derudover bidrager du til den daglige drift og sikrer sammen med dine kolleger, at afdelingen altid fremstår indbydende og inspirerende.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver er derfor at:

  • Tegne køkkener, garderober og badeværelsesløsninger i vores tegneprogram
  • Sælge hvidevarer og andet tilbehør til køkkenet
  • Besvare kundespørgsmål og yde professionel rådgivning før, under og efter købet
  • Håndtere og udlevere varer samt behandle reklamationer på en professionel og løsningsorienteret måde
  • Arbejde målrettet for at nå afdelingens salgsbudget
  • Bidrage til den daglige drift og forefaldende opgaver, herunder rengøring, oprydning og vedligeholdelse af butikkens udstillinger, så afdelingen altid fremstår præsentabel og inspirerende.

Sammen som et team

IKEA Plan and Order Point er placeret på Østre Gjesingvej 9 i Esbjerg. Du bliver en del af et team på 9 af både fuldtids- og deltidsmedarbejdere, som alle har et stort fokus på salg og service, for at skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser for vores kunder. Vi sørger for den rette træning, så du kan føle dig tryg og kompetent i jobbet. Ønsker du, at blive en del af IKEA Plan and Order Point Esbjerg, og er klar på det møde alle vores sydvestjyske kunder – så søg allerede i dag.

Har du spørgsmål eller brug for hjælp? Lad os tale med hinanden!

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Market Sales Manager Jonas Jensen på jonas.jensen4@ingka.ikea.com ved spørgsmål. Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi udelukkende modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem og ikke via e-mail.

Øvrige informationer

  • Den ledige stilling kan være på enten 30, 32 eller 37 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit
  • Din arbejdstid placeres primært indenfor åbningstiden, og du skal forvente at have 1-2 lukkevagter pr. uge samt arbejde hver 2. weekend, både lørdag og søndag. Det er muligt for dig at komme med input til arbejdsplanen
  • Løn efter HK’s butiksoverenskomst, herunder pension- og fritvalgsordning samt forskudttidstillæg
  • Vi har diverse personalegoder som helbredsforsikring, personalerabat, rabatordninger med samarbejdspartnere, årsgave osv.
  • Der kan i ansættelsesprocessen blive stillet krav om fremvisning af straffeattest
  • Ønsket opstart snarest muligt eller efter aftale
  • OBS: Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og forbeholder os retten til at lukke jobopslaget, når vi har modtaget tilstrækkeligt med relevante kandidater.

Ligesom vores hjem er vores talenter også mangfoldige, og i IKEA har vi en passion for rigtige mennesker. Ved jobsøgning er der nogle der kan miste modet, hvis de ikke opfylder alle kompetencer, men du er meget velkommen til stadig at ansøge. Vi vil gerne lære dig at kende og mulighederne er mange i IKEA, baseret på interesse, evner og erfaring - uanset om du er ung, senior eller derimellem. Vi håber, at du vil være med på rejsen og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

description:
Run Stronger. Evolve Faster. Perform Smarter with NRI

It provides the chance to combine deep technical problem-solving with practical engineering, supporting business-critical pipelines, improving service reliability, and helping shape better support processes, monitoring, and governance. For someone who enjoys both hands-on data engineering and service ownership, it is an opportunity to become the trusted expert who keeps data flowing, reduces operational risk, and contributes directly to better outcomes for clients and internal teams.

What You'll Do:

Service Operations

  • Monitor platform availability, warehouse utilisation, job execution, pipeline performance, and data quality controls to identify and address issues proactively before service impact occurs.

  • Perform detailed root cause analysis for recurring, complex, or high-impact incidents, and implement permanent fixes to improve service stability and reduce repeat failures.
  • Participate in on-call, escalation, and major incident support processes where required, ensuring timely communication, impact assessment, and restoration of service.

Platform Support and Enhancement

  • Develop, maintain, and support SQL-based transformations, stored logic, pipeline fixes, and minor enhancements required to meet operational and business needs.

  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency across Snowflake workloads, query execution, and supporting data processes.
  • Contribute to automation of support activities, including monitoring, alerting, remediation tasks, housekeeping, and repeatable operational procedures.

Security and Governance

  • Apply security, access control, governance, and audit requirements in the day-to-day support and operation of Snowflake environments.
  • Support the administration of role-based access controls, least-privilege access, and controlled segregation of duties across client environments.

  • Ensure operational activities comply with client, contractual, and organisational standards for auditability, traceability, and change control.
  • Contribute to security incident response, investigation, and recovery activities by using audit history, usage data, and operational logs to identify issues and support remediation.

Stakeholder and Service Management

  • Work closely with client stakeholders, internal service teams, and delivery teams to prioritise incidents, defects, enhancements, risks, and service improvement opportunities.

Documentation and Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of support standards, monitoring baselines, and operating procedures for Snowflake-managed services.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong hands-on experience supporting Snowflake data platforms, including troubleshooting pipelines, transformations, integrations, and downstream data issues.
  • Advanced SQL capability, with the ability to develop, refine, and support data transformations and operational fixes efficiently.
  • Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, including ingestion, orchestration, data quality, performance tuning, and platform dependencies.
  • Proven incident and problem management skills, with the ability to investigate root causes, implement permanent fixes, and prevent repeat failures.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake security and governance, including access control, least-privilege principles, auditability, and controlled data access.
  • Experience supporting releases and changes in a managed services or operational support environment, with disciplined use of change processes.
  • Strong monitoring and analytical skills, with the ability to detect service degradation, trend recurring issues, and act proactively.
  • Clear stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to prioritise work, manage expectations, and explain technical issues in plain language.
  • Well-developed documentation and knowledge management habits, including runbooks, support notes, known errors, and operational procedures.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify automation opportunities, improve supportability, and enhance service reliability over time.

Why Join Us:

  • Work with cutting-edge tools and AI-enabled platforms.

NRI Australia & New Zealand is committed to building a culturally diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages applications regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Utilization Management Coordinator
description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Utilization Management Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting Clinical Operations by managing the intake, prior authorization, and clinical coordination workflows. This role ensures timely case intake, accurate authorization set-up, and effective coordination with members, providers, and internal clinical teams to support care transitions and authorization processes. The coordinator will be an important part of building strong relationships with health care providers through proactive communication, managing key operational processes to enable efficient, high-quality clinical decisions. This is a fast-paced environment that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and a natural talent for customer service. We often require management of several tasks at once, so enthusiasm and organization are key.

Utilization Management is a heavily regulated space, so you’ll work through unexpected situations and evolving guidance — including periodic CMS audits where the whole team pitches in on research and root cause.

Schedule:

This is a full-time, remote position working five 8-hour days per week. Shifts are scheduled between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM ET, with staggered schedules across the team to ensure seven-day coverage. We are hiring for:

  • Monday – Friday

  • Tuesday – Saturday

  • Sunday – Thursday

Your specific start time is assigned within the 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM ET window. We’ll ask about your schedule preference during the process and will do our best to match it. Because we’re filling a limited number of openings on each schedule, availability changes as roles are filled — so we ask that candidates be open to more than one schedule where possible.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

Intake Management

  • Monitor intake queues, including daily census validation checks

  • Manage inbound and outbound correspondence

  • Ensure referrals and cases are accurately entered into our system or re-routed to delegates as applicable

Prior Authorization Support

  • Perform authorization set-up and case creation in our systems

  • Manage and resolve authorization-related inquiries across multiple case types

  • Review member inpatient status and clinical documentation to support episode updates

  • Ensure required documentation is present for clinical review and determination, including request for information (RFI) work and electronic health record (EHR) access

Clinical Coordination & Communication

  • Conduct outbound calls to members and providers to obtain clinical information and communicate UM decisions

  • Schedule and coordinate peer-to-peer (P2P) reviews between providers and Medical Directors

  • Manage Medical Director case assignments and tracking

  • Retrieve medical records via hospital EHR portals and external systems

  • Support the clinical team with case coordination and documentation needs

Post-Discharge & Transitional Care Coordination

  • Contact inpatient and post-acute facilities to confirm admission and discharge details

  • Complete daily census checks and assist with discharge planning coordination activities

  • Support care transition workflows and case follow-up

Operational & Reporting Support

  • Download and review operational reports (e.g., Looker, Snowflake)

  • Support RFIs and case tracking in inpatient and UM tools

  • Maintain accurate case status and documentation in our system

  • Provide operational and administrative support to the assigned team and manager

Required skills and experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Experience in healthcare operations, utilization management, care coordination, or prior authorization

  • Proficiency with healthcare systems, EHRs, and reporting tools

  • Effective communication skills with providers and members

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills in a high-volume environment

  • Attention to detail, follow-through, and time management in a frequently changing environment

Desired skills and experience:

  • Prior experience in Medicare Advantage or managed care

  • Intake, authorization, or clinical coordination experience

  • Familiarity with UM or case management workflows

  • 1–3 years of administrative or medical office experience

  • Proficiency with Google Sheets and the Google Workspace suite

  • Bilingual



Salary Range: $21.70 - $27.00/ hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.
