title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high-growth, high-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.

At Kaseya, success comes from embracing challenges, moving with urgency, and continuously raising the bar.

Position Summary:

  • Kaseya is looking for a Platform Backend Engineer to build and operate the core platform services powering Fleet, connecting the execution runtime, identity layer, event routing, secret management, and audit infrastructure. This role focuses on high-reliability backend and platform engineering, where correctness, security, scalability, and operational clarity are critical.
  • Build and operate the platform services that underpin Fleet: API gateway, Kafka-based event routing (PSA webhooks and RMM alerts → Temporal workflow triggers), Zitadel integration for machine identity and capability grant management, and ClickHouse-backed immutable audit ledger writes
  • Implement the Secret Management and KMS abstraction layer: pluggable KEK backends (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, BYOK), envelope encryption via AWS Encryption SDK, per-client cryptographic isolation
  • Build the capability grant enforcement pipeline: per-workflow, per-client, per-operation grants issued by Zitadel and validated by the sidecar Identity and Capability Engine on every inbound request
  • Own the GitOps-based automation catalog deployment pipeline: workflow definitions versioned in Git, deployed to per-client Temporal namespaces via CI/CD
  • Build operational tooling for MSP onboarding: Zitadel org provisioning, compliance tier configuration per client org, and per-client KMS setup
  • Contribute to the Safe Connector Layer: vendor API wrapper services (ConnectWise, NinjaOne, M365/CIPP, Datto, IT Glue, CrowdStrike, Huntress) that enforce scope, inject platform-managed credentials, and log every call before execution.

Required Qualification:

  • Strong backend engineering in Go or Rust; we are moving away from Java-heavy backgrounds for new platform work
  • Experience building event-driven systems: Kafka, event sourcing patterns, at-least-once delivery guarantees
  • Familiarity with Temporal or another durable workflow engine
  • Experience with identity and access management systems: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, fine-grained authorization models
  • Solid understanding of encryption patterns: envelope encryption, key hierarchy design, KMS integrations
  • Comfort operating in multi-tenant, regulated environments where correctness and audit evidence are non-negotiable
  • Strong observability instincts: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics : you instrument what you build

Preferred Qualification:

  • Experience with Zitadel, Keycloak, or similar identity providers
  • ClickHouse or other columnar/append-only store experience
  • Prior work in MSP tooling, PSA/RMM API integrations, or compliance-adjacent infrastructure (CMMC, HIPAA, SOC 2)

Maximum Lift Weight 50 #

Maximum Push/Pull Weight 150 #

% Of Time Sitting 0%

% Of Time Standing 100%

  8. Target castings as specified.
  9. Inspect height gages, verniers, and pin gages for wear. Report out of tolerance conditions to supervisor or Senior Trainer. Discontinue use of out of tolerance tools.

title: Person In Charge (PIC)
description:
Position Purpose: Exemplifies and ensures strong customer service in all aspects of the job. Directs and controls the operation of the Front End in the absence of store management to achieve sales and profit objectives.

Job Description: As a primary contact for customers, the Grocery Fourth/Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

  • Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

All store employees during the absence of the Store Director or Assistant Store Director.

title: Director, Strategy (AD&M) (#Remotw, HE, DE, 64625)
description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview:

We are seeking an exceptional strategy leader to serve as Strategy Director for TE Connectivity's Aerospace, Defense & Marine (ADM) Business Unit. This executive will shape the long-term growth agenda, lead strategic planning and portfolio decisions, drive transformational initiatives, and oversee strategic M&A activities across the business.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Strategy, the Strategy Director will partner closely with ADM leadership, functional teams, customers, and external partners to develop and execute strategies that accelerate growth, strengthen competitive positioning, and create shareholder value. The role can be located anywhere in Europe and requires approximately 10-30% travel, including international travel.

TE Connectivity is a global industrial technology leader with $17.3B in revenue and more than 90,000 employees worldwide. Within TE's Industrial Solutions Segment, the ADM Business Unit designs and manufactures critical connectivity and sensor solutions for aerospace, defense, and marine applications. ADM achieved $1.5B in net sales and 10% growth in fiscal year 2025 and continues to invest in next-generation defense, space, and advanced aerospace technologies.

This role offers significant executive exposure and a strong pathway to future leadership opportunities across strategy, business development, operations, and general management.

Please note: This role is advertised in Germany, but we are also open to considering candidates based in Italy, France, or the United Kingdom.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of ADM's long-term strategic agenda, including annual and multi-year strategic planning, portfolio prioritization, growth initiatives, and market expansion opportunities.
  • Drive alignment between business unit, segment, and corporate strategies while incorporating customer needs, market trends, competitive dynamics, technological developments, and regulatory considerations.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify and accelerate opportunities for above-market growth and continuously refine strategic priorities, including "where to play" and "how to win" decisions.
  • Communicate strategic direction clearly and effectively to senior leadership while fostering organizational alignment and commitment to execution.
  • Support execution of strategic priorities by partnering with functional leaders, managing cross-functional initiatives, and leading large-scale change and transformation programs.
  • Design and implement organizational change initiatives that enable sustainable execution of strategic objectives.
  • Develop and execute ADM's M&A strategy, including target identification, pipeline management, strategic assessment, due diligence, investment recommendations, and post-merger integration planning.
  • Partner closely with Corporate M&A and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate acquisition opportunities and unlock value creation.
  • Build strategic capabilities across the organization by promoting analytical rigor, customer focus, innovation, speed, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Champion the use of AI and emerging technologies to enhance team effectiveness, productivity, and business impact.
  • Lead talent development, succession planning, recruitment, and retention efforts within the strategy organization while fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture.
  • Establish strong stakeholder relationships, advance strategic growth opportunities, and successfully drive key strategic and M&A initiatives during the first year in role.

What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience, including at least 4 years in strategy consulting or corporate strategy leadership roles.
  • Deep expertise in growth strategy development, including portfolio strategy and where-to-play/how-to-win decision making.
  • Experience supporting B2B industrial, advanced manufacturing, engineered products, or technology-focused businesses.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate market trends, competitive dynamics, organizational capabilities, and customer needs into actionable growth strategies.
  • Experience leading strategy execution, large-scale transformations, and cross-functional initiatives in complex global organizations.
  • Familiarity with M&A processes, including target identification, business case development, due diligence, transaction support, and integration planning.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to influence executive stakeholders and build alignment without direct authority.
  • Global mindset with experience working across regions, cultures, and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience managing, developing, and mentoring high-performing teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, economics, or a related discipline; advanced degrees are advantageous.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage audiences ranging from frontline teams to C-suite executives.
  • Entrepreneurial, intellectually curious, and action-oriented leader who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Collaborative and humble leadership style, with a demonstrated commitment to team success, talent development, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

WHAT TE CONNECTIVITY OFFERS:
We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!

  • Unlimited contract opportunity
  • Pleasant working environment fostering teamwork
  • Open and dynamic company culture
  • Extensive training initiatives and growth opportunities
  • Competitive salary package
  • Comprehensive benefits including Group insurance, Hospitalization insurance, Meal vouchers etc.
  • Convenient location at E40 and E403 motorway intersection
  • Join a certified "TOP EMPLOYER" in a modern "FACTORY OF THE FUTURE"

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

  • Strong expertise in AWS services, particularly in GCC environment

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code tools, preferably Terraform

  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipeline development and management

  • Knowledge of security scanning tools (SonarQube, Fortify, Nexus IQ)

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies

  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell

Security and Compliance:

Personal Attributes

We are seeking a Regional Account Director – Central to own the Central territory within Gifthealth’s newly created external physician-facing sales organization. This person is directly responsible for driving adoption of Gifthealth’s enhanced service pharma programs within the region and building the trusted relationships that turn a target account list into long-term, retained business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Territory Sales Pipeline (30%) Build and manage the full sales pipeline within the region, including account identification, outreach, engagement, and conversion; maintain a robust, accurately staged pipeline of physician, clinic, and hospital network accounts.
  • Drive Physician & Account Adoption (25%) Execute call plans and playbooks developed by the VP of Key Account Sales; deliver the value proposition of Gifthealth’s enhanced service programs to physicians, clinics, and hospital networks; build the trusted relationships that drive program adoption and long-term account retention.
  • Deliver on Quota & Forecast Accuracy (20%) Meet or exceed territory-level conversion, revenue, and script volume growth targets; maintain accurate, up-to-date pipeline and forecast data and provide regular visibility to the VP of Key Account Sales.
  • Execute Field Strategy (15%) Apply territory coverage models, key account targeting, and call planning frameworks set at the national level; provide ground-level field intelligence and market feedback that helps refine targeting strategy and coverage design.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration (10%) Partner with Account Management, Marketing, and Sales Operations to ensure seamless account transitions, aligned messaging, and a consistent customer experience across the territory.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (Required)

Experience

  • 3+ years of direct sales experience with a proven track record of quota attainment and pipeline ownership (Required)
  • Experience in physician sales, field sales execution, or account management within a defined territory (Required)
  • Experience in hub market, pharmacy, or technology sales (Preferred)
  • Experience launching a new product or program within an existing territory or account base (Preferred)

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong understanding of physician sales cycles, call planning, and pipeline management (Required)
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with physicians, clinics, and hospital network stakeholders (Required)
  • Comfortable executing against playbooks and coverage models set by sales leadership, while adapting tactically to territory-specific dynamics (Required)
  • Strong CRM discipline and forecasting accuracy (Required)
  • Knowledge of the hub market, pharmacy market, or healthcare technology sales landscape (Preferred)

Compensation

This role includes base salary plus eligibility for Sales Incentive Compensation tied to territory quota attainment and script volume production.


Work Environment

  • Location: Remote; travel required across the Central territory to support key accounts
  • Residency: Must reside within one of the states in the Central territory (ND, SD, NE, KS, MN, IA, MO, WI, IL, IN, MI, OH, OK, TX)
  • Schedule: Full-time; reports to the VP of Key Account Sales
  • Key internal partners: the VP of Key Account Sales and the Commercial team (Account Management, Marketing, Sales Operations); key external interactions are with physicians, clinics, and hospital networks within the Central territory

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Python, AWS)
description:
Job Summary: The Senior Backend Engineer (Python/AWS) is responsible for designing and building scalable backend systems and cloud-native services that power internal products and customer-facing solutions. This role owns system architecture and integration design across multiple internal and external systems, translates business requirements into reliable, maintainable technical solutions, and provides technical mentorship to other engineers.

What does a day in the life of a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/AWS) look like?

Design and develop scalable backend applications and services using Python.

Design system architectures that integrate multiple internal and third-party systems.

Decompose complex business problems into well-defined services with clear ownership and boundaries.

Design and build REST APIs and backend services.

Design robust domain models, reusable components, and maintainable software abstractions.

Build reliable data ingestion and transformation pipelines.

Design integration patterns that ensure reliable communication between systems, including error handling, retries, and data consistency.

Develop cloud-native applications using AWS services.

Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

Troubleshoot production issues across application and cloud infrastructure layers.

Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews.

Mentor engineers by promoting sound software design and engineering best practices.

Collaborate closely with Product, Data, AI, and Engineering teams.

Adhere to company policies and procedures

Continuously improve knowledge of backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering best practices through training and learning initiatives

Collaborate with other departments as needed

Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers and colleagues at all times

Perform other duties as assigned

What are the required qualifications of a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/AWS)?

Minimum of five (5) years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience developing backend applications using Python.

Strong understanding of software architecture and distributed system design, including designing scalable systems with well-defined service boundaries.

Experience designing domain models that accurately represent complex business processes.

Experience integrating multiple APIs and third-party systems, and designing and building REST APIs.

Strong understanding of integration architecture, including data contracts, synchronization strategies, retries, and fault tolerance.

Experience building or supporting data ingestion and transformation pipelines, with an understanding of data modeling and mapping concepts.

Experience with AWS cloud services, ideally including serverless application development (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch).

Experience designing event-driven or asynchronous processing workflows.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical direction.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents
description:
Job Posting

As principal Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents, you will build the GenAI platform that powers critical decisions in healthcare, legal, tax, and compliance industries. Your work will directly shape the future of these fields, enabling faster, safer, and more impactful decision-making at a global scale.

About this role
Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product
teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development,
validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the
most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across
multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in
progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical
industries.


You'll join a 100-engineer remote-first team within a larger organization that
combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In
this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to
production. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the
development of the most impactful AI agents.


Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI
In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI—a medical research and clinical
reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point-of-care
knowledge resource into a real-time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and
reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline
fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will
translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

Tech stack
You don’t need to know all of these on day one, but you should be ready to learn
quickly.

  • TypeScript, Node.js, React, Python, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP/A2A, Rust

  • AWS (primary), Azure, GCP; Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions

  • DocumentDB, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search

  • Azure OpenAI, AWS Anthropic, Google Gemini

  • GitHub, Confluence, Slack

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement full-stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.

  • Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).

  • Apply secure SDLC and privacy-by-design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).

  • Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer-focused solutions with measurable outcomes.

  • Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.

  • Lead by example through writing high-quality, maintainable code that demonstrates engineering craftsmanship

Team context
Org and Sub-teams: Central GenAI Platform within Wolters Kluwer, driving
innovation across businesses by creating re-usable platform services and
components. Sub-teams are fewer than 10 engineers, focused on platform
services or customer-facing agents.
Culture and Reporting: We value a "manager of one" mindset, where
outcomes matter more than optics. Authority is earned through
demonstrated impact, not tenure or title. You’ll report directly to the VP of
Engineering, AI Platform.

Team Size and Impact: Our globally distributed team of ~100 engineers
combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a
startup. We are moving fast, and there are many areas where you can have
a big impact.
Work setup: Remote-first in US or EU, with hybrid options near major
offices. Collaboration requires 9–11 AM CST overlap. Occasional travel for
team onsites/offsites as needed.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong full-stack development skills and cloud experience

  • (AWS/Azure/GCP).

  • Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:

  • AI Agent development and evaluation

  • Backend development

  • Frontend development

  • Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)

  • CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code

  • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

  • Quality engineering / testing strategy

  • Secure SDLC and privacy by design

  • Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud-native systems to

  • production.

  • Excellent problem-solving, ownership, and cross-functional

  • communication.

Nice to have

  • Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a

  • small, fast-paced team.

  • Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety

  • evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous

  • improvement.

  • Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems;

  • OpenSearch.

  • Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-

  • tuning and model adaptation.

  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

  • 15‑minute intro screen

  • 2× live coding in your preferred language

  • 1× systems design

  • 1× presentation of past work

​Timeline: Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

  • Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your

  • expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.

  • After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths

  • and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.” In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

  • Your role and the problem space you were working in

  • The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them

  • The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information in your submission

#BETHEDIFFERENCE

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: Data Architect and Platform Lead
location: Kings Langley, United Kingdom; Glasgow, United Kingdom; United Kingdom
description:
Do you want to work to make Power for Good?
We're the world's largest independent renewable energy company. We're guided by a simple yet powerful vision: to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy.
We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we're tackling some of the world's toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They're our most important asset so that's why we continually invest in them.

We can promise you rewarding work which makes a real impact, the chance to learn from inspiring colleagues from across a growing, global network and opportunities to grow personally and professionally.
Our competitive package offers a wide range of benefits and rewards.
Job Summary
Are you ready to shape the future of data-driven decision-making across one of the World’s leading renewable energy businesses? At RES we are driving transformation through the power of data and insights – and we’re looking for a visionary Data Architect to lead the way.
In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing and delivering a scalable, secure, and future-ready data and analytics platform that will serve as the single source of truth for our enterprise. Your mission: to empower teams across the business with reliable, real-time insights that drive smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions.
You’ll sit within our Data & Analytics function, collaborating with technology and business stakeholders to shape strategy, ensure integration across systems, and champion data modernisation at scale. If you’re passionate about cloud data platforms, enterprise data architecture, and making data accessible and actionable – we want to hear from you.
Accountabilities
Key accountabilities include but are not limited to:
  • Own the target-state data architecture and platform technical direction for the Data platform and analytics ecosystem. Ensure the platform is secure, governed, cost-effective, and designed for scalable data products, BI and AI/ML.
  • Lead architecture and platform decisions, standards and designs, working closely with IT enterprise architecture, engineering, security and vendors to deliver a coherent, supportable platform.
  • Lead the platform and architecture team and external vendors to deliver work to high standards.
  • Set platform architectural standards and guardrails, design and lead security and privacy including legislation and regulative standards and integration across IT.
  • Own integration data architecture and source onboarding patterns.
  • Lead platform strategy and roadmap and technical debt remediation, drive tooling and implementations.
  • Coach the IT team, central and regional data teams, engineers and analytics engineers on best practices and provide global standards and guardrails. Partner with AI/ML stakeholders to ensure platform supports needs.
  • Ensure data is managed effectively and made available to services in the right way. Influence organisational strategy through robust evidence and insight.
Skills
The successful candidate will need to demonstrate:
  • Deep and significant skills in global data architecture, data engineering, data platforms and analytics leadership roles.
  • TOGAF certification (preferred) or demonstrable experience in enterprise architecture.
  • Strong cloud platform architecture and platform capability, skills and qualifications.
  • Deep understanding of BI and semantic modelling patterns and how they fit into enterprise architecture.
  • AI/ML platform requirements.
  • Effective communicator with strong influencing, negotiating, and relationship building skills. Ability to articulate architecture and data platforms to executives. Ability to translate complex data into meaningful insight for non-technical audiences.
  • Able to work independently, manage competing priorities, and lead through change.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery and data teams across different data architectures and platforms.
  • High attention to detail, integrity, and commitment to ethical data use.
  • Strong executive written documentation, planning, organisation, prioritisation and design governance, and discipline.
  • Passionate about data and innovative to enable RES to stay ahead of and implement global best practice in modern, scalable and future proof data platform.
Qualifications and Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in data, Analytics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in data architecture and platform management and operations, with track record of delivering secure, high-value global data solutions.
  • Significant experience as a global data platform architect/lead in a global enterprise environment.
  • Proven delivery of cloud-based data platforms with governance, security and scalable analytics consumption.
  • Demonstrable experience in designing and delivering Microsoft Fabric data foundations, architecting and implementing scalable, reliable end-to-end data solutions using Azure/Microsoft Fabric services, covering data lakes, data warehouses, and ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Leadership and line management of the data architecture and platform team driving a high performance, accountability, innovation and the latest technology for automation, cost efficiency and innovation.
  • Experience establishing architecture standards, reference designs and technical assurance processes.
  • In depth knowledge and practical implementation of compliance frameworks and global employment regulations.
  • Knowledge of global data standardization frameworks for harmonizing data definitions, taxonomies, and formats across regions.
  • It is mandatory that you have proven experience in data architecture/engineering for IFS (RES’s enterprise ERP system) and extensive experience in financial and human resources data, corporate services multiple system integration data architecture in a global context.
  • Experience in AI/ML enablement and integration with data and analytics platforms.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, alongside technical breadth in data architecture and platforms.
  • Extensive experience briefing executive leaders and running data architecture and platform programmes across the world.

ABOUT GLENEAGLES

One of the world’s most iconic luxury hotels and country retreats, Gleneagles has been making memories for a century. Crowned ‘Employer of the Year’ at the 2024 Cateys and Number One Resort in the UK & Ireland by readers of the Travel + Leisure for their 2025 World’s Best Awards, everything we do is about surpassing expectations and creating unrivalled adventures for our guests.

WORKING AT GLENEAGLES

We’re devoted to making our people feel as valued as our guests. In this way, we strive to support the whole ‘you’ – not just the professional part but the personal part too. People join our team for all sorts of reasons. Some work here permanently to develop a career, some work seasonally, while others have a schedule to fit around their personal commitments. However long you plan to stay with us and whatever hours you’d prefer to work, we’re open to flexible working requests and offer hours, shift patterns and contract types to suit everyone.

Location; Auchterarder, just off the A9. Gleneagles is also within easy reach of a number of Scottish towns and cities: Edinburgh City Centre (1hr), Glasgow or Dundee (50mins), Stirling and Perth (25mins).

Here's a bit more detail on what we see you doing in this role:

  • Leading the delivery of digital projects across our business, including booking engine development and guest and member-facing web and app products
  • Developing and owning project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource allocation and risk management, and holding delivery partners to them
  • Managing multiple external vendors and agencies simultaneously; reviewing statements of work, scrutinising scope and cost changes, challenging escalations with evidence, and ensuring commercial terms protect the business before sign-off
  • Coordinating the delivery of complex integrations between systems including property management, membership, reservations, spa and leisure booking, payments and our data warehouse, working to the technical and design specifications set by the Digital Experience Manager, and understanding dependencies well enough to spot delivery risk early
  • Ensuring data architecture and validation requirements defined by the Digital Experience Manager and our data function are delivered and signed off as part of each project
  • Translating the requirements and priorities set by the Digital Experience Manager into delivery plans, and flagging early where scope, cost or vendor capacity puts them at risk
  • Communicating project status to stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams to the executive; providing transparency proactively and translating technical detail into business language
  • Planning and running the delivery side of user acceptance testing across integrated systems: coordinating environments, vendors, test schedules and defect resolution, so the Digital Experience Manager and operational teams can focus on validating the experience
  • Ensuring projects handling member and guest data are delivered in line with GDPR and PECR requirements, working with legal and compliance where needed
  • Coordinating training rollout and go-live readiness so our teams are confident with new systems from day one
  • Interacting with our members and guests, always warm, professional, helpful and doing everything you can to exceed their expectations; playing your part in making their stay with us luxurious in every way

The kind of person we're looking for:

  • With strong experience delivering digital projects, ideally in hospitality, luxury or membership businesses, you also ideally have a degree in a relevant field, proven delivery however matters more
  • You've managed multi-vendor programmes and know how to run a supplier relationship commercially: reviewing SOWs, questioning cost increases, and getting line-item clarity before committing spend
  • The difference between product ownership and delivery is crystal clear to you, and you're energised by the delivery side; you've worked well alongside product owners before and know how to make that partnership work
  • You're comfortable in conversations about data: APIs, data quality, and what it takes to deliver reliable syncs between operational systems to someone else's specification
  • Building strong working relationships with stakeholders across the business, from front-of-house teams to the executive is second nature to you, and you have great interpersonal skills
  • You adeptly manage multiple projects and conflicting priorities without dropping detail, and you adapt quickly when things change
  • Direct and organised, you have a positive "can do" attitude and an eagle eye for detail; you take immense pride in your work and in delivering the standards our guests expect of the Gleneagles brand
  • You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and above all has fun along the way
What’s in it for you: Time to let your hair down
  • 30 days holiday (including bank holidays) that increases with service
  • Seasonal parties and local social events
  • 50% discount on Food & Beverage, Country Pursuits, Spa and Hair Salon (Mon-Thurs) and the Golf Driving Range
  • Golf Membership (with access to all 3 championship courses) for £50.00 per annum
Treats in your pocket

  • Free ‘pay day’ lunch and monthly drinks offers
  • A generous ‘refer a friend’ scheme
Be our guest
  • Stay with us as a guest at Gleneagles or Gleneagles Townhouse for up to 2 nights per year at £95.00 per night – a benefit available upon completion of 12 months service
  • Friends & Family discounted rate of £225 - £275 B&B per night at Gleneagles
  • Enjoy discounted rooms and restaurants rates with up to 50% off across the wider Ennismore brands and hotels, located across some spectacular locations, including London, Paris, Rome, Dubai, Doha, Rio, NY, Chicago and LA...to name just a few
Investment in your development and wellbeing
  • Pension scheme
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme, offering support and confidential advice for you and your family when you need it most
  • Ongoing investment in your personal development with access to internal and external training qualifications and programmes
  • Internal career opportunities across a wider range of specialisms and departments

  • Troubleshoot network issues using tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark.

  • Troubleshoot Layer 2/3 protocols, including STP, ARP, DHCP, HSRP, VRRP, OSPF, BGP, and IS-IS.

  • Support Cisco ACI, SD-Access, cloud networking, and other virtualized network environments.

  • Implement network security measures such as 802.1X, DDoS mitigation, and DHCP security.

  • Provide support for Juniper EX and QFX switching platforms.

  • Participate in incident resolution and coordinate with cross-functional teams during critical technical issues.

  • Maintain accurate network documentation and operational procedures.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience in enterprise network or data center engineering.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus and F5 BIG-IP.

  • Knowledge of data center networking, routing and switching, network security, and troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with Cisco ACI, SD-Access, cloud networking, and network automation.

  • Experience with Juniper EX/QFX is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP Data Center and F5-CTS are preferred.

title: Forward-deployed engineer til KUs nye AI Kontor
description:
AI-Kontoret på Københavns Universitet søger en Forward-deployed AI Engineer eller Expert med tiltrædelse 15. oktober eller snarest derefter.

Om os
AI kontoret er en af krumtapperne i KU’s nye 3-årige AI-satsning, der påbegyndes 1 september. Kontoret, der består af fire ansatte samt den nye Viceprorektor for AI, har til formål at understøtte viceprorektors arbejde, ansvar og mål i forhold til den overordnede implementering af og sammenhæng i anvendelsen af AI på tværs af forskning, uddannelse, innovation og administration.

Kontoret fungerer også som koordinerende organ for en række andre nye øvrige fora og strukturer, der til sammen udgør KUs nye AI-organisering, herunder hhv. akademiske og administrative AI-ledelsesteams, UCPH AI styregruppen, samt en agil og beslutningsdygtig AI-taskforce, som sikrer effektive, velfunderede beslutninger og bred repræsentation på tværs af KU.


Profil:
Den rette kandidat kan komme fra mange forskellige baggrunde - et eksempel kunne være en fullstack eller devops engineer med erfaring i at udvikle og lancere interne softwareværktøjer i store organisationer, eller en data science/AI nørd med samfundsvidenskabelig baggrund. Erfaring fra konsulentverdenen og den offentlige sektor er værdsat, samt erfaring med software, der bruger LLMs eller andre typer AI modeller. Vi ser gerne at du har en kreativ, åbensindet og fleksibel tilgang til koncernens, undervisernes og forskernes behov og tilbyder en høj grad af autonomi. Vi vil give dig lov til at bruge dit yndlings programmeringssprog i arbejdet - det kunne for eksempel være typescript med sveltekit eller react, python med django og fastapi, java, scala og så videre.


Arbejdsopgaver
Som forward-deployed AI engineer får du en nøglerolle i afprøvningen, udviklingen og implementeringen af specialiserede AI modeller og agenter for at understøtte universitetets digitale transformation indenfor særligt administrative opgaver på tværs af koncernen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter:

  • Etablere samt koordinere og prioritere (i tæt samarbejde med KU IT) arbejdet i KUs nye AI-platform (en sikker agentiv AI-sandbox designet og driftet i samarbejde med KU IT)
  • Bygge, teste, og implementere AI-løsninger (i tæt samarbejde med KU IT) til koncernadministrationen på baggrund af ønsker og prioritering fra KU’s ledelse og stakeholders
  • Rådgive viceprorektor, vicedirektør for IT samt resten af KUs ledelse om frontier modeller og agentive løsninger inden for særligt administration, men også forskning og undervisning
  • Rådgive viceprorektor for AI og KU’s ledelse om relevante og realistiske investeringsbehov i AI-modeller og -løsninger
  • Deltagelse i, input til og rådgivning af relevante fora i universitets nye AI-organisering, herunder AI-Taskforcen samt Styregruppen for AI i universitetsadministrationen.
Kvalifikationer

- Relevant uddannelse inden for data science, applied AI, social data science eller anden baggrund med tilsvarende viden, færdigheder og kompetencer

- Interesse for og ideelt erfaring med udvikling og implementering af AI-løsninger i store organisationer

- Evne til at overskue og prioritere opgaver i en kompleks, politisk-styret organisation med forskellige og til tider modstridende behov og interesser

- Gode kommunikationsegenskaber, både på engelsk og dansk

- Teknisk viden om og overblik over frontier AI modeller og agentive AI løsninger

- Evne til og glæde ved at indgå i tværfaglige teams bestående af både AI-nørder og generalister


Vi tilbyder

  • Et spændende arbejdsmiljø i en kompleks vidensorganisation med stor mangfoldighed i forhold til mennesker, fagområder og specialiseringer
  • Mulighed for at være med til at præge og forme KU’s nye AI-indsatser og skabe gennemgribende organisatorisk forandring
  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling med stor grad af ansvar og indflydelse
  • Godt/tæt kollegialt samarbejde og faglig sparring i en alsidig og afvekslende hverdag
  • Fleksibelt arbejde efter aftale med lederen, med mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • Høj grad af autonomi: din ekspertise inden for modeller og hvordan man implementerer dem, respekteres og værdsættes.
  • Et lille team og ekspertkolleger i et støttende miljø.
Læs mere om Københavns Universitet på www.ku.dk

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelse sker som specialkonsulent eller chefkonsulent efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikere i staten (AC-overenskomsten) eller efter Fællesoverenskomst mellem Skatteministeriet og Lærernes Centralorganisation og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 (LC/CO10-fællesoverenskomsten) samt Cirkulære om organisationsaftale for it-medarbejdere (PROSA) i statens tjeneste med indplacering i løngruppe 3 eller 4 afhængig af erfaring og kompetencer, eller efter anden relevant overenskomst. Du kan læse mere om lønniveauer i staten på .


Den ugentlige arbejdstid er gennemsnitligt 37 timer inklusive frokost og vi har flekstid.

Arbejdssted: KU AI, Krystalgade 25, 1172 København K.

Startdato: 15. oktober eller snarest muligt derefter.


Når du skal tilknyttes Københavns Universitet, eller på anden måde have adgang til Københavns Universitets forskning, kan det være påkrævet at gennemgå en baggrundsscreening. Formålet er at værne om Københavns Universitets sikkerhed og forskningsintegritet.

Københavns Universitet har etableret en ny fælles administrativ organisering, som fortsat implementeres. Det indebærer løbende forandringer og udvikling af bl.a. arbejdsgange og samarbejdsflader.

Din ansøgning

Er du interesseret i stillingen, beder vi dig sende en elektronisk ansøgning med bilag via Jobportalen (tryk på linket "SØG STILLINGEN" nederst i opslaget) senest 18. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler vil finde sted i uge 39.

Universitetet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Yderligere spørgsmål

Spørgsmål til stillingen kan rettes til Professor Morten Axel Pedersen, map@sodas.ku.dk, tel 31314630.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Employee Experience
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

FULL STACK ENGINEER, EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
  • Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
  • Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
  • Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
  • Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions
  • Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • 1+ years of experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
  • Expertise in designing software systems
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • You may be asked to work extended hours/weekends dependent on launch cadence
  • This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Software Engineer/Level I: $135,000.00 - $160,000.00/per year
Software Engineer/Level II: $155,000.00 - $185,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Solutions Engineer Team Lead
description:
What we do?

Today most companies are reliant on their sales reps to find leads. The challenge? Reps struggle to find great prospects. Worse, they waste huge amounts of time disqualifying leads they can't sell to. This is a poor experience for reps, inefficient use of their skills and sunk cost for the business. GoodFit helps companies identify their leads programmatically and build a dataset based on their unique requirements. We only source the accounts that meet the company's qualification criteria and enrich them with the most useful data points. With the company's market mapped, they can more efficiently distribute & prioritise leads, while delivering compelling messaging based on their prospect's needs.

About the Role

As a Team Lead Solutions Engineer at GoodFit, you will leading a team of 2 Solutions Engineers whilst playing a crucial role both pre and post sales, ensuring we’re delivering the best data sets to our clients and helping them integrate and leverage the data effectively as a part of their GTM strategies.

In your role, you’ll have the chance to work closely with commercial teams at some of the fastest growing B2B companies around (such as Clari, Chili Piper, Deepgram, Paddle, and more), translating their needs into actionable dataset and advising them on how to utilize GoodFit platform in their go-to-market efforts.

Given your close contact with both existing clients and prospects, you will act as a bridge between GoodFit’s commercial and product team, advocating for client needs, sharing client feedback and helping product bring new solutions to market.

As team lead, you will be responsible for ensuring the Solutions team have the appropriate support, capacity and processes to ensure outstanding delivery of work whilst adopting a culture of continuous improvement.

What You'll Do
  • Pre-Sales: Engage in discovery sessions to translate prospects needs into bespoke datasets. Helping define the data points / data sources that capture a prospect’s ideal customer profile definition. Build demo datasets that demonstrate GoodFit’s value proposition.
  • Data Analysis: using the Goodfit platform to analyse and interpret customer data, how this correlates to Goodfit’s data sets and how to best educate prospects and customers on how we have arrived at our definition of qualified account/ICP/best customers
  • Onboarding: Work closely with Account Managers and new clients to deliver their solution including guiding them through possible configurations and best-practice. Meanwhile, validating that we map the right market of companies they want to target, and enrich them with the required data based on their GTM plans. Help our clients integrate the data into their existing tools such as CRMs (e.g. SFDC, HubSpot), sequencing tools (e.g. Salesloft, Lemlist) or data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake).
  • Client Support: Own communications with existing clients, helping them adjust their dataset, data processes, and educate them on overall product capabilities.
  • Internal Collaboration: Represent the voice of the customer and work closely with the engineering and product teams to relay feedback and push for continual product improvement. Help maintain internal and external documentation of best practices and common solutions.
  • Team Lead: oversight of and responsibility for ensuring processes for managing workload, prioritisation of tasks and high performance of the team.
We'd Love to Hear From You If
  • Passionate about data and how it can be used to drive commercial teams productivity.
  • Genuine curiosity about all things GTM and proactively follows and researches new ideas and concepts relating to GTM.
  • Have previous experience in Solutions / Sales Engineering or Forward Deployment Engineering roles within Saas or Data industries, working directly with the clients to help them utilise the product in the most effective way and advise them on best practices.
  • Have strong technical skills in data analysis, are proficient with spreadsheets, and have experience in data wrangling and transformation. Ideally with a basic knowledge of SQL, JSON data structures, and API functionalities.
  • Are curious about new technologies and how they might improve the day to day of teams in the commercial organisation
  • You are obsessed with continuous improvement be that process, people or product
  • Experienced / used common sales tech stack tooling such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Experience in prioritising workloads and communication with internal stakeholders.
Why Join Us?
  • Work closely with a leadership team who’ve built and scaled multiple revenue teams to $100M+ ARR (you’ll learn more in 12 months than most do in 5 years)
  • Quarterly off-sites in the UK (past trips: Oxford, Bath)
  • Top-tier equipment & Shoreditch HQ
  • Private healthcare insurance
  • Gym access, monthly team events & more
Hiring Process
  • Screening call with Adam: introductions, an overview of the role, and an initial conversation about your experience and motivation (30 mins)
  • Task interview with Aleks, Joanna, and Adam: presentation of your task and discussion of your approach (60 mins)
  • Meet the team with Joanna and Ammar: an informal conversation with your potential future teammates (30 mins)
Inclusion at Goodfit Ltd.

Goodfit Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, colour, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

Research shows that some candidates, particularly women and people from underrepresented groups, may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every listed qualification. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly.

title: Product Analyst, Conversational AI
description:
IntegriChain's Product Management team is adding a Product Analyst for Prism. Prism is our conversational analytics platform. It lets the people who work in market access at life sciences companies ask questions about their data in plain English and get answers back in seconds, instead of handing the request to an analyst and waiting. Behind the scenes, Prism runs on semantic layers we build from our raw SQL data, and those layers are what let it take a business question and map it to the right numbers. The Product Analyst is the person who makes sure the questions people ask actually line up with the answers Prism gives back. You'll work day to day with Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering to keep those answers accurate and worth trusting.

This isn't a development role, and it isn't about building reports or dashboards. It's an analysis role for someone who is technical but isn't a software engineer. You'll use Snowflake Cortex along with tools like Claude and Codex to review and improve the prompts business users type into Prism and the answers it sends back. A lot of the work is finding the spots where the data is set up in a way that leads Prism to misread a question or return the wrong answer. Roughly half the job is digging into the data itself. The other half is talking to the business owners, certifying that queries return the right results, and writing up what needs to change.

What This Role Entails

  • Prompt review: Go through the prompts business users type into Prism and improve them, using Snowflake Cortex and tools like Claude and Codex, so their questions get read correctly against the semantic layer.
  • Query certification: Check user queries and the answers Prism gives back, confirm they hold up against the source data, and sign off so the business can trust the results.
  • Quality ownership: Keep an eye on the questions users ask and the answers they get, and watch for repeat errors, gaps, or misreads so they get fixed.
  • Semantic layer work: Work with Data Science and Engineering to improve the semantic layers built from the raw SQL tables, including the taxonomies, metadata, and labeling, so Prism understands the data better.
  • Data analysis: Dig into how data connects across pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and other areas, and use what you find to shape how that data is represented in Prism.
  • Working with the business: Talk to business owners about the questions they need answered, and turn those conversations into better prompts, queries, and data structure.
  • Writing requirements: Write clear technical requirements for tuning the model, changing how data is structured, or improving the product, based on what your reviews turn up.
  • Documentation: Document where the data comes from, the business logic behind it, and how things relate, so people can understand and trust Prism's answers.
  • Roadmap input: Be the voice for data quality in planning and prioritization for Prism, so decisions are based on what the data actually says.
  • QA and communication: Work with QA to set up test cases for answer accuracy each sprint, and help with internal and customer updates (release notes, briefings, presentations) that explain how Prism works.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • At least 3 years in data analysis, data correlation, or similar analytical work.
  • Strong technical skills without being a software engineer. You're comfortable with SQL, semantic layers, and data structures, and you can dig into a problem on your own.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools like Snowflake Cortex, Claude, or Codex, and a good sense of how they read structured data and prompts.
  • A working knowledge of semantic data modeling (ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or similar) and how it supports AI querying.
  • A knack for spotting when an AI answer doesn't match the source data, and the patience to figure out why.
  • A track record of turning messy data relationships into clear requirements, working alongside Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering.
  • Strong writing and speaking skills. You can talk to business owners and explain complicated data and AI ideas in a way people can act on.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile tools.
  • Familiarity with pharma, or with contracts and pricing, is a plus. A 4-year degree in a related field is preferred.

What does IntegriChain have to offer?

  • Shape how a market-leading platform's AI understands and responds to life sciences data.
  • Work at the intersection of data science, semantic modeling, and product innovation, with visibility to senior product and company leadership.
  • Join a collaborative, growing o
  • Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering & Architecture (1 year contract)
description:
(What the role is) The Health Promotion Board's vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people. Come be a part of this journey if you're passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change. You will be a part of HPB's Chief Data Officer's Office (CDOO), Data Engineering and Architecture team, which is building the National Lifestyle Repository (NLR) - a first-of-its-kind platform that integrates lifestyle and preventive health data from across Singapore's health and community ecosystem into a 360- citizen-centric view. This work sits at the heart of HPB's Precision Public Health strategy, positioning HPB as the authoritative data custodian for lifestyle data in Singapore and empowering partners and grassroots leaders to deliver more personalised and impactful health programmes at scale (What you will be working on) As Senior Manager responsible for data governance and standards, you will drive the development of the governance frameworks, data standards, and partnership agreements that underpin the NLR's integrity and trustworthiness as a national lifestyle data platform. You will lead complex multi-agency engagements, negotiating and aligning partner organisations on governance standards, data sharing protocols, and compliance requirements, and facilitating cross-agency alignment to support NLR scale-up and MOH platform integration You will propose and establish data standards, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria governing data ingestion, engineering, and quality across all NLR data domains, translating governance and policy requirements into actionable standards for adoption by HPB's partner ecosystem. You will design and implement consent management policies, data sharing safeguards, and compliance validation processes that enable trusted, scalable data flows across partner organisations with varying technical capabilities and institutional priorities. You will serve as HPB's authoritative data custodian for the NLR, maintaining data dictionaries, lineage records, and metadata frameworks, and acting as the primary point of contact for data concierge queries on data product definitions, availability, and appropriate use. You will evaluate new data product requirements and feature requests against governance and custodianship standards prior to pipeline-level implementation and oversee data product lifecycle management including documentation of handover protocols. You will implement governance safeguards and workflows to support data portability and onward data sharing, and surface cross-cutting governance and policy issues with well-reasoned recommendations for collective decision-making.

(What we are looking for) An ideal candidate will be a governance-minded and technically grounded professional, a dynamic and self-motivated individual with at least 5 years of working experience in data governance, cross-agency stakeholder management, and data partnership development, with demonstrated experience defining and establishing data governance frameworks, data standards, and consent management systems across multiple partner organisations. The candidate should also possess: Demonstrated experience managing complex multi-stakeholder engagements and negotiating data sharing agreements across government agencies or health ecosystem partners. Strong foundation in data standards policy development, governance framework design, and compliance validation, with the ability to translate high-level policy and governance requirements into actionable technical standards implementable at the pipeline level. Working proficiency in data engineering tools and programming languages (e.g. Python, R), with sufficient technical depth to ensure governance frameworks are practical and implementable. Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage complex multi-agency relationships, align diverse partners on governance standards, and facilitate adoption across organisations with varying technical maturity. Sound independent judgement on governance and standards matters, with the ability to surface cross-cutting issues constructively and prepare well-reasoned recommendations for collective decision-making. Meticulous, result-driven, and intellectually curious, with the drive to seek continuous improvement in governance practices, data standards, and compliance validation processes. A genuine interest in digital health, healthcare, and health promotion, with an appreciation for how Precision Public Health and population-level analytics can deliver more personalised lifestyle programmes at scale.

Prior experience in healthcare data management, data custodianship, or cross-agency governance processes will be an added advantage. Candidates with experience establishing and validating compliance frameworks across partner organisations with varying technical capabilities will have an added advantage.

title: Solution Architect IS&O Enterprise Security
company: FLBU FUJIFILM Life Sciences Biotechnologies U.
description:
Design the security backbone that protects science, patients, and clients across FLBG. As our Global Solution Architect (IS&O) for Enterprise Security, you will translate complex business and technical needs into scalable, secure architectures—elevating delivery quality, accelerating outcomes, and ensuring alignment with enterprise, infrastructure, and compliance standards worldwide. Your work will reduce risk, prevent rework, and enable confident, compliant growth across our global network.

Why this role matters

  • Shape security by design: Embed cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure requirements into every solution—strengthening resilience across IT, OT, data, and application domains.

  • Drive clarity and speed: Illuminate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early so FLBG teams can deliver predictably and at scale.

  • Protect reputation and revenue: High-quality architecture prevents delivery delays, mitigates compliance exposure, and enables secure digital innovation for our clients and patients.

What you’ll do

  • Translate requirements into end-to-end solution designs within Enterprise Security, including system interactions, data flows, and integration points.

  • Produce and maintain architecture artifacts (diagrams, data flows, interface definitions, technology selections) to guide design decisions and delivery teams.

  • Identify whether initiatives meet ARB entry criteria (e.g., cross-domain impact, regulatory scope, new technology, high-risk design) and prepare required inputs for review.

  • Perform architecture impact assessments for new initiatives, including dependencies across IT, OT, data, and security domains.

  • Define and validate solution design options (e.g., build vs. buy, pattern selection, integration approaches) and support decision-making with documented trade-offs.

  • Review designs to ensure alignment with approved patterns and reference architectures; flag deviations requiring governance review.

  • Partner with engineering and delivery teams to clarify design intent, resolve design issues, and ensure correct implementation of architecture.

  • Identify and manage cross-team dependencies, ensuring sequencing and integration points are clearly understood and planned.

  • Ensure security, compliance, and infrastructure requirements are embedded in solution designs (e.g., GxP, identity, data protection, connectivity).

  • Support release readiness by validating that architecture-related dependencies, risks, and constraints are addressed prior to deployment.

  • Document and track architecture risks, exceptions, and technical debt, including mitigation or remediation plans.

  • And other job duties as assigned.

Minimum education requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Preferred cybersecurity certifications: SABSA, CISSP.

Minimum experience requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise security–specific architecture or engineering.

  • Experience translating requirements into solution designs and architecture artifacts.

  • Experience working across multiple teams and domains (e.g., cyber, infrastructure, data).

  • Familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (where applicable).

  • Experience in regulated environments (e.g., GxP, ISO 27001) preferred.

  • Knowledge of Security Frameworks – NIS2 /GDPR (Europe) is strongly preferred.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong expertise in enterprise security technologies and architecture.

  • Ability to design and document end-to-end solutions and integrations.

  • Understanding of cross-domain dependencies (IT, OT, security, data).

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; crisp articulation of trade-offs and risk.

  • Effective communication and stakeholder coordination in global, cross-functional environments.

How you’ll operate

  • Own architecture input and design quality within the Enterprise Security domain.

  • Support solution architecture and ARB decision-making inputs.

  • Identify dependencies, risks, and complexity across initiatives; escalate when needed.

  • Interface with Solution Architecture Lead, Enterprise Architecture, and delivery teams; align with enterprise standards while balancing real-world delivery constraints.

  • Global role requiring coordination across time zones; occasional off-hours engagement as needed.

Your impact from day one

  • Lift design quality and consistency across FLBG’s security initiatives—reducing rework and cycle time.

  • Build confidence with clear governance inputs, ready-for-release solutions, and transparent risk management.

  • Enable secure, scalable digital capabilities that help FLBG deliver for clients and patients—safely, quickly, and at global scale.

This is a global position that will support all our FUJIFILM Biotechnologies sites. This position can be based at any of our locations (United States, United Kingdom, or Denmark). Benefits and compensation will be governed by the location that you are based from and considered your home site.

title: Contact Channel CX Lead
description:
Are you passionate about transforming customer experiences across every contact channel?

As our Contact Channel CX Lead, you’ll be at the heart of shaping how our customers interact with us, ensuring the right message reaches the right person, at the right time, through the right channel. You’ll lead the charge in breaking down silos, knitting together journeys and channels to deliver seamless, engaging, and cost-effective experiences. If you thrive on storytelling, campaign strategy, and journey design, have experience with implementing communication platforms, and a knack for channel best practice (especially email/SMS), this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

What you’ll be doing as Contact Channel CX Lead

  • Team Leadership: Lead and manage a team of journey managers and channel owners, ensuring cohesive delivery and ongoing improvement of all customer touchpoints
  • Best Practice Implementation: Apply best practices in channel management and campaign strategy to drive performance outcomes and enhance customer satisfaction.

  • Collaboration Facilitation: Facilitate collaboration across traditionally siloed teams and processes, building unified and effective customer journeys.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Engage stakeholders effectively and provide leadership in driving cross-functional projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

Base location: Hybrid/Reading (minimum one day in the office per week, with flexibility to attend additional days as required for team meetings, projects, or during onboarding)

Working pattern or hours: 36 hours per week (Monday to Friday)

What you should bring to the role
  • Proven experience in channel management, campaign management, marketing, communications, public relations, or service design—especially in email and SMS channels.

  • Leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
  • Experience in Agile product delivery environments. (desirable)
  • Background in campaign management, marketing, communications, or PR. (desirable)
  • Knowledge of new contact technologies and digital transformation. (desirable)

What’s in it for you?
  • Competitive salary from £62,650 - £70,000 per annum depending on skills and experience.
  • 26 days holiday per year increasing to 30 with the length of service. (plus bank holidays)
  • Car Allowance.
  • Performance-related pay plan directly linked to company performance measures and targets
  • Generous Pension Scheme through AON.
  • Private Medical Health Care.
  • Access to lots of benefits to help you take care of you and your family’s health and wellbeing, and your finances – from annual health MOTs and access to physiotherapy and counselling, to Cycle to Work schemes, shopping vouchers and life assurance.

Find out more about our benefits and perks (Please note different T&Cs apply if on secondment)

Who are we?

We’re the UK’s largest water and wastewater company, with more than 16 million customers relying on us every day to supply water for their taps and toilets. We want to build a better future for all, helping our customers, communities, people, and the planet to thrive. It’s a big job and we’ve got a long way to go, so we need help from passionate and skilled people, committed to making a difference and getting us to where we want to be in the years and decades to come.

Learn more about our purpose and values

Working at Thames Water

Thames Water is a unique, rewarding, and diverse place to work, where every day you can make a difference, yet no day is the same. As part of our family, you’ll enjoy meaningful career opportunities, flexible working arrangements and excellent benefits.

If you’re looking for a sustainable and successful career where you can make a daily difference to millions of people’s lives while helping to protect the world of water for future generations, we’ll be here to support you every step of the way. Together, we can build a better future for our customers, our region, and our planet.

Real purpose, real support, real opportunities. Come and join the Thames Water family. Why choose us? Learn more.

We’re committed to being a great, diverse, and inclusive place to work. We welcome applications from everyone and want to ensure you feel supported throughout the recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, whether that’s extra time, accessible formats, or anything else just let us know, we’re here to help and support.

When a crisis happens, we all rally around to support our customers. As part of Team Thames, you’ll have the opportunity to sign up to support our customers on the frontline as an ambassador. Full training will be given for what is undoubtedly an incredibly rewarding experience. It’s also a great opportunity to learn more about our business and meet colleagues.
