title: Director of Operations
description:
Ready to be part of something big? At KRUSH Labs, a privately owned R&D center, we push the boundaries of unmanned systems and advanced hardware. We’re building next-generation platforms that fuse resilient communications, AI-driven autonomy, and precision navigation, designed to perform in the most demanding real-world environments. Join us to tackle complex challenges, turn cutting-edge research into deployed technology, and help shape the future of autonomous systems!

We are looking for an experienced Director of Operations to establish and lead the operational framework of our innovative R&D-focused high-tech company. In this pivotal role, you will ensure that the company has clear, scalable, and well-defined processes, policies, and controls across key operational areas, including IT, security, legal, compliance, finance, procurement, and facilities. You will work closely with leadership, internal teams, and external specialists to ensure that operational standards are implemented, maintained, and continuously improved as the company grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and establish the company’s operational framework, ensuring clear processes, policies, responsibilities, and decision-making structures across key support functions.
  • Establish and maintain operational policies and procedures covering IT, information security, legal, compliance, finance, procurement, facilities, and business continuity.
  • Act as the operational owner responsible for ensuring that critical processes and controls are properly implemented, documented, maintained, and regularly reviewed.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external specialists across Legal, Finance, IT, Security, HR, and other support functions to ensure effective execution and alignment.
  • Identify operational, compliance, security, and business risks, establish appropriate controls, and ensure mitigation actions are implemented and followed through.
  • Ensure appropriate processes are in place for IT access, equipment, systems, data protection, security, onboarding/offboarding, and business continuity.
  • Establish clear workflows and approval processes for finance, procurement, contracts, vendors, expenses, and other administrative operations.
  • Oversee and coordinate facilities, workplace infrastructure, suppliers, and other operational services to ensure an effective and reliable working environment.
  • Implement operational reporting frameworks, KPIs, and regular reviews, providing leadership with clear visibility into operational performance, risks, gaps, and priorities.
  • Conduct regular reviews of operational processes and policies, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement and ensuring agreed actions are implemented.
  • Support the leadership team in translating business and strategic priorities into clear operational plans, processes, and execution.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, compliance, and operational excellence across the organization.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, General Management, Finance, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in operations, business operations, general management, or similar cross-functional roles, preferably within high-growth technology, engineering, manufacturing, or R&D-driven environments.
  • Proven experience establishing and implementing operational processes, policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience working across multiple functions such as IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, and Facilities.
  • Strong understanding of operational risk management, internal controls, compliance, and business continuity.
  • Experience managing external service providers, consultants, vendors, and other operational partners.
  • Strong project and process management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives from identifying a gap through implementation and follow-up.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including understanding of budgeting, procurement, financial controls, and operational reporting.
  • Proficiency with MS Office / Google Workspace and business systems; experience with ERP, HRIS, ITSM, or other operational platforms is a plus.

Skills & Abilities Required:

  • Strong operational leadership and proven ability to establish structure and scalable operating processes in fast-growing environments.
  • Highly structured and pragmatic approach, with the ability to create effective processes without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence teams and specialists without direct ownership of every function.
  • Strong risk awareness and ability to identify operational, compliance, security, and business continuity risks and establish appropriate controls.
  • Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills, with a strong focus on execution and follow-through.
  • Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, practical policies, processes, and guidelines.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with senior leadership, functional teams, employees, and external partners.
  • High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and people-oriented work ethic.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and constantly evolving R&D environment.

Why join KRUSH Labs?

Based in Eindhoven, KRUSH Labs is a privately owned R&D, engineering, and prototyping center where multidisciplinary teams develop next-generation solutions in advanced hardware, embedded systems, wireless communication, sensing, autonomous technologies, AI, and software.

We support the complete innovation journey, from research and proof of concept to rapid prototyping, system integration, validation, and manufacturing readiness. When a solution is proven, we help customers bridge the gap from prototype to pilot production and scalable manufacturing.

Join us to solve complex challenges, take ownership of meaningful work, and help turn ambitious ideas into technologies that make a real-world impact.

  • Provide regular forecasts of the future Change and BAU resources required for the project

  • Provide the project team with direction and confidence to deliver and ensure that the project delivers the required benefits and outcomes within the specified tolerances of time, cost, quality, scope, benefit and risk.

  • Undertake regular lessons learnt sessions during the life of the project, implementing agreed recommendations to ensure the project team learns from experience and proactively shares lessons with the broader Project Management community.

  • Adhere to governance standards, including Project Change Standard and guidelines, maintaining accurate RACI and RAID logs and Service Now records.

  • Produce timely management information ensuring all mandatory documentation (e.g. business case, requirement documents/user stories, stage gates, test plans, change requests, closure documents) is completed and signed off at the appropriate stages during the life of the project and establish appropriate governance to reflect the complexity of the project as required.

  • Forecast future external costs, understand the drivers of project cost variance and take actions to control costs to budgets or raise change control

  • Monitor and report progress to the impacted stakeholders (e.g. sponsor(s), Programme manager, Change Programme Directors, steering committee) including ongoing business case viability.

  • Independently identify and take ownership of issues, risks and dependencies, making recommendations to mitigate the risk or to reduce/remove issues. Escalate where appropriate to maintain progress towards project delivery and act as an escalation point on behalf of the Project Sponsor.

  • Complete handover to BAU, and business benefits realisation activities to close off projects.

  • Manage resource planning and motivate the project team to ensure a high standard of output, focused on customer satisfaction and delivery through developing others through providing ongoing guidance, mentoring or coaching

  • Manage relationships with required teams e.g. Technology, external suppliers and other business functions to achieve timely delivery.

  • Support the Lead Programme Management Officer in establishing appropriate governance and assuring that the Project Change Standard is appropriately applied.

  • Conduct training workshops with Project Managers focused on improving both project and change management capabilities across the Project Management team

Skills and Competencies

  • Confident and effective communicator (both written and verbal) across all levels of the organisation. Confident in facilitating medium to large sized workshops and meetings with stakeholders.

  • Ability to motivate, influence and constructively challenge where appropriate.

  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the business and with external parties including key delivery partners.

  • Strong organisational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, resources, priorities and deliverables to tight deadlines.

  • Passionate about developing a work environment that embraces and values diversity.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to articulate complex ideas/concepts to stakeholders.

  • Well-developed interpersonal skills, leading by example and exercising good judgment and decision making skills.

  • Strong programme budgetary control and financial management

  • Advanced understanding and practical application of project management methodologies

Experience:

  • Financial Services Experience (essential)

  • Primary client contact with regards to all logistical arrangements surrounding congress.
  • Oversight of Client registration and reporting questions.
  • Maintain the highest level of quality, professionalism and integrity when negotiating with suppliers.
  • Partner with internal planning team members to negotiate all supplier contracts for the best possible prices and concessions to meet savings expectation on congress spend.

Core Responsibility 4: People Leadership

  • Project manage team members general workload and performance to ensure deliverables are being met, compliance is adhered to and workload is manageable.

Serves as a training resource and subject matter expert to colleagues:

  • Facilitates components of new hire or process specific training as identified
  • Assists in the development of training tools to aid in process specific training (i.e. air process; end-to-end congress process, shared mailbox management, etc.)
  • Identifies process gaps and partners with Operations Manager to develop operational improvements
  • Serves as a resource to colleagues as a subject matter expert

Serve as a resource internally to colleagues:

  • Provides guidance or assistance to team members as needed to ensure all client deliverables are met and tasks assigned are completed.
  • Provides support to the Local Services Events
  • Provide input for the creation of standard operating processes and best practices

Manages multiple projects and priorities:

  • Manages an average of 4-6 programs simultaneously
  • Effectively prioritizes congress assignments to the team
  • Fosters strong partnerships with Medical Societies and actively participates in stakeholder presentations and implementations to the MSD Global Congress Program
  • Cascades information to team as required
  • Manages governance of escalations (congress and close out)
  • Management of onsite support (Trip Director) assignments

Other:

  • Assume and perform other duties and responsibilities not specifically outlined herein, but which are logically and properly inherent to the position.
  • This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice or as required by local regulations.


Essential Job Functions:

  • Must be able to come to work promptly and regularly
  • Must be able to take direction and work well with others
  • Must be able to work under stress and meet deadlines
  • Must be able to manage change productively

We're looking for you if your profile matches the following:

  • Bachelor’s Degree strongly preferred
  • Minimum of five (5) years’ congress/convention planning/management experience
  • Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in client management
  • Minimum of three (3) years’ attendee management experience
  • Pharmaceutical Industry experience preferred
  • Previous experience with participant registration for congresses
  • Strong customer service experience required
  • International attendee experience a plus
  • Travel industry and destination knowledge
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Must have proven success with various meeting program formats on a small and large scale.
  • Must be able to manage time and prioritize work effectively, be a team player, work independently, meet stringent deadlines, and work well under pressure.
  • Up to 40% travel required.

Transferable Skills:

  • Detail -oriented
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Excellent organization skills
  • Strong customer relations skills and customer-facing skills
  • Problem solving and decision-making ability
  • Proficiency in software programs - Word, Excel, cvent and HTML

THE PERKS

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

title: Erfaren serveringspersonal sökes till vår pärla vid vattnet
description:
Brinner du för värdskap, god mat och välvalda drycker?

Vi på Kajen 11 söker nu en passionerad och skicklig serviskollega för extra pass vid behov. Det här är det perfekta uppdraget för dig som älskar pulsen på golvet, men som även kan sysselsätta sig och se vad som behövs göras vid lugna stunder.

Vår vardag bjuder på stor variation – från fartfyllda helgkvällar till mer rofyllda stunder vid vattnet.

Vi söker dig som drivs av att hitta lösningar snarare än hinder, och som bjuder på ett varmt leende oavsett tempo. Eftersom vi ibland behöver förstärkning med kort varsel ser vi gärna att du bor i Malmö och kan rycka in smidigt när det krisar.

Vi tror att du:

  • Är en trygg yrkesmänniska: Du har en gedigen bakgrund inom servering, har full koll på logistiken på golvet och löser oväntade situationer helt självständigt.
  • Har ett genuint dryckesintresse: Du kan dina drycker, guidar gästerna med säker hand och älskar att lyfta matupplevelsen genom rätt kombinationer i glaset.
  • Är en sann lagspelare: Du har struktur på din station men har inga problem med att hugga i där det behövs bäst för stunden.


Vad vi erbjuder:

En inspirerande och professionell arbetsplats på Kajen 11 med fantastiska gäster, ett nystsrtat team och total flexibilitet för dina arbetstider.

Så söker du (Läs noga):

Vi värdesätter vår tid och svarar endast på ansökningar som matchar profilen ovan.

För att vi ska lära känna dig lite bättre, berätta kort om detta direkt i ditt mejl:

  1. Din expertis: Beskriv din bakgrund inom servering samt din syn på att kombinera mat och dryck.
  2. Dina förutsättningar: Hur ser din tillgänglighet ut, och vad är ditt löneanspråk per timme?
  3. Ditt driv: Ge ett kort exempel på en situation där du löste ett problem på golvet på egen hand.


Skicka din ansökan till info@kajen11.se.

Du måste ange exakt detta i ämnesraden för att vi ska hitta ditt mejl: Servering Kajen 11

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

company: The University of Texas at Austin
description:

Senior Salesforce Developer

Dell Medical School

Job Details:

General Notes

The Senior Salesforce Developer is a hands-on software developer responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting custom and standard solutions across Dell Medical School’s Salesforce ecosystem. Working in partnership with the Senior Salesforce Engineer and business, data, security, and delivery teams, this role translates complex healthcare, fundraising, constituent-engagement, and analytics requirements into secure, scalable applications.

The position develops production-quality Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, automation, and data solutions across Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Data Cloud with Marketing Cloud Next, and Health Cloud. The developer applies disciplined software engineering practices, including source control, automated testing, code review, documentation, and secure handling of PHI/PII, while implementing new Salesforce solutions and improving platform reliability and user experience.

Purpose

The Senior Salesforce Developer designs, develops, tests, deploys, and supports production-grade solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem. This role provides advanced hands-on Salesforce development using Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, APIs, automation, and data technologies while supporting Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Data Cloud with Marketing Cloud Next, and Health Cloud.

The position partners with technical and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions while applying software engineering, DevOps, testing, documentation, privacy, and security best practices.

Responsibilities

Salesforce Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain production-grade Apex classes, triggers, batch and queueable jobs, scheduled processes, platform event handlers, and reusable service-layer components.

  • Build accessible, responsive Lightning Web Components and scalable, performant Apex using secure client-server communication patterns.

  • Create comprehensive unit and integration tests.

  • Refactor legacy Visualforce, Aura, Apex, and automation where appropriate; document design decisions and reduce technical debt without disrupting critical operations.

Cloud Solution Delivery: Nonprofit Cloud, Data Cloud & Health Cloud

  • Develop and extend Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud capabilities supporting fundraising activities.

  • Support Data Cloud ingestion, data streams, mappings, segmentation, and activation, and troubleshoot data quality and harmonization issues.

  • Support Marketing Cloud Next activation and segmentation responsibilities when appropriate.

  • Build Health Cloud solutions supporting outreach to patients, providers, and care teams and supporting service coordination while protecting PHI and PII.

  • Partner with the Senior Salesforce Engineer on scalable solution design.

Integrations, APIs & Data Engineering

  • Develop and support REST and SOAP integrations, Apex callouts, named and external credentials, platform events, Change Data Capture, middleware connections, and secure file-based exchanges.

  • Design reliable integration behavior, including authentication, idempotency, retries, error queues, monitoring, reconciliation, and operational support procedures.

  • Write efficient SOQL and SOSL and support high-volume data loads, migrations, transformations, deduplication, and archival while maintaining referential integrity and auditability.

  • Collaborate with enterprise data, analytics, integration, and security teams on canonical models, Data Cloud pipelines, BI/MDM connections, and interface contracts.

DevOps, Quality Engineering & Release Delivery

  • Use Salesforce DX, version control, package or metadata deployment approaches, and CI/CD pipelines for releases.

  • Participate in estimation, technical design, peer code review, static analysis, automated testing, regression testing, defect triage, and release validation.

  • Diagnose performance, automation, integration, sharing, and data issues using logs and platform monitoring; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.

  • Maintain technical documentation, release notes, runbooks, dependency maps, and support handoffs.

  • Contribute to coding standards and reusable development patterns.

Technical Collaboration & Support

  • Work within an Agile delivery team to refine requirements, define acceptance criteria, demonstrate completed solutions, and communicate technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Provide advanced production support and participate in planned after-hours release windows or critical incident response as needed.

  • Mentor developers and administrators through pairing, code reviews, documentation, and practical guidance on secure Salesforce development.

Marginal or Periodic Functions

  • Build prototypes or technical spikes to evaluate Salesforce releases, new platform capabilities, AppExchange products, and integration approaches.

  • Support access reviews, security assessments, audit evidence collection, disaster-recovery exercises, and remediation of code or configuration vulnerabilities.

  • Assist with production data corrections, deployment coordination, environment refreshes, and post-release validation.

  • Contribute to project planning, vendor technical reviews, and statements of work when development dependencies or estimates are required.

  • Create knowledge-transfer materials and provide technical enablement for administrators, analysts, support teams, and super users.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Technical Learning / Functional/Technical Skills

  • Advanced Apex development, including triggers, classes, interfaces, asynchronous processing, callouts, platform events, security enforcement, and test automation.

  • Advanced Lightning Web Components development using modern JavaScript with consideration for accessibility, performance, and user interface design.

  • Hands-on implementation experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Data Cloud, and Health Cloud, including core data models, security considerations, and extension patterns.

  • Strong knowledge of SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce APIs, integration patterns, Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD, metadata deployment, debugging, and platform limits.

  • Working knowledge of declarative Salesforce capabilities necessary to integrate custom code with platform configuration.

Decision Quality

  • Select appropriate synchronous or asynchronous patterns and balance custom code, declarative tools, managed products, and external services.

  • Anticipate governor limits, data volume, concurrency, security, maintainability, and failure modes before implementation.

  • Use evidence from logs, testing, monitoring, and user impact to prioritize and resolve defects.

Collaborates

  • Partner effectively with the Senior Salesforce Engineer, product owners, administrators, data engineers, integration teams, security, compliance, vendors, and operational stakeholders.

  • Participate constructively in design and code reviews, incorporate feedback, and clearly explain technical choices.

  • Translate business workflows into implementable stories, technical designs, and acceptance criteria.

Manages Complexity

  • Break complex, cross-cloud requirements into modular components with clear boundaries, dependencies, and test strategies.

  • Analyze multi-system data flows, identity resolution, event-driven processes, API contracts, and high-volume data behavior.

  • Maintain reliable solutions across multiple environments, release trains, and integration dependencies.

Ensures Accountability

  • Own code quality and delivery outcomes from design through production support and follow through on defects, documentation, and operational readiness.

  • Meet security, privacy, accessibility, testing, and change-control requirements and raise risks early.

  • Provide transparent estimates, status updates, dependencies, and technical risks to delivery partners.

Business Acumen

  • Understand nonprofit fundraising and program operations, healthcare workflows, constituent or patient engagement, and the responsible use of unified customer data.

  • Balance mission impact, user experience, compliance, delivery speed, licensing cost, and long-term maintainability.

  • Recognize how data quality, consent, privacy, and system reliability affect operational and clinical-adjacent outcomes.

Communicates Effectively

  • Produce concise technical designs, diagrams, code comments, release notes, runbooks, and incident findings.

  • Explain complex development topics, risks, and tradeoffs in language appropriate for engineers, leaders, and business users.

  • Communicate clearly during releases and incidents and document decisions for auditability and knowledge continuity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Six years of professional software development experience, including at least four years of hands-on Salesforce development using Apex and Lightning technologies and at least two years delivering complex enterprise Salesforce solutions.

  • Production implementation experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, Data Cloud, and Health Cloud.

  • Experience with Salesforce integrations, including APIs, Apex, and SOQL.

Equivalent education and experience may be substituted.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Salesforce in healthcare, higher education, philanthropy, fundraising, or nonprofit program environments.

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or a related field.

  • Salesforce Certified Developer or Administrator.

  • Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud.

Licenses/Registrations/Certifications

Required

  • None specified in the finalized JD.

Preferred

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I.

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II.

  • Salesforce JavaScript Developer I.

  • Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant.

  • Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Consultant.

  • Salesforce Health Cloud Accredited Professional or equivalent role-relevant credential.

$99,139+ depending on qualifications

Working Conditions

We are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Engineer to join our US team and play a key role in Cyolo’s continued growth in North America.

title: Service Management Lead
description:
14th August, 2026

Why work for Brennan?

At Brennan, we aim to lead, not follow. One of the ways we do this is through an open diverse culture that values performance, where anyone in the team can bring new ideas to the table and see them thrive. Our people are empowered, considerate, supportive, trusting and accepting, they are the cornerstone of the business. Because of this approach, we have become the largest Australian owned systems integrator in Australia and continue to grow.

Brennan offers an excellent remuneration package and benefits including:

  • A focus on health and well-being - social club, sporting teams, health checks, poker, trivia nights and more!
  • A strong culture underpinned by values that are truly lived every day
  • An environment that embraces learning and development of all employees
  • Flexibility to work in the way that brings out the best in you
  • High levels of reward and recognition for overachieving
The Role

This is a senior customer-facing Service Management role responsible for leading Change Management and driving Service Management outcomes for a strategic managed services customer.
Working from our Brisbane offices you will regularly work on customer site also in Brisbane, so locally based candidates will only be considered.
The primary focus of the role is ownership of the Change Management function, ensuring changes are assessed, authorised, communicated and implemented in a controlled manner that protects service stability and meets customer expectations.
The role also provides leadership and oversight for Problem Management and broader Service Management disciplines, ensuring the MSP consistently delivers against contractual obligations, agreed customer processes and service governance requirements.
Working closely with customer stakeholders, resolver groups, Service Delivery Managers and operational teams, the role drives operational excellence, continual improvement and service maturity across the account.
This role is not a process owner or practice leader. The customer owns the Service Management processes; this role ensures those processes are effectively executed, governed and continually improved within the managed services environment.

Responsibilities

Change Management Leadership
  • Lead and operate the Change Management function for the customer account.
  • Chair and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and associated governance forums.
  • Ensure changes are appropriately assessed, planned, approved and implemented in accordance with agreed processes.
  • Manage change-related risks, conflicts, escalations and service impacts.
  • Drive improvements in change quality, success rates and operational outcomes.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to technical and operational teams on change governance and best practice.
Problem Management Oversight and Leadership
  • Provide oversight and leadership for Problem Management activities.
  • Coach and support the Problem Manager to deliver effective outcomes.
  • Ensure recurring issues are investigated, root causes identified and corrective actions implemented.
  • Drive service stability through proactive problem management and trend analysis.
Service Management Governance and Uplift
  • Provide governance and oversight across ITIL-aligned Service Management practices.
  • Ensure teams adhere to agreed customer processes, procedures and operational standards.
  • Lead service improvement initiatives focused on service quality, efficiency and customer outcomes.
  • Facilitate workshops and education sessions to improve service management maturity across resolver groups.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for Service Management matters. Promote practical ITIL-aligned ways of working that improve service outcomes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Support continual improvement initiatives that improve service stability, operational efficiency, customer experience and compliance.
  • Ensure Service Management governance supports both operational delivery and contractual accountability.

Customer & Commercial Management
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders.
  • Represent the MSP in operational and governance forums.
  • Ensure services are delivered in line with contractual obligations and agreed scope.
  • Identify and manage risks associated with service delivery, governance and compliance.
  • Work closely with Service Delivery Managers and account leadership to ensure alignment between customer expectations, operational delivery and contractual commitments.
Knowledge & Operational Excellence
  • Ensure procedures, work instructions and knowledge articles are maintained and remain fit for purpose.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and operational consistency across support teams.
  • Support the effective use and continual improvement of the ITSM platform, including Cherwell.

Skills/Experience

Essential
  • Significant experience in ICT Change Management within enterprise or managed services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL-based Service Management practices.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Change Advisory Boards and managing complex change environments.
  • Experience with Problem Management and service improvement initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.
  • Experience working within contractual service delivery environments.

title: Safeguarding Lead – Children and Young Person Service
description:
Safeguarding Lead – Children and Young Person Service

REF:QS001

United Kingdom (Remote)

Reporting to: Head of Safeguarding

Remuneration: £35,500 - £43,000 per annum - plus £1,000 WFH allowance

Contract Type: ﻿Permanent/ Full time - 40 hours per week

Location: Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required

Closing Date for applications: Wednesday 9th September*

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The Children and Young Person Safeguarding Lead will provide specialist safeguarding advice, leadership and support across Psychiatry UK’s Children and Young Person Service.

The role will support clinicians and operational teams to identify, assess, manage and escalate safeguarding concerns appropriately and ensure practice remains child-centred, proportionate and aligned with relevant legislation, statutory guidance and organisational policy.

The role will provide expertise in areas including child protection, parental responsibility, consent and confidentiality, Gillick competence, domestic abuse, exploitation, contextual safeguarding, online harms, self-harm and suicide risk.

Working closely with the Head of Safeguarding, Quality and Safety colleagues and external agencies, the role will also support safeguarding governance, supervision, training, audit and service improvement.

This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), though occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK.

As our Children and Young Person Safeguarding Lead, you will:

  • Provide specialist safeguarding advice and support to clinicians, operational teams and senior leaders working with children and young people.

  • Support identification, assessment, management and escalation of safeguarding concerns.

  • Provide advice on child protection, parental responsibility, consent, confidentiality, information sharing, Gillick competence and best-interest decision making.

  • Support complex cases involving abuse, neglect, exploitation, domestic abuse, contextual safeguarding, online harms, self-harm and suicide risk.

  • Complete or support safeguarding referrals to Children’s Social Care and other relevant agencies.

  • Develop and communicate clear safeguarding management plans.

  • Provide timely advice in relation to high-risk or urgent safeguarding concerns.

  • Work collaboratively with local authority Children’s Services, education providers, NHS organisations, police, safeguarding partnerships and third-sector organisations.

  • Attend child protection conferences, strategy discussions, case conferences and other multi-agency meetings where required.

  • Support clinicians in preparing safeguarding reports and information for external agencies.

  • Provide safeguarding supervision and support reflective practice across the Children and Young Person Service.

  • Contribute to safeguarding training, guidance and learning resources for staff.

  • Support audits, safeguarding reviews, incident learning and quality-improvement activity.

  • Monitor safeguarding themes, trends and risks and contribute to reports, dashboards and governance updates.

  • Support development and review of safeguarding policies, procedures, pathways and care plans.

  • Ensure internal safeguarding alerts on the RADAR system are responded to in a timely manner and workflow and investigation requirements are completed.

  • In the case of external reporting to either the police or local authorities, ensure that completed RADAR reports are forwarded in PDF format to the Quality and Safety Clinical Governance Lead for forwarding to CQC.

  • Work with the Head of Safeguarding and IT colleagues to ensure RADAR and other digital processes remain fit for purpose in keeping with the dynamic changes of Psychiatry-UK and its patient's needs.

  • Contribute to safeguarding reviews and implementation of recommendations and lessons learned.

  • Ensure safeguarding is embedded throughout the CYP patient journey from referral to discharge.

  • Promote a culture in which safeguarding is recognised as everyone’s responsibility.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential and contemporaneous safeguarding records.

  • Escalate significant safeguarding or organisational risks to the Head of Safeguarding.

  • Contribute to PUK Safeguarding Committee and other relevant governance meetings.

  • Maintain up-to-date specialist safeguarding knowledge and undertake relevant continuing professional development.

Remote and Digital Safeguarding

  • Support clinicians to manage safeguarding concerns identified during video, telephone and digital consultations.

  • Advise on verification of a child or young person’s identity, current location, parental responsibility and emergency contacts where required.

  • Support urgent escalation where immediate safeguarding risks are identified remotely.

  • Help ensure appropriate local authority and emergency services are identified for children and families across different geographical areas.

  • Maintain awareness of online safety, digital harms and emerging safeguarding risks within remote healthcare.

To succeed as our Children and Young Person Safeguarding Lead, you will be:

An experienced children and young person’s safeguarding professional with strong safeguarding knowledge, sound professional judgement and the ability to manage complex and sensitive situations. You will demonstrate excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to provide expert advice, appropriately challenge practice and escalate concerns when required. You will be highly organised, resilient and able to prioritise effectively, work autonomously and collaboratively, make proportionate and defensible decisions, and communicate sensitively with children, young people, families and professionals.

Essential Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Registered healthcare or social care professional with an appropriate professional body.

  • Safeguarding Children Level 4 training or equivalent specialist safeguarding qualification.

  • Significant experience of safeguarding children and young people within healthcare, mental health, social care or a related setting.

  • Strong working knowledge of safeguarding legislation, statutory guidance and child protection processes.

  • Knowledge of the Children Act 1989 and 2004 and Working Together to Safeguard Children.

  • Knowledge of parental responsibility, consent, confidentiality, Gillick competence and information sharing.

  • Knowledge of domestic abuse, exploitation, contextual safeguarding and online harms.

  • Experience of multi-agency safeguarding working.

  • Experience of safeguarding supervision.

  • Experience of complex safeguarding risk assessment and decision-making.

  • Experience of delivering safeguarding training or education.

  • Ability to provide clear, proportionate and defensible safeguarding advice.

  • Good report-writing, governance and IT skills.

Desirable Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Experience of remote or digital healthcare.

  • Recent specialist safeguarding children training.

  • Experience of developing safeguarding training programmes.

  • Experience of audit, quality improvement or policy development.

  • Experience of preparing safeguarding assurance for CQC, NHS commissioners or other regulatory bodies.

Psychiatry UK: Supporting You

We want you to enjoy your work while feeling healthy, happy, and appreciated. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed with you in mind. You’ll have access to a range of wellbeing perks, including a Health Cash Plan, Well Hub Subscription, access to an Employee Assistance Programme, Annual Volunteering Day, Enhanced Sickness and Family Leave pay, Length of Service Bonus, Work from Home allowance and Pension options.

At Psychiatry UK, we care about what matters to you.

title: Technical Lead – IFS
description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.

We empower people through technology

Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.

At Wilhelmsen, empowering people through technology is more than an aspiration. It defines how we work and how we continue to shape the future of the maritime industry. As part of our digital transformation journey, we are continuously investing in and modernizing our ERP landscape, ensuring our IFS Cloud platform remains evergreen, scalable, and aligned with the needs of a global business.

To strengthen our ERP organization, we are looking for an experienced Technical Lead who will play a key role in designing, developing, and evolving our IFS Cloud platform. This is an exciting opportunity for a technology-driven professional who enjoys combining technical leadership, architecture, integration, and platform governance to deliver business-critical solutions.

Our ERP platform is the operational backbone of a significant part of Wilhelmsen's global operations. As Technical Lead, you will be instrumental in ensuring the platform remains reliable, innovative, and capable of supporting future business growth.

If you are collaborative, curious, self-driven, and passionate about technology, we would love to hear from you.

Your future duties and responsibilities

As Technical Lead, you will be responsible for the technical direction and delivery of our IFS Cloud platform and related enterprise applications.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Lead the technical design, development, and continuous improvement of the IFS Cloud platform.
  • Review, approve, and govern technical designs, customizations, extensions, and code quality.
  • Establish and enforce development standards, documentation practices, and technical governance.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to developers, consultants, and solution architects.

Platform Development & Enhancements

  • Support system configuration, enhancements, upgrades, and implementation of new functionality.
  • Evaluate existing solutions and identify opportunities for optimization, automation, and innovation.
  • Ensure solutions align with both business requirements and long-term platform strategy.

Integration & Enterprise Connectivity

  • Own the planning, design, and implementation of integrations between IFS Cloud and enterprise systems, including CRM, maintenance, logistics, financial, and third-party applications.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define integration requirements and technical solutions.
  • Ensure integrations are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.

Release Management & Platform Operations

  • Design and execute application deployment and release strategies with minimal business disruption.
  • Oversee development, testing, build, and production environments.
  • Manage deployment pipelines, build processes, version control, and release governance.
  • Monitor platform performance, reliability, and stability while driving continuous improvements.
  • Provide technical support and guidance during development, testing, and deployment activities.

Business Partnership & Vendor Management

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, improve processes, and deliver business value.
  • Collaborate with solution architects and provide direction to external vendors responsible for development and support activities.
  • Participate in evaluating and assuring the quality of technical solution proposals.
  • Act as a trusted advisor for technical capabilities, architecture decisions, and ERP roadmap initiatives.

Qualifications and skills we are looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience with IFS Applications and/or IFS Cloud. Minimum 10+ years of experience.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise application architecture, integrations, and ERP ecosystems.
  • Experience leading technical teams and guiding developers across complex initiatives.
  • Expertise in IFS customizations, extensions, reporting, and deployment processes.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, DevOps principles, and release management.
  • Excellent business process understanding combined with strong technical capabilities.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively across business and technical communities and build strong stakeholder relationships.
  • Highly structured, proactive, and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Personal characteristics

  • Technology-driven and passionate about innovation.
  • Curious and eager to learn new technologies and share knowledge with others.
  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a global environment.
  • Self-motivated and able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Committed to delivering high-quality solutions that create business value.

What we offer

At Wilhelmsen, you will join a highly competent ERP organization at the center of a major business transformation. We offer:

  • The opportunity to shape the future of a global IFS Cloud platform.
  • Exposure to large-scale international business processes and technology initiatives.
  • A collaborative environment with experienced professionals passionate about digital transformation.
  • Strong leadership, career development opportunities, and continuous learning.
  • A culture that values innovation, flexibility, and work-life balance.

Work Location: India or Malaysia

If you are excited about leading the technical evolution of a business-critical ERP platform and want to make a global impact through technology, we encourage you to apply.

Join us and help shape the future of Wilhelmsen Ships Service's IFS Cloud platform while delivering technology solutions that create value across our global business.

title: Product Researcher for eCom Brands
description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Researcher whose main responsibility is simple: find winning products and winning creatives before everyone else does.

You will spend your days analyzing products, competitors, ads, trends, and creative angles across different markets. Your research will directly determine which products our marketing team launches and scales.

This is a highly performance-driven role. The better the products you find perform, the more you earn.

What you'll do

  • Find high-potential and winning products for our e-commerce stores

  • Identify products that are starting to scale before they become saturated

  • Find winning ads, creatives, hooks, angles, and offers

  • Analyze competitors and understand what they are successfully scaling

  • Research trends across Meta, TikTok and other advertising channels

  • Analyze indicators such as ad longevity, advertiser activity, engagement, creative variations and scaling behavior

  • Build organized shortlists of products and creatives for our marketing team to test

  • Continuously improve the research process based on which products actually perform

  • Discover new tools, data sources and methods that give us an advantage

Tools you should know

You should already be highly proficient with product and ad research tools such as:

  • TrendTrack

  • Foreplay

  • BigSpy

  • AdSpy

  • Minea

  • Meta Ad Library

  • TikTok Creative Center

  • Other product research, ad-spy and competitor intelligence tools

We don't expect you to simply know how to use these tools. We expect you to understand how to interpret the data and recognize opportunities that other researchers miss.

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in e-commerce product research

  • Strong experience researching products for DTC/e-commerce brands

  • Proven ability to identify winning products

  • Proven ability to identify winning creatives and advertising angles

  • Advanced knowledge of multiple ad-spy and product-research platforms

  • Strong understanding of paid social advertising, especially Meta and TikTok

  • Good understanding of what makes a direct-response creative convert

  • Data-driven and analytical

  • Fast researcher who can analyze large numbers of products without sacrificing quality

  • Naturally curious and constantly looking for new trends, competitors and opportunities

Compensation & Performance Bonuses

This role includes a base salary + performance bonuses.

Your bonuses are directly connected to the success of the products you discover.

When our marketing team launches a product you found and successfully scales it, you receive bonuses based on the advertising spend generated by that product.

This means there is significant upside for researchers who consistently identify products that we can scale.

Find average products → earn your base salary.

Find products we spend hundreds of thousands or millions advertising → earn significantly more.

Who we're looking for

We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions on exactly what to search for.

We want someone who is obsessed with finding the next winner.

You should enjoy digging through thousands of ads, spotting patterns, investigating competitors, discovering new tools and figuring out why certain products and creatives are scaling.

Your performance is measurable: How many of the products you find become winners, and how much advertising spend can we profitably deploy behind them?

If you have a strong track record in e-commerce product research and want your compensation to directly reflect the value of the winners you discover, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Threat Researcher
description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security research, red-teaming, penetration testing, incident response, or vulnerability research.
  • Strong understanding of network and application security, including core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS), web technologies, modern APIs, and real-world application- and network-layer exploitation techniques (e.g., OWASP API Security Top 10).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (using Python, Bash, or equivalent).
  • Hands-on experience developing, customizing, using, or conducting research supporting vulnerability scanners (DAST / SAST / Network / Host scanners), writing detection rules, or building automated vulnerability and exploitability validation tools.
  • Strong sense of ownership and the ability to independently lead projects from research to delivery.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills in both English and Hebrew.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with developing or researching cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with security aspects of Kubernetes, containers, and/or CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar.
  • Familiar with network and application scanning tools (Burp Suite, nmap, Metasploit, Nuclei, or similar).
  • Published security research, exploits/PoCs, or contributed to open-source security tooling.

About the job

As a Threat Researcher in Exposure & Risk Detection, you will drive research projects end-to-end to identify emerging threats, CVEs, and misconfigurations, assessing their real-world exploitability and customer impact. In this role, you will investigate cloud services, frameworks, and commonly deployed technologies to uncover new attack surfaces, and build automations to validate, benchmark, and monitor AI-driven detection capabilities at scale. You will collaborate closely with Product and R&D teams to transform research findings and attack methodologies into impactful product capabilities, directly shaping how our customers stay secure.

Check out some of our recent research:

  • The Red Agent POV: How it Reasoned its Way to SSRF
  • Under the Radar: Exploring Spring Boot Actuator Misconfigurations
  • Beyond CVEs: The Exploitation of Everyday Misconfigurations
  • React2Shell: Technical Deep-Dive & In-the-Wild Exploitation of CVE-2025-55182

Responsibilities

  • Research emerging threats, CVEs, and misconfigurations to assess real-world exploitability and customer impact.
  • Design, build, and test detection rules and scanning logic for exposed and vulnerable assets.
  • Build automations to validate, benchmark, and monitor AI-driven detection capabilities at scale.
  • Investigate cloud services, frameworks, and commonly deployed technologies to uncover new attack surfaces.
  • Analyze large-scale scan results to identify and prioritize meaningful risks.
  • Drive research projects end-to-end, from initial idea to production-ready detection.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and R&D teams to transform research findings and attack methodologies into impactful product capabilities.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need for visa sponsorship. This role does not offer visa sponsorship.

description:

In this role, you will lead end-to-end technical initiatives—architecting and deploying new Microsoft 365/Azure environments, taking over and remediating legacy client infrastructures, building custom Intune kiosk profiles, managing Google Workspace, optimizing licensing, and responding to complex security incidents.

Beyond hands-on engineering, you will act as the primary technical point of contact and project manager on complex client projects. You will interface directly with senior client leadership, evaluate and coordinate with third-party vendors, present analytical reports, and deliver proactive infrastructure roadmaps. Additionally, you will handle Tier 3 escalations and assist the broader team with Tier 1/2 ticket overflow during peak volumes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Project Management & Client Leadership: Serve as the primary technical contact and project manager for complex client onboardings, infrastructure overhauls, and cloud migrations. Lead project scoping, timeline management, milestone tracking, and direct status communications with senior client staff and executive management.

  • M365 Tenant Architecture & Licensing: Build, configure, and secure new Microsoft 365 tenants from the ground up. Audit, assign, and optimize Microsoft 365 licensing tiers (Business, Enterprise, Add-ons) to ensure maximum feature adoption and cost efficiency.

  • Exchange Online & Email Security: Manage complex Exchange Online environments, mail flow rules, shared mailboxes, hygiene policies, retention tags, and email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

  • Security Incident Response & Advisory: Act as an incident lead to detect, triage, contain, and remediate complex security incidents (e.g., account compromises, phishing outbreaks, malware/ransomware alerts). Advise client leadership and internal teams on root cause analysis and immediate containment strategies.

  • Proactive Enhancements & Advisory: Continuously assess client environments against CIS, NIST, and HIPAA security benchmarks. Identify vulnerabilities, bottlenecks, and obsolete configurations, proactively delivering actionable improvement roadmaps to management.

  • Reporting & Analytical Insights: Generate, analyze, and present regular reports regarding tenant health, endpoint compliance, security posture, ticket trends, and license utilization for both internal review and executive client presentations.

  • Vendor Research & Tool Evaluation: Research, evaluate, and vet emerging IT vendors, hardware models, and cloud software solutions. Present comparative analyses and recommendations to support procurement and client project decisions.

  • Endpoint Management & Custom Kiosk Deployments: Design, deploy, and maintain device profiles using Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM). Architect and deploy custom Intune-managed Kiosk mode implementations (single-app and multi-app dedicated devices) for specialized client workflows.

  • Identity & Access Management: Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Conditional Access policies, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign-On (SSO), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and hybrid identity configurations.

  • Environment Takeovers & Migrations: Audit, document, and remediate inherited Microsoft 365 and Azure environments when onboarding new clients from previous IT vendors. Execute seamless tenant-to-tenant and on-premises-to-cloud migrations.

  • Multi-Platform & Vendor Collaboration: Administer Google Workspace tenants and collaborate with third-party software developers to ensure seamless API integrations and adherence to compliance baselines.

  • VoIP & Telephony Support: Configure and manage cloud VoIP systems, softphones, call routing, auto-attendants, and Microsoft Teams Phone integrations.

  • Escalations & Team Support: Serve as the Tier 3 escalation lead for complex technical roadblocks while stepping in to assist with Tier 1 and Tier 2 ticket overflow as business demand requires.

  • Scripting & Automation: Utilize PowerShell to automate administrative tasks, tenant provisioning, reporting, and bulk policy updates across M365 and Azure environments.

  • Documentation & SOPs: Author comprehensive standard operating procedures (SOPs), incident response runbooks, network topology maps, and client transition guides.

Required Qualifications

  • Location: Must be legally residing and eligible to work as an independent contractor in Argentina.

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on IT systems, networking, and cloud administration experience, with at least 2+ years in an MSP or multi-tenant enterprise environment.

  • Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience serving as a project manager or primary technical liaison, successfully driving IT initiatives while interfacing directly with C-suite and executive client stakeholders.

  • Microsoft Cloud & Licensing Mastery: Deep, demonstrable expertise in Microsoft 365 tenant administration, Exchange Online mail flow, Entra ID, and licensing structure optimization.

  • Security & Incident Response: Proven experience investigating and responding to security incidents, analyzing audit logs, and configuring threat protection policies (e.g., Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint).

  • Endpoint & Kiosk Engineering: Proven hands-on experience configuring Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, compliance baselines, Win32 application packaging, and dedicated Intune Kiosk mode profiles.

  • Reporting & Analytical Skills: Ability to extract, analyze, and synthesize raw tenant and infrastructure data into actionable executive summaries and health reports.

  • Multi-Platform Administration: Experience administering Google Workspace alongside Microsoft environments.

  • Telephony & Networking: Experience supporting cloud VoIP telephony systems and core networking fundamentals (firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, DHCP).

  • Scripting: Strong working knowledge of PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 and Entra automation.

  • Language & Communication: Fluent/Bilingual English proficiency (C1/C2 level) with superior verbal and written communication skills suitable for high-stakes executive interaction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, SC-200: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst, SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator, AZ-104: Azure Administrator, or MD-102: Endpoint Administrator).

  • Formal project management training or certifications (e.g., CAPM, PMP, Agile/Scrum) is a strong plus.

  • Deep understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2, CIS Controls).

  • Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, and modern RMM/PSA platforms.

  • Familiarity with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam, Datto, Acronis).

Work Environment & Expectations

  • 100% Remote: Must maintain a dedicated, quiet home office setup with high-speed, reliable fiber/broadband internet and backup power solutions.

  • Availability: Active, accessible, and responsive via Teams, email, and VoIP throughout standard US operating hours.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior Data Engineer


Vacancy Information

  • Location: London, UK
  • Salary: Competitive
  • Working Pattern: Hybrid, 3 days per week in the office
  • Contract Type: Permanent
  • Working Hours: Monday to Friday


At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.


Our Values

Five shared commitments shape how we work, and how we will work with you:

  • Value Every Voice. We put people first.
  • Act with Integrity. We do what is right.
  • Explore Beyond Boundaries. We are driven by curiosity.
  • Own the Outcome. We take responsibility for our decisions.
  • Succeed Together. We have each other's backs.


The Role


We’re building TTC’s Data & AI capability, and this role sits at the heart of it. You’ll design and deliver data products that power analytics, data science, AI and commercial decision-making across a global business, using customer, booking, digital, marketing, commercial and operational data. Working in a modern Snowflake ecosystem, you’ll partner with engineers, analysts, data scientists, Product and Architecture to solve complex business problems and create trusted, reusable data. With the platform still evolving, you’ll help shape standards, patterns and architecture, mentor others, and influence how the team works—while remaining hands-on with the technology from day one onward globally.


What Will You Do?

  • Build scalable, production-grade pipelines and reusable data products that teams across the business genuinely rely on.
  • Model our most important customer and commercial entities so the business works from one trusted version of the truth.
  • Engineer solutions in Snowflake, SQL, Python and modern transformation tooling such as dbt.
  • Raise the bar on testing, data quality, observability, version control and CI/CD, and make good practice the default.
  • Tune workloads for performance, resilience, scalability and sensible cloud cost.
  • Lead technically through design reviews, code reviews and hands-on mentoring.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product and Architecture to unlock advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  • Define the reusable engineering patterns that lift the technical maturity of the whole platform.


About You

Essential

  • Substantial data engineering experience in a sophisticated, production-scale environment.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in SQL and Python.
  • Strong Snowflake experience, or equivalent depth in another modern cloud data platform.
  • A proven track record designing ELT and ETL pipelines and analytical data models.
  • Practical experience with dbt, orchestration frameworks, Git and CI/CD.
  • A genuine commitment to data quality, testing and observability.
  • Sound engineering judgement, knowing when to build for the long term and when to ship.
  • The credibility to lead technically, influence design decisions and lift standards around you.

Desirable

  • Experience with complex customer, transactional or behavioural datasets.
  • Experience in an agile, product-led delivery environment.
  • Exposure to data products that support data science or AI use cases.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers or shaping engineering standards.
  • Curiosity about travel, hospitality or global consumer businesses.


Apply Now

If you want to build the data foundations behind how millions of people see the world, we would like to hear from you. Apply today, and tell us what you would want to build first.

title: Lead Automation Tester in JS

  • Manage test data and coordinate environment orchestration
  • Lead code reviews for automation codebases
  • Eliminate flaky tests and improve the reliability of test execution
  • Mentor and guide mid-level and junior Quality Engineers

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in Quality Engineering or Test Automation, including demonstrated work in a Senior QE capacity

  • Practical knowledge of test architecture design, test data handling, and environment management

Benefits

  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses

title: Finance Administrator M/F
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Finance Administrator to join our finance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing financial transactions, maintaining accurate records, and supporting various accounting functions using a range of accounting software. We are looking for someone who loves variety, ingenuity, and creative problem solving. Our ideal candidate will have strong communication, organization, and computer skills (Excel, Outlook, Word). You will need a minimum of three to five years of experience. Post-secondary education is regarded as an asset. Significant previous experience will be taken into consideration.

Responsibilities

  • Process a high volume of vendor and subcontractor invoices accurately and efficiently.
  • Match invoices to purchase orders, contracts, and receiving documentation.
  • Verify coding and obtain appropriate approvals before processing payments.
  • Prepare and process cheque runs, electronic payments, and wire transfers.
  • Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, including tax and banking information.
  • Monitor aging reports and ensure payments are made according to agreed terms.
  • Assist with month-end closing activities, accruals, and account reconciliations
  • Process employee expense reports and corporate credit card transactions.
  • Respond to vendor inquiries professionally and promptly.
  • Support audit requests and provide required documentation.
  • Assist with continuous improvement of accounts payable processes and internal controls.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, GST/PST requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Demonstrating high attention to detail, strong analytic and problem-solving skills, and ability to multi task

Requirements

  • Education is considered an asset in the field of business/finance/accounting or related field
  • Minimum 2 years of accounts payable experience, preferably within the construction industry.
  • Knowledge of construction billing, subcontractor management, holdbacks, and project costing is considered an asset.
  • Familiar using accounting software
  • Proficient using Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to take initiative with excellent communication skills

What We Offer

  • Competitive Wages in the $55k to $70k range depending on qualifications
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
  • Group retirement savings program.
  • Paid vacation and personal days.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • Supportive team environment with opportunities for growth and advancement.

This role operates primarily on a remote working arrangement that will require little to no travel into our Coventry head office or various campuses. Our working model arrangements are a non-contractual benefit so please note that an Arden work location is added to our employment contracts.

About Arden University:

We are an aspirational and multi-award-winning university, delivering rapid growth with ambitious plans to disrupt the HE sector through our passion for innovation and digital education. Our vision is to become the first-choice university for career-focused lifelong learners worldwide, ensuring that everyone, everywhere can access higher education, by leading the thoughtful integration of AI into teaching and learning and equipping our students to thrive in an AI-enabled world.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines, forge worldwide partnerships, and expand our locations.

About our Department:

The Functional Consultant (Salesforce) sits within our Technology Department that is crucial to making sure our employees and students can work effectively, deliver projects, find the right solutions and ensure we develop the technology that will make the biggest difference.

Our IT team is made up of around 65 employees with a vast range of skills from Software Development to IT Operations and Security.

Our IT Department values employee development and we have lots of great examples of employee

About the Opportunity:

Join Arden University as a Salesforce Functional Consultant and play a key role in maximising the value of our Salesforce platform across the University. Working primarily across Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, you'll help shape how Salesforce supports our people, processes and student experience.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to understand business needs, translate requirements into effective solutions, and deliver configuration and enhancements that make a real difference. From improving processes and data quality to supporting users and driving adoption, you'll be involved in continuously evolving the platform to meet the University's changing needs.

As Arden continues to grow and transform digitally, this is an exciting opportunity to join our Salesforce team and help shape a platform that delivers lasting value across the organisation.

About You:

If you're passionate about Salesforce, enjoy solving business challenges through technology, and want to make a real impact in a purpose-driven organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Essential skills / experience:

  • 3 years minimum Salesforce administration within a business environment.

  • Strong declarative configuration capabilities, including Flows, reports, dashboards, fields, layouts and automation.

  • Supporting Salesforce users within a service or operational environment.

  • Good understanding of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud functionality.

  • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into effective Salesforce solutions.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence supporting and guiding non-technical users.

  • Experience working within Agile or service-delivery environments.

  • Strong attention to detail with a proactive approach to system improvement and problem-solving.

Desirable skills / experience:

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant or Service Cloud Consultant certification.

  • Knowledge of Salesforce Omni-Channel.

  • Delivering user training and creating clear system documentation.

  • Experience working within a large, complex organisation or Higher Education environment.

  • Familiarity with Jira or similar work management tools.

Why Arden:

At Arden, you will become a part of a passionate and dedicated team who are committed to removing unnecessary barriers to learning and making education more accessible. Our people work hard to ensure our students journeys are the best they can possibly be, as such we want to reward our people with fantastic benefits. Employees benefit from:

  • 30 days holiday + bank holidays on-top, and even a Christmas closure!

  • A generous Aviva pension plan, company contributions starting from 7%

  • BUPA Cash Plan

  • Private Medical Insurance coverage (applies to certain job roles)

  • We support your development and encourage (and fund in most cases) Salesforce certifications / exam costs

  • Annual team trip to Salesforce / Agentforce world event in London.

  • Access to Perkbox benefits

  • Study any Arden course for free, with a discount for all family and friends

  • Plus, other excellent benefits

  • Our ‘Golden Ticket’ which allows you to gift anyone in your life a free Arden education

Our Values:

Stand out, Progressive, Accessible, Resourceful, Kindness, reflect who we are as an institution, a team and as individuals. If they also reflect you and you are excited by the chance to be the driving, creative force within a growing business, we want to hear from you.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines and locations.

Closing Date:7th September

We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the specified closing date should we receive sufficient applications or in order to respond to business needs. In order to avoid missing an opportunity to apply please submit your application as early as possible.

If you are a current Arden student or have an upcoming course with us, you are not eligible to apply for Student Experience roles due to a conflict of interest related to system access.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion:

Arden University is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. This means that if you have a disability, as defined by the Disability Equality Act 2010, you may be guaranteed an interview if you meet the essential criteria for the role.

For more details on what qualifies as a disability under the Disability Equality Act 2010, please refer to the guidance here.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Therefore, we make sure that our recruitment and selection processes never discriminate based upon people's age, disability, gender, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or other personal circumstances, and actively welcome applications from all groups.

title: Press Brake Operator - 2nd Shift
description:
2nd Shift Press Break Operator: Monday through Thursday 5:00pm to 3:30am


Who We Are:


We build products and relationships that last a lifetime! No really, that’s what we do. We are a successful family business with a long-term record of steady growth, and we are determined to accelerate our trajectory. Our diverse team members who speak 22 languages are passionate about their company and their co-workers. We reward for performance.

Check out our website at


We Are Not:

  • Fancy - as manufacturers we believe practical, clean facilities are required to make quality products and retain the best team.
  • Transactional - we have long-term relationships with our team members and most valuable customers.
  • Satisfied - we celebrate achievement, then set our sights on new goals.

What We're Looking For:


We are seeking a reliable and motivated Press Brake Operator to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you will be responsible for setting up, adjusting, and operating press brake machinery to bend, shape, and form heavy-duty American steel components for our industrial storage products. You will read technical blueprints, select the proper tooling, and conduct rigorous quality checks to ensure our products maintain their signature "obsessively overbuilt" standard. This position requires strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, physical stamina, and an uncompromising commitment to safety.

  • Passion for winning: Achieving production goals, maintaining tight geometric tolerances, and driving continuous improvement motivates you.
  • Relatable experience: Prior experience operating press brakes or working in precision sheet metal fabrication is highly valued!
  • Driven to succeed: You are passionate about craftsmanship, precision, and building things that last.
  • Passion for learning: You will receive specialized on-the-job training tailored to our heavy-duty machinery.

Responsibilities:

  • Set up and program press brake machines by selecting the correct dies, punches, and back gauges according to blueprint specifications.
  • Form and bend sheet metal and steel plate to precise angles and dimensions for cabinets, workstations, and carts.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, job orders, and technical drawings to determine material requirements and bending sequences.
  • Inspect finished components using measuring tools (calipers, squares, and tape measures) to ensure strict adherence to high-quality standards.
  • Perform routine machine maintenance and ensure a clean, safe, and highly organized workstation.
