title: Delivery Operations Lead
description:
hackajob is collaborating with Simply Business to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Who Are We?

We insure small businesses and enable big dreams – not just for our customers, but for our people and communities too. With over 1,000,000 active insurance policies, we protect builders, bakers, landlords and more than 1,200 other trades.

We’re a technology company as well as one that sells insurance. That means we build, we fail, we learn and we improve. Through our global social impact strategy, called 'The Big Dreams Project’, we're working to help 10,000 small businesses start or grow by 2030.

Why not check out our advert on YouTube: Simply Business TV advert 2024: 'Simply the Best'.

Job Category

Project Management

Position Type

Permanent

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Here's what you'll be doing:

Most organisations treat process optimisation as a side project. At Simply Business, we see it as the engine of our tech strategy. We're looking for a Delivery Operations Lead to step into our Shared Services department and transform how we build and scale. You won't just be managing workflows; you'll be acting as a systems-thinking champion to eliminate friction, optimise throughput, and turn our engineering delivery into a streamlined, high-efficiency machine. Reporting to the Delivery Manager, you’ll partner directly with Product and Engineering leaders to introduce global best practices, tackle systemic risks, and cut waste. With a background in software or data engineering, you understand the actual work behind the metrics. You will stabilise lead times, accelerate our time-to-market, and cut operational costs — ensuring our engineering teams can focus on doing their best, most impactful work.

As one of our Delivery Operations Leads, you'll:

  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen practices to overhaul end-to-end workflows and eliminate system-wide bottlenecks.

  • Build and maintain dynamic workflow maps that expose blockers, highlight opportunities, and map out broader system impacts.

  • Standardise and automate tools across Shared Services to streamline our discovery and software delivery lifecycles.

  • Analyse core flow metrics (throughput, lead time, cycle time) to root out underlying issues and drive data-backed recommendations.

  • Harness Jira, developer tooling, and BI platforms (like Looker or Tableau) to visualise process health and quantify the impact of change.

  • Empower teams through self-service tooling, peer training, and data advocacy to embed a continuous-improvement mindset.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in process mastery, with an expert grasp of Lean, Six Sigma, or Theory of Constraints applied directly to software delivery.

  • Tech-minded at heart, with 2+ years of hands-on experience as a data or software engineer, alongside strong Jira administration skills.

  • Skilled in data visualisation, capable of turning complex datasets into clear insights using tools like Tableau or Looker.

  • A strategic communicator who can translate operational data into executive-level narratives that influence leadership without relying on direct authority.

  • Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable cutting through ambiguity to bring clarity to fast-paced, evolving environments.

  • An intentional collaborator and conscious change agent who values diverse perspectives, self-awareness, and guiding teams smoothly through growth.

"(We know it's tough, but please try to avoid the confidence gap. You don't have to match all the bullet points above to be considered for this role.)

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work."

Ready to build systems that actually scale?

If you're an engineer at heart who loves untangling complex systemic puzzles, this is your sandbox. At Simply Business, we don't just tolerate optimisation — we rely on it to ship impactful software to hundreds of thousands of small businesses. You will have the autonomy, modern stack, and data-rich environment to build elegant, automated workflows that keep high-performing teams moving fast. No jargon, no rigid hierarchy — just real systems impact, high-throughput delivery, and an inclusive culture that values your engineering perspective.

Apply today and help us reshape how we deliver tech at scale!

What are the benefits of working at Simply Business:

  • we offer a great work-life balance where workloads are manageable and everyone has the flexibility to work hybrid

  • on top of the 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), we offer the option to buy five more days of holiday with your flexible benefits

  • our flexible parental leave allows you to approach an important time how you want - with six months full pay to the primary caregiver and four weeks full pay if you're the secondary caregiver

  • our life event leave is an extra days leave every two years for those big moments in your life like moving house or your birthday. And our long-serving employees get a two week paid sabbatical after five years of service, then four weeks off after ten years of service

  • private medical insurance through BUPA, that covers any pre-existing condition is a core benefit. Plus a health cash plan that covers your everyday medical expenses

  • we offer a competitive salary based on your experience and the current market. Plus the potential to earn an annual bonus based on performance

  • access to tools to support your personal development on our dedicated learning platform. As well as support for your mental health with access to counselling

  • we match what you put into your pension up to five per cent. And pass on a tax-free sum that's four times your basic salary with our life assurance policy, with the option to increase it to ten times through our flexible benefit scheme

  • our salary sacrifice car scheme gives you the option to buy a brand new, fully insured, and maintained car for a convenient fixed monthly amount taken from your gross salary (after 6 months service)

  • our flexible benefits scheme gives you an allocated amount to use each year on benefits like critical illness cover, dental insurance, travel insurance, or a gym membership

Ready to join us and drive our success as a high-performing team? Apply today.

Employment Practices

Simply Business is committed to providing equality and opportunities for all employees and candidates considering a career with us. We offer a workplace where colleagues are treated with respect and dignity. We don’t (and won’t) discriminate either directly or indirectly on the grounds of race, colour, religion, belief, political opinion, disability, nationality, ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation or relationship status at any stage of the hiring process or during the course of your employment.

description:
Job Summary

Per la Integrated Communication Services Division di NTT DATA Italia stiamo ricercando figure di Senior RF Engineer con esperienze maturate nellambito della progettazione radioelettrica e ottimizzazioni di reti radiomobili per comunicazioni pubbliche, private e di sicurezza.

  • Eseguire site survey per valutare le caratteristiche degli edifici o dei siti e identificare i vincoli installativi;

  • Ottimizzare le prestazioni della rete radio attraverso interventi sulla configurazione del sito e sulla parametrizzazione delle celle;
  • Supportare il team Presales nelle attivitdi tendering e i Project Manager durante tutte le fasi di deployment della rete.

Qualifications

  • Almeno 10 anni di esperienza su progetti di Radio Network Planning Optimization;
  • Conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie 4G/5G e delle architetture di rete radiomobile di ultima generazione per le reti pubbliche e private;
  • Buona conoscenza delle architetture DAS multi-operatore e multi-tecnologia per radio coperture indoor e outdoor;
  • Conoscenza approfondita dei tool di Radio Network Planning per le simulazioni della copertura radio outdoor (Atoll, Planet, Asset) e indoor (iBwave);
  • Buona conoscenza dei tool di test per la misura e analisi dei parametri di rete di accesso radio (Nemo, TEMS);
  • Conoscenza dei tool di misura a radiofrequenza per il rilevamento dellinterferenza;
  • Competenza nella definizione di una lista di test e nellesecuzione dei test di validazione delle prestazioni di rete radiomobile;
  • Buone competenze di troubleshooting dei KPI di rete e capacitdi fornire indicazioni sulle modifiche parametriche per lottimizzazione delle prestazioni;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana o madrelingua;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua Inglese;
  • Disponibilitad operare in trasferta, anche internazionale;
  • Ottime doti relazionali e predisposizione al lavoro di gruppo in contesti dinamici e in continua evoluzione;
  • Ottime capacitcomunicative e di negoziazione;
  • Ottime capacitdi sintesi e trasmissione efficace delle informazioni, sia in forma scritta che orale;
  • Capacitdi adattamento a diversi ambiti di lavoro;
  • Approccio orientato al raggiungimento degli obiettivi ed eccellenti capacitdi problem solving.

Nice to have

  • Conoscenza delle reti GSM-R e TETRA per le comunicazioni radiomobili mission critical

Who We Are:


We build products and relationships that last a lifetime! No really, that’s what we do.   • Satisfied - we celebrate achievement, then set our sights on new goals.

What We're Looking For:


We are seeking a reliable and motivated Press Brake Operator to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you will be responsible for setting up, adjusting, and operating press brake machinery to bend, shape, and form heavy-duty American steel components for our industrial storage products. You will read technical blueprints, select the proper tooling, and conduct rigorous quality checks to ensure our products maintain their signature "obsessively overbuilt" standard. This position requires strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, physical stamina, and an uncompromising commitment to safety.

  • Passion for winning: Achieving production goals, maintaining tight geometric tolerances, and driving continuous improvement motivates you.

  • Passion for learning: You will receive specialized on-the-job training tailored to our heavy-duty machinery.

  • Set up and program press brake machines by selecting the correct dies, punches, and back gauges according to blueprint specifications.
  • Form and bend sheet metal and steel plate to precise angles and dimensions for cabinets, workstations, and carts.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, job orders, and technical drawings to determine material requirements and bending sequences.
  • Inspect finished components using measuring tools (calipers, squares, and tape measures) to ensure strict adherence to high-quality standards.

title: ServiceNow CSM Developer (Freelance mogelijk)
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Deze functie focust op de verdere uitbouw van de Customer Service Management (CSM)-module binnen een bestaand Enterprise Service Management-platform. De modules ITSM, HRSD en CSM zijn al operationeel en worden intensief gebruikt binnen de organisatie.

Als ServiceNow CSM Developer werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van oplossingen binnen de CSM-module. Je zet business requirements om naar concrete configuraties en technische uitwerkingen, met een duidelijke voorkeur voor standaardfunctionaliteiten en een out-of-the-box aanpak. Zo help je mee aan een schaalbaar, performant, onderhoudbaar en upgradebaar platform.

Je werkt hiervoor samen met een architect en een business analist in een klein deliveryteam.

Algemene verantwoordelijkheden

  • Ontwikkelen en implementeren van CSM-oplossingen op basis van aangeleverde business requirements.
  • De standaardmogelijkheden en best practices van CSM maximaal benutten en maatwerk beperken.
  • Waken over kwaliteit, performantie, onderhoudbaarheid en upgradebaarheid van de opgeleverde oplossingen.
  • Bijdragen aan een vlot delivery- en releaseproces, van implementatie tot go-live en nazorg.
  • Kennis delen met het interne ServiceNow-team.

Specifieke verantwoordelijkheden

1. Implementatie van business requirements (CSM)

  • Requirements vertalen naar concrete configuraties binnen de CSM-module.
  • Cases, casetypes, workflows, catalogusitems en record producers uitwerken volgens de gevraagde noden.
  • Afstemmen met betrokken stakeholders en teams om requirements correct en volledig te realiseren.
  • Werkende oplossingen opleveren doorheen de volledige deliverycyclus, inclusief go-live en nazorg.

2. OOTB-first en gebruik van CSM-standaarden

  • De standaardfunctionaliteiten en standaardelementen van CSM maximaal inzetten.
  • Oplossingen uitwerken in lijn met out-of-the-box mogelijkheden en ServiceNow best practices.
  • Customisaties kritisch evalueren en de impact op upgradebaarheid bewaken.
  • Waar mogelijk kiezen voor standaardconfiguratie in plaats van maatwerk.

3. Configuratie en ontwikkeling

  • Configureren van Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, ACL's, notificaties en SLA's/OLA's.
  • Gerichte ontwikkelingen uitvoeren met JavaScript/GlideScript en Flow Designer en/of UI Builder wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit niet volstaat.
  • De CSM-portalen configureren, waaronder Customer Service Portal en Consumer Service Portal.

4. Integraties, testing en release

  • Integraties met externe systemen bouwen en ondersteunen via REST, SOAP en IntegrationHub.
  • Unit testing uitvoeren en user acceptance testing (UAT) ondersteunen.
  • Update sets opvolgen en meewerken aan een gecontroleerd releaseproces.
  • Productieproblemen oplossen en mee toezien op de stabiliteit van het platform.

5. Documentatie en kennisdeling

  • Technische documentatie en solution designs opstellen en onderhouden.
  • Gemaakte keuzes rond OOTB versus customisatie helder documenteren.
  • Bijdragen aan kennisopbouw en de verdere autonomie van het interne team.

📝 Jouw profiel

Opleiding en ervaring

  • Bachelor in ICT of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Minstens 5 jaar ervaring met ServiceNow-implementatie en -configuratie.
  • Aantoonbare hands-on ervaring met de CSM-module en de standaardfunctionaliteiten ervan.

Functionele en technische competenties

  • Grondige kennis van de standaardfunctionaliteiten en het datamodel van de CSM-module.
  • Sterke configuratievaardigheden met een OOTB-first en best-practice-gedreven aanpak.
  • Scriptingervaring met JavaScript/GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes en ACL's.
  • Ervaring met Flow Designer en/of UI Builder.
  • Ervaring met integraties via REST, SOAP en IntegrationHub.
  • Vertrouwd met Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen.

Soft skills

  • Pragmatisch, oplossingsgericht en kwaliteitsbewust.
  • Sterke communicatievaardigheden richting business en IT.
  • In staat om zelfstandig te werken en doordacht om te gaan met customisatie.

Talen

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands of Frans, met de andere landstaal minstens op een zeer goed niveau.
  • Goede kennis van het Engels.

Troeven

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) en CIS-CSM certificering.
  • Ervaring binnen de federale overheid.
  • Ervaring met andere ServiceNow-modules zoals ITSM en HRSD.
  • Ervaring met Virtual Agent, Employee Center of Service Portal.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. title: Humanitarian Programme Officer
description:
TITLE: Humanitarian Programme Officer

DEPARTMENT: Operations

LOCATION: based in Ambovombe

GRADE: 4A

CONTRACT LENGTH: 03 months subject to

availability of funds.

CHILD SAFEGUARDING:

Level 3: the post holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work country programs;or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the police checking/vetting process staff

ROLE PURPOSE:

The Humanitarian Programme Officer is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of anticipatory action, emergency preparedness, and humanitarian response programmes in the Grand Sud of Madagascar. The role contributes to ensuring that emergency interventions are delivered in a timely, effective, and accountable manner, in line with Save the Children's policies and procedures, donor requirements, humanitarian principles, and international standards.

The post holder will support the implementation of forecast-based and anticipatory actions designed to reduce the impact of predictable humanitarian shocks, particularly those associated with forecasted El Niño events, drought, food insecurity, water scarcity, disease outbreaks, floods, cyclones, and other climate-related hazards. Working closely with technical teams, partners, government authorities, and communities, the the Humanitarian Programme Officer will help ensure that vulnerable children and families receive timely assistance before, during, and after emergencies.

With the support of the Humanitarian Programme Coordinator (based in Antananarivo), the role will contribute to strengthening emergency preparedness and response capacity by supporting early warning monitoring, contingency planning, risk analysis, needs assessments, field-level coordination, and programme monitoring activities. The Humanitarian Programme Officer will play a key role in tracking programme progress, ensuring quality implementation, facilitating accountability to affected populations, and documenting lessons learned to improve future humanitarian interventions.

In anticipation of El Niño-related impacts, the post holder will support the delivery of preparedness and early action activities aimed at mitigating risks to food security, nutrition, water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), child protection, education, and livelihoods. This includes assisting with project implementation, monitoring triggers for anticipatory action, coordinating field activities, and supporting timely reporting on programme achievements, challenges, and emerging humanitarian needs.

Working collaboratively with the Humanitarian Programme Coordinator, MEAL, Operations, Finance, Security, and technical specialists, the Humanitarian Programme Officer will contribute to high-quality, evidence-based programming that strengthens community resilience, protects children, and supports Save the Children's humanitarian and climate adaptation objectives in Madagascar.

SCOPE OF ROLE:

Role Dimensions: The position holders will liase with both internal and external stakeholders to achieve SCI humanitarian ambition in Madagacar.

KEYS AREAS OF RESPONSABILITY

1. Humanitarian Programme Operations and Implementation

  • Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of anticipatory action and emergency response projects.

  • Ensure programme activities are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved project plans and donor commitments.

  • Monitor project progress against work plans, indicators, and targets, identifying risks and proposing corrective actions when necessary.

  • Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme quality, provide technical support, and ensure adherence to agreed standards.

  • Coordinate closely with logistics, procurement, finance, and administration teams to facilitate efficient programme delivery.

  • Ensure all activities comply with Save the Children policies and procedures, donor regulations, and relevant national requirements.

2. Programme Quality and Accountability

  • Support the integration of quality programming approaches throughout project implementation.

  • Collaborate with the MEAL team to ensure monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning systems are effectively implemented.

  • Promote accountability to affected populations through accessible and responsive feedback and complaints mechanisms.

  • Ensure beneficiary feedback and lessons learned are incorporated into programme improvement and future project design.

  • Contribute to maintaining humanitarian programming in accordance with the Sphere Humanitarian Standards and the Red Cross Code of Conduct.

3. Safety, Security, and Risk Management

  • Ensure programme activities are implemented in line with organizational safety and security policies.

  • Work closely with the Country Security focal point and field teams to monitor contextual developments and security risks.

  • Support adherence to security procedures during field operations and project implementation.

  • Report security incidents, operational challenges, and emerging risks in a timely manner.

4. Reporting and Documentation

  • With the support of the Humanitarian Programme Coordinator, prepare high-quality and timely project reports, situation reports (SitReps), updates, and other required documentation.

  • Support donor reporting processes and ensure compliance with internal and external reporting requirements.

  • Maintain accurate project records, beneficiary data, activity documentation, and means of verification (PRIME)

  • Contribute to documenting best practices, lessons learned, and success stories.

5. Coordination and Representation

  • Participate in coordination meetings with local authorities, partners, clusters, and other humanitarian stakeholders as required.

  • Foster effective collaboration with government counterparts, community leaders, and implementing partners.

  • Represent the organization professionally and in line with humanitarian principles and organizational values.

6. Capacity Building and Team Support

  • Support capacity-building initiatives for staff, volunteers, and partners involved in project implementation.

  • Provide on-the-job coaching and technical support to field teams.

  • Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning across programme teams.

BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice)

Accountability:

  • holds self accountable for making decisions, managing resources efficiently, achieving and role modelling Save the Children values

  • holds the team and partners accountable to deliver on their responsibilities - giving them the freedom to deliver in the best way they see fit, providing the necessary development to improve performance and applying appropriate consequences when results are not achieved.

Ambition:

  • sets ambitious and challenging goals for themselves and their team, takes responsibility for their own personal development and encourages their team to do the same

  • widely shares their personal vision for Save the Children, engages and motivates others

  • future orientated, thinks strategically and on a global scale.

Collaboration:

  • builds and maintains effective relationships, with their team, colleagues, Members and external partners and supporters

  • values a broad definition of diversity and sees it as a source of organisational strength

  • approachable, good listener, easy to talk to.

Creativity:

  • develops and encourages new and innovative solutions

  • willing to take disciplined risks.

Integrity:

  • honest, encourages openness and transparency; demonstrates highest levels of integrity

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education to MSc/MA/MEng level in a relevant subject or equivalent field experience

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Essential

  • Strong language skills in French and English

  • Extensive experience of working internationally in humanitarian programmes

  • Previous experience of managing programme teams in large-scale first phase emergency response is essential

  • Previous experience of managing a large multi-sector, multi-national team

  • Previous experience of programme management across multiple locations

  • Experience of managing multi-donor, multi-site programmes (including ECHO, DFID, WFP, and BHA) as well as other awards, including transitional phase types of award that contribute to the nexus of humanitarian and development work.

  • Security management experience across a large and complex programme.

  • Commitment to, thorough understanding of, and able to train staff in participation and accountability approaches

  • Demonstrated ability to contributing to setting up monitoring & evaluation systems in large complex programmes.

  • Demonstrated ability to set up learning and development processes for a large team

  • Proven ability of mentoring and coaching

  • Experience of senior level representation

  • Experience in developing and negotiating successful partnerships with institutional donors

  • Ability to write clear and well-argued assessment and project reports

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Proven ability to influence change at an operational and strategic level

  • Politically and culturally sensitive with qualities of tolerance, respect of diversity, patience, tact and diplomacy

  • The capacity and willingness to be extremely flexible and accommodating in difficult and sometimes insecure working circumstances.

  • Commitment to the aims and principles of SC. In particular, a good understanding of the SC mandate and child focus and an ability to ensure this continues to underpin our support

title: Finance Coordinator (Development Project)
description:
ROLE PURPOSE:

Save the Children in Indonesia is changing for the better. We've begun to build a national organisation that aims to be a strong, local, and self-sustaining voice for children in Indonesia. To this end, SC Indonesia has been designated as a “Prospect Member”. As ‘Prospect Member’ Indonesia has been identified as part of the next way of new member development, which focusses on strengthening and localizing our voice for children in strategic middle-income countries. Indonesia has been authorised by member ballot to start fundraising locally as a first step towards building a financially sustainable local organization. Future work will also involve developing a strong local governance structure and building key partnerships with local government, the private sector, local civil society among others. Success of the pilot phase will set the Indonesia on a pathway to full membership.

The Finance Coordinator will work closely with Awards, Finance Manager, Humanitarian team to provide overall leadership, vision, strategic direction and management of Save the Children’s financial planning across the organisation and ensure the sustainability and viability of the organisation. Specifically, he/she is responsible for financial accounting and management reporting. The scope of responsibilities includes financial accounting of our programs and operations.

Ensuring financial efficiency, sustainability and viability and establishing a strong financial governance framework that takes into consideration risks to the organisation and is in compliance with SCI policy, national foundation and regulatory laws is central to the achievement of membership status and the establishment of a national foundation that could safeguard and grow our income and portfolio, expand our geographic presence and deliver more programs for children.

Working with the CFO, grant finance manager, finance officer, finance rooving partnership and accounting team of National Office, the post holder shares the accountability to build the most positive and affirming work environment possible and ensure that the management, staffing and culture of the organisation are suitably aligned with the mission, evolving goals and strategic ambitions aligned with the Member Accountability Framework.

• Co-lead with finance manager on achievement of Operations delivery indicators, particularly on monthly spending target

Strategy and Leadership:

  • Lead on ensuring that effective internal processes for the finance department and related functions that have the participation and ownership of all key internal stakeholders are followed.
  • Becoming a business partner for project management team

Ensure financial sustainability for the organisation through strong financial governance framework, and operates on a sound financial basis:

  • Ensure financial rules, policy and regulation, both internally and externally are followed.

title: Senior Officer-Education (SCOPE)
description:
Save the Children invites applications for the above-mentioned position. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, colour, ethnic origin, nationality, disability, age, or beliefs and religion. We are committed to diversifying our staff to better represent the communities we serve and actively welcome underrepresented groups to apply.

The position is contingent upon donor approval.

The Opportunity
The primary purpose of this position is to ensure that children of RMG workers in Dhaka and Savar can realize their rights to quality, inclusive protection and education services.

The position is responsible for the effective planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of project activities in line with donor requirements and the Detailed Implementation Plan (DIP). The position will work closely with the Child Protection (CP) team to achieve the overall project goal and strengthen partner organizations to ensure quality and timely implementation of project interventions. Key responsibilities include building the capacity of partner staff, secondary school teachers on STEM education, and daycare teachers and caregivers. The position also requires strong skills in designing and facilitating training, meetings, and workshops.

The position will ensure the quality of ECCD activities in daycare centers, including the development and use of age-appropriate, low- and no-cost Teaching-Learning Materials (TLMs); provide training and ongoing technical support to daycare teachers and caregivers; and monitor children’s growth by tracking height and weight in accordance with relevant government guidelines. The position will facilitate STEM education for secondary school-aged children and support remedial education interventions to minimize learning gaps among children of RMG workers. The position will also strengthen life skills among secondary school-aged children, assess children’s developmental progress using CREDI and IDELA tools, and support competency assessments of secondary school students. In addition, the position will assist in conducting studies and assessments, ensure timely procurement of project materials, support day-to-day project operations, and prepare timely, need-based reports and documentation.

Qualifications and Experience
• At least five years of relevant professional experience in ECCD and primary and secondary education, including a minimum of two years of demonstrated experience in ECCD training facilitation and development of age-appropriate teaching-learning materials.
• Detail knowledge about learning toys and learning aids, a clear understanding of how children learn, and detailed knowledge of training.
• Strong networking and stakeholder engagement capacity.
• Ability to collaborate and coordinate effectively with local government, DSHE, and district and sub-district-level Primary and Secondary Education Offices.
• Excellent training design and facilitation capabilities.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Effective active listening and counselling abilities.
• Sound time management and organizational skills.
• Good working-level English communication proficiency.
• Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Master’s degree in ECCD/Education/Social Science or any other relevant field.

The Organisation
We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard.

We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:
• No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday
• All children learn from a quality basic education and that,
• Violence against children is no longer tolerated.

We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive workplace where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

Application Information

Please apply using a cover letter and an up-to-date CV as a single document. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations.

Only short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview
‘Save the Children promotes diversity in its workforce.’

We need to keep children safe, so our selection process reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.

All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our global anti-harassment policy.

Enjoy monthly BBQs cooked with our finest meats, make-your-own wrap or sandwich, morning teas, staff sales, and Employee of the Month recognition. Whether you’re in the office, on production & warehouse sites, or working at our cattle and sheep stations, there’s always an opportunity to connect, celebrate, and enjoy being part of a tight-knit team.

title: Data Center Facilities Engineer (DCEO)
description:
The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Engineer is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.

Key job responsibilities

The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

  • Act as the site primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders involving communication and relationship management.
  • Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
  • Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analysis, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Work with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
  • Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Assist in recruiting efforts.
  • Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues.
  • Fine with 24x7 rotational shift hours.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
  • Work flexible shifts including night shifts/weekends
  • Min. Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units

title: Outdoor Skills Assistant
description:
Join Metroparks Toledo as a Seasonal Outdoor Skills Assistant. In this role, you bring our Summer Camp experience to life. You’ll help campers experience the outdoors (maybe for the first time) and connect the community to the outdoors. This position is part-time at 20-30 hours per week.


Day in the Life?

You’ll start off behind the scenes where you pick up the gear needed for the selected activity and get it set up. You’ll then help other staff ensure that the campers have a fun and safe time. Afterwards, you’ll tear down the activity and take the gear back to where it’s stored until next time.


Here’s why we think you’ll love working at Metroparks

  • Play outside all summer – fishing, kayaking, tree climbing, archery, and more.
  • Get experience working at a park.
  • Competitive pay, health care, and retirement benefits. Read more here.
  • Grow your career by advancing to an Outdoor Skills Programmer.

You’ll love this job if

  • You like working outside and with people.
  • You like getting all the materials ready and putting things back where they belong.
  • You like making sure everyone is having fun and being included.
  • You can think on your feet when equipment doesn’t cooperate.

------------------------------------------------------------

Job Summary

Advance Metroparks Toledo’s core conservation mission by providing positive, engaging, and educational experiences to program participants of all ages. Connect the community to natural parks and open spaces.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist Year-Round Programming Staff by setting up and tearing down outdoor skills equipment and assisting during outdoor skills activities that are included in summer day camp programs and general programming.
  • Prepare and assist facilitation in high quality age-appropriate nature based outdoor skills activities including archery, tree climbing, paddling (canoeing, kayaking, stand up paddle boarding), fishing, hiking, biking, tent camping, and other engaging programs.
  • Maintain a safe environment for campers and park visitors at all times.
  • Be a positive role model when leading campers and volunteers.
  • Assist with daily maintenance of facilities and teaching areas, equipment and supplies. Includes sweeping and mopping, restroom and litter clean up.
  • Transport visitors through the parks driving a Metroparks truck towing a 25’ tram/trailer and/or drive an 11 passenger van (training provided). Transport equipment using a variety of trucks and trailers up to 36 feet long (training provided).
  • Other Park District duties as assigned.

Equipment Used

  • General office equipment
  • Cameras
  • Software & Apps: Microsoft Office Suite
  • Art and nature equipment and supplies
  • General cleaning supplies and hand tools
  • Outdoor Skills Equipment: canoes, kayaks, stand up paddleboards, tree climbing equipment, camping and backpacking gear, fishing poles, archery equipment, adaptive equipment, mountain bikes and ramps, mobile rock climbing wall and equipment
  • Metroparks Vehicles: pick-up trucks and 11-passenger van, which will frequently be used to haul trailers. Occasional driving of UTVs and golf carts.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Length of employment varies based on need. Generally, May – August, but may include extensions through December. Employment will not exceed 1,480 hours in a calendar year.
  • Schedule: 20-30 hours/week. Shifts can range in length and will vary by program needs. May require evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.
  • Home Work Location: Oak Openings
  • May require business use of personal vehicle to travel between Metroparks locations.
  • Requires frequent lifting and carrying of up to 45 pounds and occasional lifting up to 90 pounds with assistance.
  • Requires ability to walk and work outdoors for extended periods of time in all types of weather including extreme heat and cold.

title: Estimator for Window Cleaning Services
description:
Fish Window Cleaning is hiring an Estimator to be the face of our company out in the field. This is a hands-on, in-person role — not a closing job!

Your work is to visit commercial properties, walk the building, assess their windows & other factors, and write an estimate. Your job is to provide pricing — you are not responsible for following up or closing the sale. If you'd rather be outside, meeting people, and making connections than sitting at a desk, this is the perfect role for you!

What You'll Do

  • Visit commercial businesses in person — retail strips, restaurants, offices, storefronts
  • Introduce yourself and Fish, and ask for the decision-maker
  • Walk each property, assess and count the glass that needs cleaning
  • Write accurate, professional estimates using our pricing system
  • Log each estimate so it flows cleanly into our system
  • Target: approximately 60-75 written estimates per week, based on the schedule you set
Paid hourly for time worked. The estimate target is the performance standard for the role — there's no sales quota and no commission tied to closing.

Schedule & Pay

Schedule: You set your own schedule — build it around classes or other commitments, then keep roughly the same hours each week, 20-25 hours/week. The only constraint: your working hours must start no earlier than 8 am and end no later than 5 pm.

Pay: $16.00–$20.00 per hour, part-time

Estimated annual earnings: Based on 20-25 hours/week at $18-22/hr, this works out to roughly $18,720–$28,600/year, depending on the hours and rate you land at.

What You'll Need

  • Reliable personal vehicle, car insurance and a valid driver's license — you'll drive between stops
  • Comfortable outdoors and on your feet for several hours at a time, including in Texas summer heat
  • Presentable and comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation
  • Able to work independently & stay organized
  • Basic comfort using a smartphone or tablet to log estimates
Nice to Have

  • Previous door-to-door, canvassing, or field sales experience
  • Background in trades, field service, or route-based work
  • Familiarity with navigating Houston
Our Hiring Process

We move fast and keep you in the loop — most candidates hear back within 3 business days of applying.

  • No resume required
  • A few pre-screening questions
  • One in-person interview, about 30 minutes
  • Job offer
Why Fish

  • You set your own schedule — great for balancing classes or other commitments, with consistent hours once you've settled into a rhythm
  • Full paid training, no experience needed
  • Work independently and manage your own route day to day
  • Room to grow — after 6 months, motivated estimators can explore closing sales for additional commission, expanding their hours, and other advancement opportunities
  • Family-owned and operated business — we value our people!
About Fish Window Cleaning

Fish Window Cleaning has grown into the world's largest window cleaning company, with more than 250 franchise territories across 43 states — but we've never lost sight of the values we were founded on. Every customer is treated like our only customer.

For over three decades, Fish has worked to be a good neighbor in the communities we serve, partnering with nonprofits and giving back through volunteering, leadership, and charitable support. Our mission is simple: be the best and most respected window cleaning company in the world.

If you're courteous, self-motivated, and pay close attention to detail, we'd love to have you on the team. Apply today.

title: Natural Resources Conservation Assistant
description:
Join Metroparks Toledo as a Seasonal Natural Resources Conservation Assistant. In this role, you keep our natural resources thriving. You’ll help conserve our natural resources at parks that thousands of people enjoy every day. You play a big role in ensuring we maintain our “Clean, Safe, and Natural” promise.


Day in the Life?

Every day is different. You may be working in the woods, fields, marshes or wetlands to control invasive plants. You may be helping with controlled burns to bring our native plants back to life. You may spend the day at the shop keeping our equipment in good condition.


Here’s why we think you’ll love working at Metroparks

  • Field experience in natural resources helps bring your degree to life.
  • Monthly set schedule so you can plan your life.
  • Competitive pay, health care, and retirement benefits. Read more here.
  • Grow your career by advancing to a Land Steward or Natural Resources Technician.

You’ll love this job if

  • You are pursuing a Natural Resources-related degree and want to get field experience.
  • You like working outdoors in all kinds of weather.
  • You enjoy hands-on work with a wide variety of plants and animals.

---------------------------------------

Job Summary

Advance Metroparks Toledo’s core conservation mission by assisting with removal of invasive species through mechanical and chemical treatments, assisting with prescribed fire operations, and native seed production. Learn about and assist with implementing restoration management within Metroparks and on Metroparks properties.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform natural resources restoration work including removal and control of invasive plants and dead and dying trees, brush removal, wood chipping and environmental clean-up.
  • Control invasive species by applying pesticides and herbicides to specific identified plant species under the supervision of a licensed applicator.
  • Perform basic tree felling activities (less than 12” diameter); cut trees and brush using chain saws.
  • Work as a burn crew member on ecological prescribed burns, assisting in prescribed fire operations.
  • Field maintenance and seed production, including plant propagation, weeding, irrigation, seed collection, seed processing, harvesting and storage.
  • Maintain tools, vehicles, and equipment used in management activities.
  • Perform routine maintenance on power equipment, woodchipper, and vehicles.
  • Respond to customer questions, comments and suggestions in a courteous and timely manner.
  • Other Park District duties as assigned.

Equipment Used

  • General office equipment
  • Software & Apps: Microsoft Office Suite, Geographic Information System (GIS),
  • Maintenance Equipment: lawn equipment, mowers, tillers, woodchippers, chainsaws, herbicide application equipment, power and hand tools, safety equipment
  • Vehicles: on & off-road trucks, UTVs, Tractors, Trailers
  • Biological survey tools and equipment: GPS devices and mapping tools

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Length of employment varies based on need. Generally, March – December. Employment will not exceed 1,480 hours in a calendar year.
  • Schedule: 40-hour workweek that may require work in the evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.
  • Home Work Location: Blue Creek
  • May require business use of personal vehicle to travel between Metroparks locations.
  • Extensive outdoor physical labor exposed to climate extremes, inclement weather, stinging insects, dust and pollen, prescription fires, and herbicides.
  • Requires frequent lifting and carrying of up to 75 pounds and occasional lifting over 75 pounds with assistance.
  • Requires ability to walk and work outdoors for extended periods of time in all types of weather including extreme heat and cold. Must be able to move about off trail over uneven ground and in wooded areas while carrying equipment.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Finance
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER, FINANCE

The finance software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX’s financial operations – we build and maintain the mission-critical applications that power the finance department and ensure our financial systems stay accurate, reliable, and secure as we scale launch, manufacturing, Starlink, AI, and chip design.

Our team designs, owns, and evolves the systems that finance depends on every day – from core financial platforms to the integrations that connect those systems with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and other teams across the company. We work closely with finance stakeholders and partner software teams to ensure data flows cleanly end-to-end, controls stay strong, and our financial systems keep pace with crewed launches, Starship flights, Starlink growth, and everything else that moves the business forward.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

As a Lead Software Engineer on the Application Software team, you will have the opportunity to lead a team of highly skilled engineers both from a technical and personnel development perspective.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directly manage a team of software engineers
  • Own all aspects, including prioritization, implementation, and delivery, of a system roadmap
  • Provide strong technical leadership with a focus on continuous improvement
  • Manage and track multiple priorities while maintaining a focus towards common project goals
  • Develop highly reliable and available software systems
  • Maintain highest standards of excellence, never settle for the status quo
  • Collaborate with other leaders in the department, and across the company, to ensure success for SpaceX

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline and 3+ years of software development experience; OR 6+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • 1+ years of experience with object-oriented programming
  • 1+ years of experience with leading software teams or projects

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#, .NET, Go, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies
  • 4+ years of experience building single page web applications
  • Experience building or integrating with ERP, accounting, or financial planning systems
  • Expertise in testing and infrastructure
  • Experience with financial data integrity, auditability, and access controls (SOX-aware systems a plus)
  • Domain expertise in any of the following:
    • Financial systems (GL, AP, AR, close, or FP&A)
    • ERP platforms (e.g. SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar)
    • Financial integrations, data pipelines, or reporting platforms
  • Strong desire to mentor and grow employees
  • Able to collaborate across group and department lines with a wide range of engineers and managers, including networking and working in a team development environment
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Must be willing to travel when needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
$165,000.00 - $265,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Software Engineer
description: About the Role We're hiring a new-graduate Software Systems Design Engineer focused on blockchain security and protocol design. You'll work at the intersection of cryptography, distributed systems, and adversarial security - redesigning and hardening wallet and core systems against protocol- and architecture-level threats. This is a builder's role for someone who thinks like an attacker and designs like an engineer. Protocol Analysis & Design Analyze and evaluate how mainstream blockchain protocols work under the hood (Ethereum/EVM, Cosmos SDK, Substrate, Solana, etc.), and redesign wallet systems grounded in secure cryptographic mechanisms. Develop hardening and mitigation plans for the wallet system against known protocol-level vulnerabilities and emerging risks. System Security Re-architecture & Hardening Drive security-requirement-driven re-architecture and maintenance of existing software systems. Embed security assumptions at the architecture level, designing and implementing defense-in-depth for critical modules to reduce single points of failure and ambiguous trust boundaries. Research, Audit & Response Track cutting-edge blockchain attack techniques and defenses, and turn research into shippable system improvements. Participate in or lead security audits of internal systems and open-source dependencies, driving remediation and architectural improvements. Background & Experience Master's degree or above preferred in Computer Science, Cryptography, or Network/Cyber Security. New graduate or up to 2 years of work experience. Core Technical Skills Development & architecture: Strong command of at least one systems-programming language among Java / Go / Rust / C++. Proficient in distributed systems design, concurrency models, and performance optimization. Security domain knowledge: Familiar with threat modeling, secure coding standards, penetration-testing mindset, and supply-chain security. Key Soft Skills Security mindset & risk thinking: Operates on a 'zero trust' principle by default and reasons systematically about attack surfaces. Analysis & abstraction: Translates complex, ambiguous security requirements into clear, verifiable technical architecture and module designs. Engineering craft & influence: Builds a security culture across the team through design docs, code reviews, and tech talks. Preferred Qualifications Deep understanding of the full technical stack of at least one mainstream blockchain (networking, consensus, execution, storage). Strong grasp of smart contract security and common vulnerability patterns. Practical command of how public-key cryptography, hash functions, zero-knowledge proofs, and threshold signatures apply - and where their risks lie - in real systems.

title: Outdoor Skills Programmer
description:
Join Metroparks Toledo as a Seasonal Outdoor Skills Programmer. In this role, you bring our Summer Camp experience to life. You’ll help campers experience the outdoors (maybe for the first time) and connect the community to the outdoors. This position is part-time 20 to 30 hours per week.


Day in the Life?

You’ll start off behind the scenes where you pick up the gear needed for the selected activity and get it set up. You’ll then lead the activity and ensure that the campers have a fun and safe time. Afterwards, you’ll tear down the activity and take the gear back to where it’s stored until next time.


Here’s why we think you’ll love working at Metroparks

  • Play outside all summer – fishing, kayaking, tree climbing, archery, and more.
  • Get real-world experience leading outdoor skills programming.
  • Competitive pay, health care, and retirement benefits. Read more here.

You’ll love this job if

  • You like working outside and with people.
  • You like getting all the materials ready and putting things back where they belong.
  • You like teaching others how to have fun outside.
  • making sure everyone is having fun and being included.

----------------------------------------------------------------------

Job Summary

Advance Metroparks Toledo’s core conservation mission by providing positive, engaging, and educational experiences to program participants of all ages. Connect the community to natural parks and open spaces.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead high quality educational programming by interpreting natural, historical, and cultural resources of Metroparks and the northwest Ohio region.
  • Set up and tear down outdoor skills equipment and leading outdoor skills activities that are included in summer day camp programs and general programming.

  • Be a positive role model when leading campers and volunteers.

  • Transport visitors through the parks driving a Metroparks truck towing a 25’ tram/trailer and/or drive an 11 passenger van (training provided). Transport equipment using a variety of trucks and trailers up to 36 feet long (training provided).
  • Direct the work of Outdoor Skills Assistants during assigned program.
  • Coordinate with staff to train volunteers and effectively direct the work of volunteers.
  • Other Park District duties as assigned.

Equipment Used

  • General office equipment
  • Cameras
  • Software & Apps: Microsoft Office Suite
  • Art and nature equipment and supplies
  • General cleaning supplies and hand tools
  • Outdoor Skills Equipment: canoes, kayaks, stand up paddleboards, tree climbing equipment, camping and backpacking gear, fishing poles, archery equipment, adaptive equipment, mountain bikes and ramps, mobile rock climbing wall and equipment
  • Metroparks Vehicles: pick-up trucks and 11-passenger van, which will frequently be used to haul trailers. Occasional driving of UTVs and golf carts.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Length of employment varies based on need. Generally, May – August, but may include extensions through December. Employment will not exceed 1,480 hours in a calendar year.
  • Schedule: 20-30 hours/week. Shifts can range in length and will vary by program needs. May require evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.
  • Home Work Location: Oak Openings
  • May require business use of personal vehicle to travel between Metroparks locations.
  • Requires frequent lifting and carrying of up to 45 pounds and occasional lifting up to 90 pounds with assistance.
  • Requires ability to walk and work outdoors for extended periods of time in all types of weather including extreme heat and cold.

The Workers Compensation Claims Adjuster is responsible for managing a caseload of moderate complexity claims from start to finish. This includes conducting thorough investigations, assessing liability, negotiating settlements within defined authority limits, and maintaining clear communication with claimants, third parties, and legal representatives. title: Cloud DevOps Engineer - Kubernetes | Hybrid, Nightshift
description:
Cardinal Health, a global leader in healthcare innovation, is seeking a Cloud Engineer to help drive the evolution of our enterprise‑scale cloud and CI/CD platforms. Operating in a multi‑cloud, multi‑tenant environment, our platforms support thousands of developers across hundreds of teams, powering mission‑critical workloads across IaaS, PaaS, and CaaS models.

As part of the Serverless Platforms Team, you will help design, build, operate, and continuously improve our cloud‑native and CI/CD platforms—including Kubernetes, serverless runtimes, and the enterprise Harness CI/CD ecosystem. You will work closely with application teams, security partners, and platform stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and repeatable deployment patterns using GitOps, infrastructure as code, and modern DevSecOps practices.

With a strong foundation in cloud‑native development and platform engineering, you will help ensure our platforms are reliable, governed, and easy to consume—while fostering a culture of technical excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, and solving complex platform‑scale challenges, join us to help shape the future of healthcare technology.

Role Summary

As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and support containerized and serverless platforms on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and to operate and evolve the enterprise Harness CI/CD platform. You will enable application teams to build, test, and deploy software through standardized, secure, and scalable pipelines while ensuring platform reliability, compliance, and developer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters and workloads on GKE using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps practices.

  • Operate and support the enterprise Harness CI/CD platform, including build, deploy, and infrastructure pipelines, ensuring availability, reliability, and consistent developer experience across teams.

  • Develop and maintain standardized Harness pipeline templates for build, test, security scanning, and deployment to Kubernetes and serverless runtimes.

  • Partner with application teams to onboard services to Harness, providing guidance, troubleshooting, and best‑practice enablement.

  • Integrate CI/CD pipelines with Infrastructure as Code tooling (e.g., Terraform) and GitOps solutions (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) to support repeatable and auditable deployments.

  • Embed security and compliance controls into CI/CD workflows, including vulnerability scanning, policy enforcement, secrets management, and audit logging to meet HIPAA, SOX, and enterprise security requirements.

  • Collaborate with DevSecOps and Application Security teams to shift security left within the SDLC, leveraging tools such as Trivy, Aqua, or equivalent scanners integrated into Harness pipelines.

  • Monitor platform health, pipeline execution, and application performance using tools such as Dynatrace, Prometheus, and cloud‑native monitoring; perform root cause analysis and drive incident resolution.

  • Participate in code and pipeline reviews, establish platform standards, and ensure adherence to engineering best practices.

  • Enforce platform governance and guardrails using policy‑as‑code approaches (e.g., OPA), ensuring consistency, observability, and compliance across all environments.

  • Act as a technical liaison between the Serverless Platforms Team and partner organizations, translating business and delivery needs into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Communicate platform changes, incident status, and best practices through clear runbooks, release notes, and stakeholder updates; facilitate working sessions to drive alignment and unblock delivery.

  • Stay current with cloud‑native and CI/CD trends, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Cardinal Health’s cloud and DevOps strategy.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering with a strong focus on Kubernetes and GCP (preferred).

  • Hands‑on experience designing, operating, or supporting CI/CD platforms, preferably Harness CI/CD in an enterprise environment.

  • Strong understanding of microservices, event‑driven architectures, and distributed systems.

  • Experience with GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, and automated delivery pipelines.

  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, security scanning, and compliance requirements in regulated environments.

  • Exceptional communication skills—able to translate complex platform and security concepts for both technical and non‑technical audiences, and to influence outcomes through clear documentation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Proven problem‑solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments.

title: Senior Linux System Administrator
description:

BeVera Solutions, LLC is a rapidly growing public health and professional services company that provides innovative solutions to federal and state agencies. Our team supports mission-critical programs through expertise in program management, communications, acquisition, data analytics, and public health initiatives. BeVera’s CEO champions a people-first culture where every employee is valued. The company supports this commitment by offering competitive compensation and meaningful, impactful work assignments.


Recognized as one of Atlanta’s Best Places to Work (2024 & 2025 & 2026) by the Atlanta Business Chronicle, BeVera fosters a culture of integrity, excellence, and collaboration.


Position Overview

BeVera Solutions is seeking an experienced Senior System Administrator to support and lead the IT infrastructure efforts at the Office of Advanced Molecular Detection (OAMD) at the CDC. This role requires an in-depth expertise in Linux system administration, infrastructure management, and security compliance. The Senior System Administrator will provide guidance and mentorship to junior staff while managing complex systems critical to public health initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

Linux System Administration

  • Lead the administration of Linux environments (RHEL 8/9 preferred), RedHat/CentOS 8/9 environments, performing tasks at a level equivalent to a (RHCSA ) RedHat Certified Engineer.
  • Administering virtualized environments such as VmWare and/or Proxmox.
  • Scripting using Bash, Python, PERL, and/or Ruby.
  • Working experience with container technology initiatives, including Docker, Podman, and libvirt.
  • Experience with configuring and running Kubernetes.
  • Experience with HPC software such as Warewulf and Slurm
  • Oversee the configuration and management of BIND servers for IP address space management.
  • Manage and optimize local and network file systems, including permissions, encryption, and ACLs.
  • Supervise the administration of NAS storage appliances, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Mentor junior administrators in scripting using bash, Python, PERL, and Ruby.

Infrastructure Management

  • Lead the installation, update, and management of software core services, and system configurations using Ansible and bash shell scripts.
  • Provide expert-level management and troubleshooting of FreeIPA and Linux-based LDAP servers for authentication.
  • Ensure comprehensive system security through basic firewall and SELinux configurations.
  • Lead change management efforts, to create and execute change requests for maintenance, including documentation and after-action reports.
  • Oversee the administration of multiple NAS appliances providing File, Block, and Object storage solutions.
  • Develop and maintain advanced Ansible scripts to automate service configurations and optimize infrastructure performance.
  • Supervise the monitoring of environments with tools like Nagios, Zabbix, Sensu, and Prometheus.
  • Oversee the provisioning, management, and decommissioning of virtual servers in VMware.

Documentation and Issue Tracking

  • Ensure the maintenance of comprehensive system documentation in the online wiki.
  • Analyze security vulnerabilities, generate remediation plans, and execute remediation.
  • Ensuring proper project documentation including lifecycle and deadline specification.
  • Lead efforts in issue tracking using JIRA, ensuring project lifecycles are managed effectively.

title: Executive Manager - Product Security
description:
Executive Manager, Product Security

Role Purpose

The Executive Manager, Product Security is responsible for leading the organisation's Product Security capability, ensuring security is embedded throughout the entire product lifecycle—from ideation and design through build, deployment, operation, and retirement.

This role leads a federated operating model comprising central Product Security Centres of Excellence (CoEs) and embedded Product Security Chapters aligned to business divisions. The Executive Manager drives the strategy, governance, standards, capabilities, and culture required to deliver secure products at scale while enabling business agility and innovation.

The role serves as a key security leader, partnering with Technology, Product, Engineering, Risk, and Business executives to ensure security is built into products by design, verified continuously, and maintained throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Security Strategy & Leadership:

  • Define and execute the enterprise Product Security strategy, roadmap, and operating model.

  • Establish security-by-design and secure-by-default principles across all products and platforms.

  • Drive alignment between business objectives, engineering practices, risk appetite, and security requirements.

  • Build and lead a high-performing Product Security organisation comprising Centres of Excellence and embedded security chapters.

  • Represent Product Security at executive governance forums and provide strategic advice to senior leadership.

  • Develop and manage budgets, workforce planning, capability development, and vendor relationships.

Lead Product Security Centres of Excellence:

Provide leadership and oversight for a series of Product Security CoEs, including:

Security Education & Awareness:

  • Establish security capability uplift programs for engineers, architects, product teams, and leaders.

  • Develop role-based learning pathways, security certifications, and hands-on training initiatives.

  • Drive a culture of shared ownership for security across the organisation.

Security Design:

  • Define security architecture patterns, standards, and reference designs.

  • Lead threat modelling practices and security design reviews.

  • Ensure security requirements are embedded during product planning and design phases.

Security Testing:

  • Establish enterprise approaches for security testing, including bug bounty, penetration testing, and adversarial assessments.

  • Drive continuous improvement of testing coverage and effectiveness.

  • Define security quality gates and risk-based testing methodologies.

Secure Build & Deploy:

  • Lead secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.

  • Define standards for secure coding, software supply chain security, CI/CD security, secrets management, and infrastructure security.

  • Ensure security controls are integrated into engineering platforms and delivery pipelines.

Security Verification:

  • Establish verification frameworks that validate security controls across products and services.

  • Lead assurance activities, security metrics, control effectiveness reviews, and evidence collection.

  • Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements.

Security Organisational Change Management (OCM):

  • Drive adoption of Security capabilities across business and technology teams.

  • Develop communication, engagement, and change strategies that accelerate security maturity.

  • Build security communities of practice and champion networks across the enterprise.

Product Security Chapters & Federated Delivery:

  • Lead Product Security Chapters embedded within business divisions, ensuring consistent standards and practices while supporting local delivery needs.

  • Foster strong collaboration between central CoEs and embedded security teams.

  • Ensure embedded teams provide effective security guidance throughout product development and operational lifecycles.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives across Technology, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, and Operations.

  • Influence engineering and product strategies to improve security outcomes.

  • Engage with industry forums, regulators, partners, and vendors to advance organisational capabilities.

  • Act as an executive sponsor for key security transformation initiatives.

Key Outcomes:

  • Security is embedded across the entire product lifecycle.

  • Product teams consistently deliver secure products at scale.

  • Security controls are automated and integrated into engineering workflows.

  • Product Security capabilities are adopted and actively used across the organisation.

  • Security risks are identified and managed proactively.

  • Engineering and business teams view security as an enabler of innovation and customer trust.

Leadership Accountabilities:

  • Build and lead a diverse, high-performing Product Security organisation.

  • Develop future security leaders and specialist talent.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration.

  • Drive measurable improvements in organisational security maturity and resilience.

  • Balance security outcomes with customer experience, speed, and business value.

Experience & Qualifications:

Essential:

  • Extensive senior leadership experience in Product Security, Application Security, Cyber Security, or Secure Engineering.

  • Proven experience leading large-scale security transformation programs.

  • Deep understanding of secure software development lifecycles and modern engineering practices.

  • Demonstrated experience building and leading Centres of Excellence and federated operating models.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security, DevSecOps, software supply chain security, and modern application architectures.

  • Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and Boards on security matters.

  • Strong commercial, risk management, and strategic planning capabilities.

Desirable:

  • Experience within highly regulated industries.

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, SABSA, GIAC, or equivalent.

  • Experience leading global or enterprise-scale Product Security organisations.
