title: Software Engineer (Application Software)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER (APPLICATION SOFTWARE)

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
  • Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
  • Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
  • Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
  • Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions
  • Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • 1+ years of experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
  • Expertise in designing software systems
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • You may be asked to work extended hours/weekends dependent on launch cadence
  • This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Senior Research Director, Worldwide Small and Medium Business Research
description:
Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC is seeking a Senior Research Director to lead its coverage of one of technology's most important and complex markets: small and mid-sized businesses. This is a high-visibility global role for a research leader ready to shape how the industry understands SMB technology adoption and to build a personal brand as the go-to authority on it. The role combines primary research and competitive analysis with direct client engagement and business development, translating research into advice for technology vendors navigating the SMB market. The Senior Research Director will also own IDC's SMB thought leadership platform, representing IDC at industry events, on LinkedIn, with business and technology media, and in direct conversations with vendors shaping the space. The ideal candidate brings a sharp analytical point of view on where SMB technology is headed and a willingness to challenge conventional thinking about how smaller businesses buy and use technology.What You’ll Do

• Develop diverse research deliverables supporting the SMB program, including survey insights, buyer segment analysis, competitive analysis, and present key findings to clients through briefings and readout sessions. • Serve as a thought leader on the SMB market (small businesses: <100 employees; midsized businesses: 100–999 employees), maintaining frequent engagement with clients, prospects, and vendors. • Support syndicated research and custom projects simultaneously, working independently across publishing, consulting, forecasting, market modeling, and thought leadership activities. • Drive business development by nurturing current and prospective client relationships to grow syndicated subscriptions and custom consulting business. • Manage the SMB program budget, meeting monthly, quarterly, and annual bookings and revenue targets. • In collaboration with the survey research team, apply sound data collection and analysis practices, using appropriate primary and secondary sources to ensure accurate interpretation and results-oriented recommendations. • Bring strong analytical skills and attention to detail to data generation, refinement, and review, using creativity and flexibility to filter and integrate qualitative and quantitative data into new client insights.What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree required, MBA a plus.
  • 10+ years of previous market research experience with an analyst firm or technology firm.
  • Diverse background across multiple technology areas (e.g., AI, enterprise apps, infrastructure, telecom).
  • Excellent verbal, presentation and written communications skills are essential. The position requires successful candidate to provide quantitative analysis and insight on the changing SMB market to clients in a clear and compelling way.
  • Strong commitment to client support/success and enthusiasm for program mission.
  • Interest in strengthening existing client relationships and driving new business opportunities. Willingness to partner with IDC sales, often taking the lead in identifying new opportunities and crafting effective proposals to grow revenue. Strong ties to current IDC clients/prospects a plus.
  • Experience/understanding go-to-market channels used by technology suppliers to reach SMB customers.
  • Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and the ability to learn to use various IDC resources for document preparation, publishing, client inquiry tracking, and program financial performance.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%.
  • Remote or hybrid if located near IDC’s Boston headquarters.

Why This Role Stands Out At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

What We Offer

  • 12 company-paid holidays
  • 6 paid sick days (prorated based on start date; may vary by state)
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 2 floating holidays (prorated based on start date)
  • 1 volunteer day
  • 401(k) company match (IDC matches 3% on the first 6% of employee contributions)
  • Company-paid short-term disability
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Company-paid parental leave

Compensation Transparency

At IDC, we are committed to fair and equitable pay practices. Employees are compensated equitably for their work, aligned with their skills and experience. Salary and incentive structures are determined through a rigorous process that considers experience, education, certifications, role-specific requirements, internal equity, and verified U.S. market data from an independent third-party partner.The expected total annual compensation, depending on location and experience, is between $130,000 to $180,000, inclusive of base salary and variable compensation.

If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

title: Software Engineer - AI Legal Risk Systems
description:
About LEAP

LEAP is the leading provider of Legal Practice Management Solutions in the world and is part of ATI – one of the largest international LegalTech companies. For more than 30 years, our curiosity and commitment to continual improvement has kept us reimagining productivity tools for lawyers and their staff to support our guiding purpose, to ‘Help lawyers who help people’. The market-leading software we develop, and support is used by more than 71,000 lawyers and their staff in small and medium-sized law firms.

Working alongside our international team of passionate high achievers, you’ll join a fast-growing technology business where things seldom stay the same for long. With more than 1000 smart, caring and ambitious ‘LEAPsters’ working together across Australia, Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland, Poland and New Zealand, you’ll find yourself in good company here.

Meet the Matter Issues team

A fast-moving AI venture operating inside the world’s leading LegalTech organisation. Working at the intersection of automation, agentic AI reasoning, and legal domain intelligence, you’ll help engineer the risk-aware legal brain that powers LEAP’s emerging agentic AI ecosystem — including the AI Free Thinking Paralegal.

If you’re excited about building practical, high-impact AI systems that support real professionals doing important work, this is the place for you. This is your chance to help build a first-of-its-kind AI system that gives lawyers something they’ve never had before: an intelligent, risk-aware legal assistant that understands what can go wrong—before they even ask.

What you'll do

As a Software Engineer on the Matter Issues team, you’ll work across the full stack and the full product lifecycle — designing, building, and refining the systems that will power risk-aware AI inside law firms around the world.

To make this happen, you will:

Build the next generation of legal intelligence

  • Develop core features and APIs for our AI risk management platform.
  • Model, structure, and deliver risk insights that feed into AI systems via MCP.
  • Integrate with LEAP’s AI ecosystem, including the Free Thinking Paralegal and Matter AI.

Design and deliver production-quality systems

  • Build scalable, resilient backend services and polished frontend experiences.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical direction.
  • Ensure high reliability, observability, and performance.

Push the boundaries of applied AI

  • Prototype and refine AI-driven features that leverage LLMs effectively.
  • Work with the constraints and strengths of generative AI in real-world systems.
  • Help enable proactive, risk-aware behaviour inside LEAP’s AI products.

Work like a start-up, backed by an enterprise

  • Own features end-to-end — from idea to release.
  • Collaborate closely with the Matter Issues team in a low-bureaucracy environment.
  • Contribute to a product with real user impact from day one.

What you'll bring

  • 3–6 years of professional experience as a full-stack engineer.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, backend development, and databases.
  • Clear and thoughtful communication skills.

Nice to Have

(Not required — we will teach on the job)

  • Experience with AI/LLMs, automation workflows, or agent systems.
  • Exposure to Legal Tech, SaaS products, or early-stage tech teams.
  • Interest in LLM prompt engineering or applied AI reliability.

Why join LEAP?

  • Your work matters. Helping lawyers help people sits at the heart of everything we do. We solve real world problems that improve and support local, everyday law firms. So they can do their best work for the people in the communities they serve.
  • Make an impact. You won’t be another ‘cog in the wheel’ here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to be heard, to work on big & complex projects – and to make a real difference.
  • Work with a group of authentic, passionate people who love what they do.
  • Flexible and hybrid working. We'd like to find this person in Sydney, but we want you to work in a way that suits you and we're open to flexible arrangements that support you.
  • Grow your career with us. Our founder Christian Beck has been building legal tech businesses for over 30 years. There are opportunities galore to expand your career based on where your interests lie. We're not afraid to pivot based on market conditions - you will always have the opportunity to stay ahead of the curve and do your best work here.
  • Have fun with us. Celebrations. Socials. Sports teams. Access to sailing and yacht events.
  • We value your well-being - enjoy an additional paid wellbeing day every year, free gym membership, corporate dental plan and weekly massages in the office.
  • Work in a new, beautiful office space – with a catered lunch and breakfast every week, fully stocked kitchen and an on-site barista.
  • Access to LEAP Home - a program unique to LEAP to support you in buying your primary residence.

title: Senior Network Architect
description:

Overview

As a senior member of the Network Architecture team, you are responsible for the design, documentation and deployment of services within a global Managed Service Provider IP/MPLS network.

Primary focus is on designing solutions such as large-scale SD-WAN, IPSec and MPLS VPN, IP multicast solutions and across wired and wireless comms.

The role comes at an exciting time for TNS as we integrate services into private- and public-cloud environments, with a focus on automation and orchestration of services and look to transform to a NetDevOps model, where this role will play a key part.

The position requires technical expertise across multiple areas and functions – ability to work with pre-sales and internal teams on requirements gathering, creation of high-level and detailed design specs, ability to work alongside development teams to automate configuration, delivery and support processes, and ownership of overall projects.

Selected candidate will also work with strategic vendors for solution evaluation and customization and will provide third-level Operations support for incident resolution, and leadership over critical operational maintenance works.

  • Experience in vendor product evaluation (hardware, software, service provider)

  • Experience and technical understanding of broadband service deployments (xDSL, Cable).

  • Ability to design, plan, and coordinate network maintenance and installation windows.

  • Hardworking, focused, thorough, and punctual

  • Ability to provide written and verbal presentations on technical topics to corporate peers and management

  • Experience providing support for Tier1 and Tier2 environments

  • Self-motivated; able to work independently or within a team environment with minimum instruction from management

  • Able to work flexible hours as required and provide on-call support

Desirable Skills:

  • Fortinet, Cisco and/or Juniper certifications (NSE Level 4/5/6/7, CCIE/CCNP-SP, JNCIE, JNCIP)

  • Experience with AAA, Tacacs+, Radius, and CA/PKI

  • Experience with Voice over IP, Dial Services (Async/PPP, ISDN), Wireless services (CDMA, EVDO, GPRS, EDGE, 802.11b/g/n), Server Load-Balancing (F5)

title: CFS Operations Supervisor – Warehousing & Stuffing
description:
Job Purpose

Hands-on supervision of warehouse operations and export stuffing of containers, ensuring accurate receipt, proper stacking and safe, optimized stuffing of cargo into containers for export, while protecting cargo integrity, productivity and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Supervise all warehousing activities – cargo receipt from truck / container, visual inspection, condition checks, counting, weighing and placing in allocated stacking location.

• Supervise and carry out stuffing of export containers including planning of cargo placement, loading pattern, weight distribution, securing / lashing and sealing.

• Supervise de-stuffing of import containers and delivery of cargo to customers / agents.

• Conduct and verify tallying of cargo at receipt, during storage and at stuffing / de-stuffing – ensuring quantity, description, marks, weight and condition match the documentation.

• Maintain accurate stacking plans for warehouses – by customer, by shipping line, by export destination – and ensure proper segregation, FIFO / FEFO and space optimization.

• Plan daily stuffing plan in coordination with the Documentation Officer and CFS Manager based on shipping line instruction, vessel cut-off, customer priority and yard / warehouse layout.

• Coordinate with reach-stacker, forklift and equipment operators for container positioning and movement between warehouse and stuffing bay.

• Ensure correct usage of lashing, dunnage, bracing, padding and strapping to prevent cargo damage during stuffing and transit.

• Prepare and maintain stuffing plans, photos, weight distribution checks, seal records and container condition reports for each shipment.

• Coordinate closely with the documentation team for stuffing instructions, B/L details, seal numbers and customs / shipping-line approvals before sealing containers.

• Monitor and report cargo damages, shortages, overages, wet / stained cargo, pest-infested cargo and other irregularities – and segregate as required.

• Coordinate the housekeeping, 5S, pest control and cleanliness standards in all warehouses.

• Ensure safe handling of export cargo – odd-size, heavy, hazardous, fragile – including use of appropriate PPE, equipment and trained manpower.

• Allocate and supervise warehouse teams, tally clerks, forklift operators, loaders and casual labour; record attendance and overtime.

• Maintain stock reports, daily warehouse position reports and inputs for billing / costs.

• Support investigations on cargo claims with proper documentation and photos.

Qualification & Skills

• Certificate / Diploma in Logistics, Warehousing, Supply Chain, Shipping or related field. Practical on-the-job training is equally valued.

• At least 4–6 years of hands-on experience in CFS / export warehouse operations, including tallying, stacking and export container stuffing.

• Strong, on-the-ground knowledge of stacking patterns, lashing / securing methods, dunnage and weight distribution for export containers.

• Demonstrated experience in handling a variety of export cargo – general cargo, FMCG, break-bulk, project cargo, customer-specific packing requirements.

• Good understanding of stuffing documentation – stuffing plans, container photos, weight distribution sheets and seal records.

• Working knowledge of warehouse safety, PPE and handling equipment (forklift, pallet jack, reach stacker).

• Physically fit, willing to work on the warehouse floor and in the stuffing yard, including shifts and overtime when required.

• Good communication in English and Swahili; basic reporting skills.

description:
Footzone group med base i Holstebro søger E-Commerce medarbejder

Erfaring med Shopify og Meta vil være en fordel

Vil du arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem e-commerce, branding, performance og content – og være med til at udvikle stærke digitale brandoplevelser? Så er du måske den, vi søger til vores team.

Om rollen

Som E-commerce & Brand Specialist kommer du til at arbejde med at udvikle og aktivere vores brands på tværs af B2C- og B2B-webshops og digitale kanaler.

Du får ansvar for en række områder og arbejder hands-on med alt fra webshop-merchandising og Meta Ads til SoMe, e-mail marketing, kampagner og aktivering af content.

Du bliver en del af et team med fælles mål og tæt sparring, men skal samtidig trives med at tage ejerskab, tænke selvstændigt og drive dine opgaver fra idé til eksekvering.

Vi leder efter dig, der har øje for detaljen, men samtidig forstår det større billede og kan se vores digitale kanaler med både kommercielle og brandmæssige briller.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:

· Drift og merchandising af vores B2C- og B2B-webshops

· Meta Ads – fra planlægning og opsætning til løbende optimering

· Organisk SoMe på Instagram, Facebook og TikTok

· Planlægning og udsendelse af nyhedsbreve til både D2C- og B2B-kunder med blik for de forskellige målgrupper

· Kampagner og løbende optimering med fokus på både brand og konvertering

· Udarbejdelse af salgsmateriale i Canva og/eller Adobe-pakken

· Opfølgning på performance og omsætning af data til konkrete initiativer

· Briefing og koordinering med content creators

Du skal ikke nødvendigvis selv producere alt content. Det vigtigste er, at du forstår kanalernes forskellige virkemidler, har et stærkt visuelt blik og kan vurdere, hvilket content der skal til – og hvordan vi får mest muligt ud af det.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring inden for e-commerce, digital marketing, branding eller lignende

· Har arbejdet med Meta Ads

· Forstår Instagram, Facebook og TikTok og deres forskellige virkemidler

· Har et stærkt visuelt blik og forståelse for branding

· Kan omsætte mål til konkrete idéer og aktiviteter

· Tager initiativ og er god til at få ting eksekveret

· Trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og tæt sparring

· Har kendskab til Canva og/eller Adobe

Du behøver ikke være ekspert i det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du kan sætte flueben ved størstedelen af vores ønsker og har lyst til at lære resten.

Erfaring med Shopify og Klaviyo er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Hos os får du

· En varieret rolle med ansvar og mulighed for at sætte dit præg

· Mulighed for at arbejde bredt med e-commerce, brand og digital marketing på tværs af B2C og B2B

· Plads til at udvikle dine kompetencer og prøve nye idéer af

· Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje og kort fra idé til eksekvering

Hvem er vi?

FOOTZONE Group er en dansk virksomhed med flere skobrands, herunder Shoedesign Copenhagen, phenumb copenhagen og Havanna Shoes. Vi designer og sælger sko til både danske og internationale kunder gennem vores egne B2C- og B2B-webshops, forhandlere og øvrige salgskanaler.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til jobs@footzonegroup.com. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

title: Data Engineer III - Python/Spark/AWS
description:
Job Description

Be part of a dynamic team where your distinctive skills will contribute to a winning culture and team.

As a Data Engineer at JPMorganChase within the International Consumer Bank, you will serve as a seasoned member of an agile team, designing and delivering trusted data collection, storage, access, and analytics solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You will be responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining critical data pipelines and architectures across multiple technical areas and business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

Implement data solutions on cloud platforms, preferably AWS, using services such as S3, EKS, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Athena, and container-based runtime environments. Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications supporting a data and analytics product, with a strong focus on operational stability and resiliency. Develop and maintain microservices and event-driven architectures, including RESTful APIs and integration patterns for data workflows. Design and implement complex, scalable solutions to process data efficiently, ensuring consistent and timely delivery and availability. Focus on building robust systems that can handle large volumes of data with minimal downtime. Develop solutions using Agile DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment practices on public cloud platforms. Collaborate with key partners to enhance understanding of data usage within the business. Serve as a subject matter expert on the content and application of data in the product and related business areas. Support the Data Analytics and Insights team by identifying and integrating necessary data into analytics platforms. Document and enforce requirements for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness within the product. Contribute to a team culture that values diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Formal training or certification on data engineering concepts with 5+ years of experience. Demonstrated expertise in Python programming, as well as hands-on experience with data processing technologies, including Spark or PySpark. Strong knowledge of the SDLC and agile practices, including CI/CD, application resiliency, and security. Working understanding of NoSQL databases; experience with large-scale datasets, data lakehouse, and data warehouse technologies at least at TB scale, ideally PB scale, with at least one of Databricks, Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery. Recent hands-on professional experience, actively coding, as a data engineer; back-end software engineering experience will also be considered. Understanding of distributed systems and public cloud services, such as AWS or other cloud providers. Experience with SQL, any dialect, and data tools, e.g., dbt, Glue, and Trino. Experience with Infrastructure as Code, ideally Terraform, for cloud-based data infrastructure. Experience with a scheduling system, such as AWS Step Functions or Airflow.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Experience automating deployments, releases, and testing in continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines. A solid approach to writing unit-level tests using mocking frameworks, as well as automating component, integration, and end-to-end tests. Experience with containers and container-based deployment environments, such as Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of data streaming and scalable data processing frameworks, such as Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming. Cloud certifications, including AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experience with TypeScript and modern React development practices.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

description:
About Brilliant

Brilliant is creating a world of better problem solvers. We deliver learning that's interactive, adaptive, and fun – at scale. You can learn more about our approach, learners, and method on our about page.
We have always prioritized building a real, healthy business, and we make hires very selectively and intentionally. We serve hundreds of thousands of paid subscribers, and want you to help us serve millions.
In our day-to-day, we value adventure, excellence, generosity, and candor. We are optimists in the face of uncertainty, we take pride in our work, we go the extra mile for each other, and we tell it like it is (the good and the bad). We’re here to do the best work of our lives together.
We believe that real-time collaboration and human connection are necessary ingredients in building a high-velocity, high-trust team. We maintain core hours (9:30am - 2:30pm Pacific) when everyone is online, regardless of timezone. About half of us are located near our hubs in SF and NYC.
In addition to what’s below, you can see all open roles and learn more about our culture on our careers page.

The Role

Note: This particular posting serves as a "future consideration" form for engineering, as opposed to a formal application to any current openings. Unfortunately, we are not hiring early/mid-career software generalists at this time.
Engineers at Brilliant work in small, elite teams alongside colleagues from Product, Design, and Data to achieve the best possible outcomes for our learners and business. While we’re already happy with our current team size and velocity, we occasionally hire exceptional software engineers with demonstrated histories of transformative impact to further elevate the team. You can apply to this role to be considered for such opportunities in the future.
Engineers we’ve hired through this general interest form in the past include former founders, early employees who grew into staff engineers at companies that achieved massive growth, and experienced engineering leaders who returned to the individual contributor path. These sorts of folks make up a significant percentage of our current team, and we’re interested in talking with more of them to explore what sort of transformative impact they might be able to achieve here.

What we'll look for:

  • Bring new features from conception to completion, helping people around the world to learn more effectively by contributing code across our entire stack.
  • Be mindful of the “big picture” from both a technical perspective and a business one, keeping your pod on track in terms of “building the right thing” and “building the thing right”.
  • Exercise a high degree of autonomy and technical authority on a team that trusts you to do what’s right for our users but is there to support you when you need it.
  • Contribute to a culture of excellence within your pod, setting high standards for candor and mutual accountability, and striking a careful balance between velocity and quality.
  • Advocate for initiatives that will improve developer experience for Brilliant’s engineers and user experience for Brilliant’s users.
  • Frequently ask: How does this impact our learners?

Who are you?

  • You have at least 5 years of professional experience in web-focused software engineering, with meaningful experience going both deep and wide across the domain.
  • You’re motivated by building robust, maintainable, AI-interoperable software systems that drive user and business outcomes.
  • You’re capable of working across the stack, and you’re most energized when owning feature implementations end-to-end, including in third-party tools and data systems.
  • You believe in using the right tool for the job — even when it’s an unfamiliar one, and especially when it’s a boring one.
  • You enjoy solving technical challenges in a way simple enough for an intern to understand and build upon. You avoid introducing complex, novel, or “clever” solutions. You write code for humans, not for computers.
  • You have a favorite product and can articulate your perspective on what makes using it delightful. You often think about how the products you use could be better.
  • You’re constantly tinkering with AI tools and workflows and have used them to achieve surprising new levels of productivity.
    • Note: these roles require deep experience. We are not hiring early/mid-career software generalists at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

We use a systematic compensation framework: salary scales are set each year for each job vertical, managers level folks on their team, and those levels are mapped directly to our compensation scales. A location-based adjustment is applied outside of SF and NYC (typically 5-10%) - feel free to ask us about your location!
Given the systematic approach, we always make First and Best offers - there is no negotiation (for new hires nor our existing teammates). This ensures people are paid based on their expected contribution, not their negotiation skills.
We offer top-notch health care plans, with 100% of the premiums covered for medical, dental, and vision for employees.
We offer flexible PTO, with a norm of taking off about 6 weeks per year (including federal holidays). We also provide home office equipment, a professional development stipend, and free food at our offices.
Our CCPA Privacy Notice can be found here.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

Data Engineer


Vacancy Information

  • Location: London, UK
  • Salary: Competitive
  • Working Pattern: Hybrid, 3 days per week in the office
  • Contract Type: Permanent
  • Working Hours: Monday to Friday


At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.


Our Values

Five shared commitments shape how we work, and how we will work with you:

  • Value Every Voice. We put people first.
  • Act with Integrity. We do what is right.
  • Explore Beyond Boundaries. We are driven by curiosity.
  • Own the Outcome. We take responsibility for our decisions.
  • Succeed Together. We have each other's backs.


The Role

This is a chance to help build the modern data foundations behind TTC's growing Data and AI capability. You will design and develop reliable pipelines and trusted data products across customer, booking, digital, marketing, commercial and operational data, enabling analytics, data science and better decisions across our global portfolio of travel brands.

You will work in a modern Snowflake-based ecosystem alongside senior engineers, data scientists, analysts and data product colleagues, turning complex data into accessible, reusable, high-quality assets. The platform is being actively developed and scaled, so you will learn quickly, see your work used and grow alongside strong engineers who are happy to share what they know. If you care about doing things properly and want room to develop, you will do well here.


What Will You Do?

  • Build and maintain scalable, production-grade pipelines across customer, booking, digital, commercial and operational domains.
  • Turn raw data into trusted, reusable and well-modelled products for Analytics, Data Science and AI.
  • Develop solutions in Snowflake, SQL, Python and modern transformation tooling such as dbt.
  • Build analytical models that give consistent views of customers, bookings, products and key entities.
  • Implement automated testing, data quality controls, monitoring and observability across critical datasets.
  • Apply modern engineering practice including Git, code review, automated testing and CI/CD.
  • Monitor and optimise workloads for performance, scalability, resilience and cost.
  • Work with senior engineers to apply reusable patterns and technical standards.
  • Partner with Data Science, Insight and Data Product colleagues to translate needs into solid technical solutions.
  • Investigate data quality and pipeline issues, find root causes and fix them properly.


About You

Essential

  • Strong professional experience in data engineering or analytics engineering.
  • Strong hands-on capability with SQL and Python.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform.
  • Experience designing and developing ELT and ETL pipelines in production.
  • A good understanding of analytical and dimensional data modelling.
  • Experience with dbt or comparable modern transformation tooling.
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and data quality practice.
  • A collaborative mindset and a genuine interest in building things well.

Desirable

  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience working within AWS, Azure, GCP or another enterprise cloud ecosystem.
  • Experience with complex customer, transactional, digital or behavioural data.
  • Exposure to data security, governance, lineage and documentation practice.
  • Curiosity about travel, hospitality or global consumer businesses.


Apply Now

If you want to build data foundations that thousands of colleagues and millions of travellers rely on, we would like to hear from you. Apply today, and tell us what you would want to build first.

title: Senior Product Manager (m/f/d) – German Payroll

In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert for German payroll requirements and work closely with customers, engineering, product, design, and other cross-functional teams. You will translate complex payroll regulations and compliance requirements into clear product requirements and help deliver user-centric payroll solutions in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Location: Remote, Germany

Contract: Full-time, 12-month contract

Your Responsibilities:

Product Management & German Payroll

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for German payroll requirements, regulations, tax, social security, and compliance.

  • Research and monitor German payroll legislation and regulatory developments.

  • Conduct market and regulatory research to identify and validate product requirements.

  • Translate complex payroll and compliance requirements into clear product requirements and user stories.

  • Own and manage a prioritized product backlog from concept through execution.

  • Work closely with development and QA teams to clarify requirements and support successful product delivery.

Product Development & User Experience

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact product improvements.

  • Maintain a strong focus on the end-user experience and develop intuitive solutions for complex payroll processes.

  • Contribute to product strategy, roadmap development, and continuous product improvement.

  • Collect, analyze, and prioritize feedback from customers, end users, executives, partners, and other stakeholders.

  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, compliance, and efficiency within payroll solutions.

Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Act as a key bridge between product teams, customers, and commercial stakeholders.

  • Support sales teams during complex customer engagements and product-related discussions.

  • Contribute to customer deployment and implementation strategies.

  • Support successful customer onboarding and help address complex payroll-related requirements.

  • Present product concepts, solutions, and payroll-related topics to customers and senior stakeholders.

Your Profile:

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, Implementation Consultant, Senior Payroll Manager, or in a comparable role.

  • Deep understanding of German payroll legislation, tax, social security, ITSG requirements, and compliance frameworks.

  • Strong ability to translate complex regulatory and business requirements into clear product requirements and user stories.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with development, QA, design, customers, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex and changing regulatory environments.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence presenting to senior stakeholders and customers.

  • Fluent or native-level German and English.

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, MBA, or equivalent practical experience in HR, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with enterprise payroll software or SaaS solutions.

  • Experience in sales enablement, technical pre-sales, customer deployment, or implementation strategy.

  • Experience with AI/ML to support automation, compliance, anomaly detection, or intelligent insights in payroll or financial systems.

  • Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS, software product design, and UX/UI principles.

  • Experience working in an Agile product development environment.

  • Experience with enterprise payroll platforms.

  • Experience presenting at conferences, trade shows, or executive briefings.

title: Business Analysis Manager
description:

Overview

The Business Analysis Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for the Business Analysis function within IT Delivery Operations. Managing a team of Business Analysts and partnering with IT Demand Management, this role aligns operational business objectives with technical execution across corporate systems. The position governs delivery quality, standardizes methodologies, and establishes frameworks for continuous process improvement and knowledge management.

Candidate Requirements

  • Define, scale, and govern enterprise Business Analysis frameworks and standards across all SDLC delivery models, establishing best-in-class KPIs, delivery benchmarks, and quality gates across global IT delivery portfolios.

  • Provide executive escalation support and strategic direction on high-complexity, mission-critical enterprise initiatives, ensuring seamless continuity across high-risk portfolio deployments.

  • Drive continuous improvement across the requirements lifecycle, optimizing analytical tools (Jira, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart) and templates to streamline timelines and reduce specification gaps.

  • Maintain authority over requirement maturity, ensuring strict readiness criteria are met before project handoffs to engineering.

title: IDE Technical Coordinator
description:
International Diploma in Education (iDE) Technical Coordinator

Location: Worldwide

Organization Summary:

The vision of Edify is to see Flourishing, Godly Nations, and we seek to accomplish this by improving and expanding sustainable Christ-centered education globally. Edify is a non-profit organization registered in the U.S. since 2009 and now has operations in 16 countries, including Burkina Faso, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El-Salvador, Ethiopia, Ghana, Guatemala, Kenya, Liberia, Nigeria, Panama, Peru, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, and Uganda. Edify serves low-fee independent Christ-centered schools through three primary avenues, including loans, training and education technology.

Learn more at

Location: Virtual, US or one of Edify Operating Countries above

Start Date: 11/1/2026

Reports To:Global Curriculum and Assessment Manager

Salary Range: Commensurate with experience and education and competitive with other nonprofits

Work Environment:

This position will be a full-time remote position. The atmosphere of Edify is one where you can expect to perform widely varied tasks with various functional groups. There will also be collaboration with Edify’s global team in the other countries where Edify operates, and with partner organizations and individuals that are part of the iDE program.

Travel Expectations:

Regular travel is not expected for this position. Edify holds an annual all-staff meeting, alternating in a US-based or international location each year. All Edify Staff are required to attend this meeting.

Job Summary:

The International Diploma in Education (iDE) program at Edify leverages online learning to train teachers at its partner schools. It uses three integrated systems to register (registration portal using Woo Commerce on Wordpress), train (TalentLMS), and communicate/track (Salesforce) progress throughout the lifecycle of each cohort. Multiple cohorts are run concurrently across different countries over the course of a year, with thousands of participants. The primary role of this iDE Technical Coordinator position is to ensure data quality across the systems. Zapier is used to move data between systems, and Salesforce Flow is also used to perform more complex updates in Salesforce. There are also automated weekly reports in Salesforce, and quarterly end-of-term grades that must be sent out. The iDE Technical Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the program runs smoothly, which heavily involves troubleshooting and diagnosing issues as they arise. Central to this role is managing and optimizing cross-platform integrations, automations, and data syncs to ensure seamless technical operations. This role will also supplement work in these areas as assigned by leadership.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Each iDE cohort must be supported through the different stages of its lifecycle. Because there are multiple cohorts running across different countries on different timelines, these stages may overlap between cohorts.

Registration

  • Create cohort branches in TalentLMS with admins for each one
  • Setup school for registration in TalentLMS and Salesforce
  • Create teacher and facilitator groups for each cohort
  • Setup the cohort in the Registration Portal (Wordpress)
  • set the cost and registration period
  • update the registration form (WPForms)
  • update the payment methods (country-specific)
  • test entire process well in advance of open registration period
  • Enroll schools in the cohort in Salesforce
  • Assign appropriate Salesforce permissions to in-country leads for each cohort
  • Troubleshooting registration issues with registrants
    • Inability to register (registration dates, school permissions, OTP WhatsApp or Email issues).
    • Inability to pay (payment gateway errors)
  • Troubleshooting system integration issues (data synchronization)
  • Create and update FAQ page for each new cohort, receiving input from in-country leads on areas of need and learning
  • Import courses to Salesforce

Cohort Support

  • Create weekly progress reports in Salesforce and check for errors
  • Release course reports and results via TalentLMS user fields
  • Export end-of-term results to Salesforce
  • Troubleshoot synchronization issues between TalentLMS and Salesforce
  • Develop scalable automation to identify synchronization issues
  • Perform manual updates as necessary to support exceptional circumstances
  • Meet with iDE team
  • Collaborate with Edify HR & IT Teams regarding impacts to TalentLMS and/or Salesforce

End of Term/Cohort

  • Create reports on end-of-term scores and review with iDE team for discrepancies
  • Coordinate sharing of term results with teachers (via WhatsApp, Salesforce, or TalentLMS)
  • Deactivate cohorts in Salesforce and delete branches in TalentLMS

General Systems Support

  • Quality assurance of courses in our LMS system
  • Data quality analysis
  • Troubleshoot systems automation

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Personal values that align to Edify’s mission.
  • Living example of servant leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal and technology-based communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Course design in an LMS system.
  • Strong cross-cultural collaboration and communication skills.

Systems Knowledge Required:

  • Required
    • LMS (TalentLMS preferred but not required)
    • Salesforce Flow
    • Wordpress
    • Zapier or similar workflow integration platform
    • Woo Commerce
  • Preferred
    • PHP
    • Linux
    • MySQL

Education and Experience:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or similar
  • Two years of experience in the IT Field working in systems integration

Additional Information: Applications will be accepted for this position through September 30.

title: Data Engineer (Cloud & Analytics Platform)
description:
The incumbent will design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions that support analytics, machine learning, and business insights. Responsibilities include developing robust data pipelines, cloud-based data platforms, analytics solutions, and supporting AI/ML initiatives while ensuring data quality, governance, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across cloud and on-premise environments, integrating internal and external data sources, including compliant ingestion of public data where required.
  • Build, optimize, and maintain scalable data models (e.g., star and snowflake schemas) to support analytics, reporting, and business intelligence requirements.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, cleansing, transformation processes, and implementation of monitoring controls.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data solutions on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Factory, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, and related services.
  • Support infrastructure configuration and administration, including compute, storage, networking, identity management, and security controls to ensure reliable and scalable platform operations.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments, and establish monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities to maintain performance, reliability, and SLA adherence.
  • Support the development and optimization of interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI, ensuring seamless integration between data pipelines and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective data solutions and visualizations.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists to deploy, support, and monitor machine learning models in production environments and integrate AI/ML capabilities into data pipelines and applications.
  • Ensure adherence to data governance, security, compliance, access control, and data lineage requirements while following software engineering best practices such as version control, code reviews, and modular design.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of data platform standards, operational performance, scalability, and cost optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Possess a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or related roles with exposure to data platforms, cloud technologies, and analytics solutions.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Possess initiative and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Technical Skills Required

  • Experience with data warehousing concepts, data modeling, database optimization techniques, and ETL/ELT development using Python or ETL tools (e.g., SSIS, Informatica).
  • Proficiency in relational database technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle, and familiarity with big data technologies such as Spark and Databricks.
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, data engineering tasks, and basic API development.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Data Factory, Data Lake Storage, and Azure SQL.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automation tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with streaming or real-time data processing concepts and exposure to monitoring, performance tuning, and optimization of data systems.
  • Experience with Power BI, including DAX and Power Query, for dashboard development and reporting.
  • Basic understanding of machine learning workflows and tools, including Scikit-learn and Azure Machine Learning.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Together, we own our company, our future, and our shared success.

As an employee-owned company, our people are Black & Veatch. We put them at the center of everything we do and empower them to grow, explore new possibilities and use their diverse talents and perspectives to solve humanity's biggest challenges in an ever-evolving world. With over 100 years of innovation in sustainable infrastructure and our expertise in engineering, procurement, consulting and construction, together we are building a world of difference.

Company : Black & Veatch Corporation

Req Id : 116769

Opportunity Type : Staff

Relocation eligible : No

Full time/Part time : Full-Time

Project Only Hire : No

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Why Black & Veatch?

At Black & Veatch, you’ll be part of work that matters—designing, creating, and building the infrastructure communities rely on every day, from concept through execution.

We care about how the work gets done as much as what we build. Safety is built into every decision, and people look out for each other—speaking up, collaborating, and doing the right thing because it affects real lives.

You’ll work alongside teams solving complex challenges and turning ideas into solutions that perform in the real world—gaining hands-on experience across projects, technologies, and disciplines.

Ownership shows up in how we work. We take responsibility for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and take pride in what we deliver. As a 100% employee-owned company, employees share in the long-term success we build together.

With flexible ways of working and meaningful development opportunities, you’ll build a career you can be proud to stand behind.

The Opportunity

The Senior Project Manager provides leadership and overall accountability for the successful execution of complex engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, commissioning, and startup projects within the energy and process industries. The role manages multidisciplinary teams across global locations and serves as the primary client interface for projects ranging from feasibility studies and FEED through EPC/EPCI execution and project closeout.

This position is responsible for delivering projects safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements while managing project risk, stakeholder alignment, and business performance.

The Team

Black & Veatch’s Fuels & Natural Resources focuses discreetly on global investors and operators who need to tap into Black & Veatch’s broad portfolio of large-scale solutions dedicated to converting critical resources into essential fuels and feedstocks. By joining our market sector, you will have the opportunity to be at the forefront of helping our clients with the most innovative energy solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Execution

  • Lead medium to large capital projects from concept development through commissioning and startup.
  • Direct multidisciplinary engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning teams.
  • Develop and execute project management plans, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and execution strategies.
  • Establish project objectives, key performance indicators, and delivery milestones.
  • Maintain accountability for project performance, profitability, quality, and client satisfaction.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, partners, contractors, suppliers, and internal leadership.
  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with project stakeholders.
  • Facilitate executive reviews, steering committee meetings, and client progress reviews.
  • Support business development efforts, proposals, estimates, and project pursuits.

Risk & Interface Management

  • Lead project risk identification, mitigation planning, and contingency management.
  • Manage internal and external interfaces across engineering disciplines, contractors, suppliers, regulatory agencies, and client organizations.
  • Resolve complex technical, commercial, and execution challenges.
  • Ensure effective change management and contractual compliance.

Engineering & Construction Oversight

  • Provide oversight of engineering design, procurement, fabrication, construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Coordinate execution across domestic and international project teams.
  • Review project deliverables for technical adequacy, constructability, operability, and maintainability.
  • Support construction planning, field execution, vendor coordination, and startup readiness.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Develop project budgets, forecasts, cash flow projections, and resource plans.
  • Monitor project financial performance and drive corrective actions when necessary.
  • Manage subcontractors, suppliers, and consultant contracts.
  • Support contract negotiations and claims avoidance/resolution activities.

Safety & Quality Leadership

  • Champion a strong safety culture with a focus on incident prevention and operational excellence.
  • Ensure compliance with company quality requirements, client standards, and applicable regulations.
  • Promote continuous improvement and lessons learned across projects.

Preferred Project Experience

Experience managing projects involving:

  • Natural gas compression facilities and compressor stations.
  • Gas processing and treating facilities.
  • Pipelines, pump stations, metering facilities, and terminal infrastructure.
  • Carbon capture, utilization, and sequestration (CCUS) developments.
  • Petrochemical and process facilities.
  • FEED, Detail Design, EPC, and EPCI project delivery.
  • Brownfield modifications, debottlenecking, and expansion projects.
  • International and multi-office project execution environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Engineering or related technical discipline.
  • Experience managing FEED, EPC, or EPCI projects exceeding $100MM.
  • Experience supporting project execution across multiple international locations and contractors.
  • Ability to mentor project engineers, coordinators, and early-career project managers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Minimum 15+ years of project management, engineering, construction, or project delivery experience within the energy industry.
  • Demonstrated success leading large multidisciplinary teams and complex capital projects.
  • Strong understanding of project controls, scheduling, cost management, risk management, procurement, and construction execution.
  • Proven experience managing global project teams and client relationships.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will:

  • Deliver projects safely, on time, and within budget.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and high customer satisfaction.
  • Improve project financial performance and execution predictability.
  • Effectively manage project risk and stakeholder alignment.
  • Develop high-performing project teams and future leaders.
  • Contribute to sustainable business growth through successful project delivery and repeat client work.

Work Environment/Physical Demands

  • Hybrid or flexible work options may be offered after the first 90 days of employment based upon manager discretion, job performance and work assignments.
  • Typical office environment, typical construction environment, extreme weather conditions, high noise level, safety hazards (electric currents, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to chemicals), atmospheric conditions (fumes, odors, dusts, mists, gases, poor ventilation). Sitting, walking, talking, hearing, reading, writing, keyboarding, driving, filing, reaching, stooping, crouching, bending, standing for extended periods of time, lifting or carrying up to 40 pounds.

  • Inspect finished components using measuring tools (calipers, squares, and tape measures) to ensure strict adherence to high-quality standards.
  • Perform routine machine maintenance and ensure a clean, safe, and highly organized workstation.

title: Software Engineer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
  • Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
  • Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
  • Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
  • Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions
  • Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • Experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
  • Expertise in designing software systems
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: SOC Level 2 Security Analyst
description: **The team you'll be working with:** **UK Sovereign SOC** **Security Analyst (Level 2)** **Role Description** The SOC Analyst (L2) plays a critical role in the detection, investigation, and management of security alerts and incidents escalated from SOC Analyst (L1) teams. The position focuses on in-depth analysis, incident validation, tactical response coordination, and continuous improvement of security monitoring and response capabilities. Operating within a 24/7 Security Operations Centre, the L2 Analyst serves as a technical escalation point for junior analysts, working closely with internal IT and security teams as well as customers to contain and remediate security incidents. The role contributes directly to improving detection quality, response efficiency, and the overall effectiveness of SOC operations. **What you'll be doing:** You will investigate security alerts and events escalated from Level 1 analysts, validating and classifying activity to determine whether it represents a confirmed security incident. This includes performing detailed analysis to understand root cause, scope, impact, and attacker behaviour using SIEM platforms and supporting telemetry. You will coordinate and support incident response activities in line with defined SOC and customer processes, assisting with containment, eradication, and recovery actions. During high-severity or customer-impacting incidents, you will follow major incident procedures and ensure timely, accurate escalation to stakeholders. You will provide technical guidance to L1 analysts during live incidents and help maintain investigation quality under pressure. You will execute defined SOAR playbooks as part of incident response and provide structured feedback to improve automation, response consistency, and efficiency. You will maintain awareness of SOC performance metrics and service levels, such as MTTD and MTTR, and actively contribute to improving investigation quality and response outcomes. You will apply threat intelligence to investigations and alert triage, maintaining awareness of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attacker techniques. Incident learnings and threat insights will be fed back into detection logic to continuously enhance SOC monitoring capabilities. You will also contribute to the development and tuning of SOC detection use cases, ensuring alerting remains relevant, effective, and aligned to current threat activity. This includes supporting onboarding of new services, identifying detection gaps, and recommending improvements to tooling, processes, and coverage. Clear and accurate documentation is a key part of the role. You will maintain investigation records, runbooks, and playbooks, produce post-incident reports for customers and internal stakeholders, and contribute to operational and service reporting. You will help document and implement improvements to event and incident management processes. Collaboration is essential. You will work closely with IT, security, and technical teams to resolve incidents and reduce risk, act as a mentor and escalation point for L1 analysts, and support continual service improvement by identifying recurring issues and proposing corrective actions. **What experience you'll bring:** You will have hands-on experience working with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or QRadar, and a strong understanding of incident response workflows and escalation management. You will be comfortable analysing security telemetry, understanding attacker behaviour, and applying log- and artefact-based investigation techniques. You will demonstrate strong analytical thinking, sound decision-making, and the ability to remain effective during high-pressure incidents. Clear, professional communication-both written and verbal-is essential, as is the ability to work independently while following and improving structured operational processes. + 2-4 years' experience in the IT security industry, ideally within a SOC or NOC environment, including experience operating at SOC L1 level + Relevant cybersecurity certifications desirable (e.g. GIAC, CySA+, SC-200) + Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS + Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Word **Security & Working Requirements** + Eligibility for, or holding, UK SC Clearance + Willingness to work within a 24/7 shift-based SOC environment, including on-call duties. description:
We are Hiring!

As we move into the next phase of Scope’s sustainability journey, we have an exciting opportunity for a Sustainability Lead to join our team. The role can be based in either the UK or Ireland.

We are looking for people who can connect their own personal vision and values into some of what we do at Scope.

Sustainability Lead

The Sustainability Lead working across all our countries will develop and implement sustainability strategies, policies, and programmes across Scope. They are responsible for promoting sustainability awareness, conducting assessments, and driving initiatives to improve environmental performance and reduce Scope’s carbon footprint. The SL will work very closely with internal departments to move forward our sustainability plan. The SL will also work closely with our external partners to ensure they are also moving forward with their sustainability goals. This role will report to the Supply Chain Director.

Strategy Development, Implementation & Assessment

  • Take forward the sustainability strategy that we have at Scope and ensure its execution is according to our 3 year strategy.
  • Brainstorm new ideas and areas that Scope can consider in our sustainability strategy.
  • Undertake assessments to ascertain Scope’s sustainability performance.
  • Identify areas where Scope could improve its sustainability practices.
  • Work with external partners to tackle different parts of our overall sustainability agenda.
  • Participate in inspections and producing sustainability reports with research-backed recommendations.
  • Ensure legal compliance, keeping up to date with relevant legislation, and advising where necessary.
  • Ensure all elements of our products and packaging are compliant with sustainability standards for our markets and customers.
  • Undertake continuous auditing to ensure all measures are implemented and supporting relevant departments to make necessary changes.
  • Monitor and evaluate progress, collect feedback from colleagues, and refresh policies to ensure Scope remains on track for its profitability and sustainability goals.
  • Track and analyse sustainability data to identify areas for improvement and report progress to key stakeholders.
  • Formulate and execute sustainability strategies, policies, and programmes aligned with organisational goals and industry best practices.

Stakeholder Engagement, Education & Training

  • Produce Scope’s annual Impact Report working internally and externally with collaborators.
  • Liaise with different stakeholders from senior management to external partners and customers.
  • Design and coordinate training sessions to update employees on new procedures and practices.
  • Operate as a point of contact within the business for all sustainability-related questions.
  • Work with relevant teams on marketing strategies to promote Scope’s sustainability projects.
  • Host external workshops to inform various audiences of Scope’s sustainability initiatives.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Research the latest technologies to help cut or reduce carbon emissions.
  • Find suitable offsetting solutions that align with Scope’s values.
  • Identify and implement innovative sustainability solutions and drive a culture of continuous improvement within Scope.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in a relevant field such as environmental science, sustainability management, engineering, or business.
  • Project management qualification e.g. Prince2.

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • 3 years+ proven experience in sustainability management, environmental compliance, or related fields.
  • Proficiency in sustainability assessment tools, carbon footprint analysis, and other relevant software.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills are essential for engaging stakeholders and driving change.
  • Ability to analyse complex data, identify trends, and develop data-driven recommendations.
  • Ability to plan, organise, and execute projects effectively and efficiently.
  • Ability to lead and influence others to adopt sustainable practices both internally and externally
  • Familiarity with environmental legislation, sustainability standards (e.g., ISO 14001), and other relevant frameworks.
  • 3 years+ proven experience in project management

title: CFS Documentation Officer
description:
Job Purpose

Maintain accurate, complete and timely documentation for all container, cargo and customer movements at the Company Cargo Limited CFS, ensuring smooth coordination between operations, the customer service team, shipping lines, clearing agents, transporters and statutory authorities.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare, issue and control all gate-in / gate-out documentation for containers, cargo and vehicles.

• Prepare and maintain stuffing / de-stuffing, cargo receipt, tally sheets, loading / off-loading and delivery documentation.

• Capture, verify and update container numbers, seal numbers, truck / driver details, cargo description, weight and quantity, customer name, shipping line, vessel and voyage details.

• Verify all shipping line release orders, customs release, customer instructions and consignee / notify party details before releasing containers or cargo.

• Maintain the CFS operating system (manual / software) including daily container and cargo movement registers, receipt records, dispatch records and pending files.

• Issue delivery notes, gate passes, receiving reports, EIR (Equipment Interchange Receipt), cartel checklists and B/L / cargo manifest extracts where required.

• Coordinate the safe release of containers and cargo only after full documentation, payment and approval checks are completed.

• Liaise with the CFS yard and warehouse teams regarding container positioning, cargo location and dispatch priority.

• Coordinate with shipping lines, shipping agents, clearing & forwarding companies, customs brokers, transporters and customers for documentation flow and approvals.

• Maintain proper filing (physical and electronic) and ensure fast retrieval of all CFS documentation for audits, customer queries and statutory inspections.

• Track pending documentation, missing information and incomplete files and follow up daily with the responsible party (customer / agent / shipping line / driver).

• Perform daily reconciliation between physical container / cargo movements and the system / documentation; investigate and resolve mismatches.

• Provide accurate input to the Finance team for billing of storage, handling, stacking, stuffing / de-stuffing and other services.

• Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports – container movements, cargo tonnage, stock position, pending deliveries, penalties and exception log.

• Support the CFS Manager in customer service by responding to documentation queries, status updates and proof-of-delivery / receipt requests.

• Maintain confidentiality of customer information and commercial documentation at all times.

Qualification & Skills

• Diploma or Degree in Shipping, Logistics, Supply Chain, Customs Administration, Business or related field.

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on documentation experience in an established Container Freight Station (CFS) in Dar es Salaam.

• Sound knowledge of shipping line documentation, customs release procedures, manifest / B/L formats, EIR, cartells and CFS operating systems (manual and software).

• High attention to detail, accuracy and ability to handle high document volumes under pressure.

• Good working knowledge of Excel, MS Office and documentation management software.

• Strong communication and coordination skills with internal teams, customers, agents and regulators.

• Fluency in English and Swahili.
